entries.title: Dynasty
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
The Taken have entered the Pyramidion, most likely looking to replenish their ranks following the Taken War. 


Investigate the Taken activity in the Pyramidion on Io.

entries.title: Dynasty
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote: You cleared the Pyramidion of the Taken and prevented them from rebuilding their army. Asher refuses to thank you for doing your job.

entries.title: Dynasty
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
Ikora's agents have reported unusual Taken activity on the plateaus of Io. Confirm the intel.



        Speak with Asher about the ramifications of the Vex being converted by the Taken.

entries.title: Evacuation: Io
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
As you relay Zavala's message to Asher, he grins dryly.


"He values my safety over documenting galaxy-saving knowledge? How noble," he says and waves away Zavala's concern. "If that is all the bureaucrat had to say, there are several tasks requiring your attention."


"Ikora told me of unusual Taken activity nearby, but I did not make it a priority. You must correct that oversight. In addition, an altered Taken roams the nearby caves. Fetch a sample so that I may probe it for Dark influence."


"Most importantly, venture into the Pyramidion and search for scan evidence. I believe the dark ships came here for the same reason as I."


The scientist raises an eyebrow. "Paracausal as they may be, perhaps they are not beyond scientific curiosity."

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote: Your reputation on Io precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote: Your reputation in the Crucible precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote: Complete patrols and public events on Io to get Io tokens and earn Level 20 rewards from Asher Mir.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote: Complete patrols and public events on Io to get Phaseglass Needles and earn rewards from Asher Mir.

entries.title: FLASHPOINT: IO
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
Asher thanks you for eliminating the annoyances from the Prison of Elders on Io.



        Asher thanks you for eliminating the annoyances from the Prison of Elders on Io.

entries.title: FLASHPOINT: IO
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
Complete various activities around Io, including public events, Lost Sectors, and Heroic Adventures.



        Complete various activities around Io, including public events, Lost Sectors, and Heroic Adventures.

entries.title: Fleischman-Aschheim Axiom
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
Asher studies the data you brought him. "I finally see," he says.


"If the Darkness claims the Pyramidion, it will dissect it for study. Unfold its innumerable dimensions, wade through its multitudinous seas radiozoic, peer through its crackling warp gates leading toward a million millions of new realities…"


Asher's voice drops low and quiet. "I will not allow it."


"If something steps out of that ship and descends down the pulsing electric corridors of the Pyramidion, through the infinite swirling Cantor dust of its interior…"


"They will find me in its heart. On the shores of my radiolarian lake."


Asher's arm emits a steady mechanical thrum.


"And I will be ready for them."

entries.title: Increase Reputation
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote: Show Asher Mir proof of your deeds on Io.

entries.title: Io Challenges
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote: You've done your part to secure Io, and Asher appreciates it. Even if he doesn't show it.

entries.title: Plotting a Downfall
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
Asher takes your data and enters it into his terminal with inhuman speed. The console emits a mechanical hum, then an incongruously cheerful chime.


"Novel stimulus yields novel data!" he cries, and his metallic arm spasms in agreement.


As he studies the readout, an inscrutable expression twists his face. "This pattern of interference, paired with the Taken behavior observed in the Festering Core… something is studying the Vex."


He looks toward the distant Pyramid. "There's a chess game being played here, and someone doesn't want us to see who wins."


"Continue your patrols," he says, waving you away. "I will send word if I have more time to dedicate to your mentorship."

entries.title: Precisely
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
"Ah, unchocolate," Asher says, taking the chocolate bar. "An acquired taste, to be sure, but so much better than those cloying chocolate coins…"


He sets the bar down. "I don't approve of this pointless scavenger hunt of yours. It's easy to laugh at death when you believe you're never going to die, isn't it?"

entries.title: Precisely
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
"The Festival of the Lost is not about masks and sweets," Asher says when you return. "You've known true loss, so you must know that."


After a contemplative pause, he hands you a stalk of celery. "Go on, then. Play your game, but don't let the levity of it fool you into forgetting what this tradition is truly about."

entries.title: Preparation: Io
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
Asher Mir is working furiously at his terminal as you approach. Multicolored waveforms crash and collapse on the screen.


"There you are, assistant," he says. "I saw you earlier as you ran off after that ship."


"The denizens of this moon are reacting strangely to the Pyramid. Take to the field, record your actions, and bring me the data."


"I shouldn't have to tell you to hurry." He glances toward the black ship hanging in the sky, and his eyes narrow with irritation. "Time appears to be of the essence."

entries.title: Reach Level 20
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote: Increase your level to claim these rewards.

entries.title: Return to Asher Mir
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
"Back again, eh? I like your tenacity. It will serve me as we continue to study interesting readings across this increasingly odd world… For science!"


Continue to explore Io by completing adventures, bounties, Lost Sectors, public events, and world quests to earn XP, gear, and other rewards.

        We don't know enough about the Red Legion's flagship, the Almighty. Asher Mir believes that by gaining access to the Golden Age Warmind Network, we could retrieve important data to improve the odds of victory.

entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
Hey Guardian,



        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

entries.title: A Good Match
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Banshee offers to help you improve your new Auto Rifle, Tommy's Matchbook.

entries.title: A Good Match
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Banshee thinks he can help boost your weapon's performance, but he needs you to do some work in the field first.

entries.title: A Good Match
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "This should give you an edge in the field," Banshee says. "Happy to help."

entries.title: A Guardian Rises
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee stands at a countertop meticulously inspecting an unfinished weapon.


"Oh. Hey. You new here?" he says gruffly.


"Don't think I've seen you around before. Then again, not good with faces."


He trails off, his attention back to some detail of the rifle in his hands. He regards you carefully for a moment.


"Oh, that's right, Commander told me you were coming. Asked me to get you set up. Got it on a note right here. Here. Take this. It's solid."


His eyes look past you for a moment before snapping back.


"Oh. Hey. Wait, we spoke already, right? Right. Stay safe."

entries.title: A Sacred Fusion
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 looks up from his toolbench when you get close. He smiles. "It's no secret you've been putting in the work down there," he says. "You more than deserve this."


He hands you a gleaming new weapon.


"I'm gonna keep working on some new looks for it," he says. "A gun that nice deserves some extra attention, don't you agree?"

entries.title: A Sacred Fusion
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 waves you over. "Got something interesting cooking up back there," he says. "Experimental tech. It'll be a little hot to handle."


"While I'm working on it, go make a name for yourself in the field. I want them to wonder where you get your guns. Head into strikes and Crucible and the other one that snake guy runs."


He seems lost in thought for a moment. "What's it called? Gamble?"


"Anyway, go in there and make a name for yourself," he says. "Then when they see you carrying that new piece, they'll know I don't hand 'em out to just anybody."

entries.title: Aftershock
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "I trust my own expertise in crafting weapons. For expertise in their use, I turn to you." -Ada-1

entries.title: An Education
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Complete activities to prove your mastery of Eriana's Vow and Banshee will reward you with an Exotic weapon catalyst.

entries.title: An Old Flame
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Job well done. This dragon's ready to roar." -Banshee-44

entries.title: An Old Flame
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Haven't gotten my hands on one of these in a long time, but I can tell it's keen to get back into fighting trim. Want to see what it can do?" -Banshee-44

entries.title: And Out Fly the Wolves
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee spins a Wolfpack Round on his workbench, then stops it with his palm. "Perfectly balanced," he muses. "Not surprised. Crux really knew how to put these things together."


He looks up at you. "I wouldn't have thought forging a new Gjallarhorn was possible, but it seems that every day, the impossible gets a little closer."


He looks over at the vaults a few meters away, now brimming with the weapon stashes of countless Guardians. "We lost a lot in the Red War. The Fallen probably tucked what tech they could carry somewhere in the Cosmodrome. Check the old scav hangouts. Maybe Exodus Garden."


Banshee appears lost in thought for a moment. "Y'know, part of wielding the Gjallarhorn is honoring those who didn't make it. Parts should come from the armor of those we've lost… yeah. And we've lost a lot lately…"


He digs around under his table for a moment, then comes up with a battered trigger mechanism.


"I pieced this together a long time ago so I wouldn't forget some friends I had," he says, then looks down. "Didn't work. Maybe it's time to let go of the past, but still honor it."


He raps the tables with his metal knuckles. "Let's make this weapon one to remember."

entries.title: Another Last City
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "I remembered where the name Arbalest came from… or at least I had remembered. Hmm, well take 'er for a spin. Maybe that'll jog my memory."

entries.title: Another Last City
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Arbalest… can't remember what this was named after. Either way, it's a handy weapon. You know what would help tune it just right? Getting some data from Neomuna. You up for it? "

entries.title: Any Data Port in a Storm
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"You know, once upon a time, we didn't put onboard AIs into our weapons." The grim Exo looks over the auto rifle. "Those were dark times. Things are much more interesting now." 


He sets to work, making minuscule adjustments to the auto rifle's frame. "Programs can do a lot, but sometimes you just need to get your hands in there…" 


The nanites apparently take his lead, because when he finally returns the weapon to you, the balance feels better, the weight adjusts in your hand to perfect levels as you hold it. Banshee's grin is wicked and joyful. "One last set of calibrations. Call it high-impact testing."

entries.title: Applied Cryptosecurity
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
It takes a moment for Banshee to remember why you've come to him with a more-or-less-functional key generator, but after a bit of kind prompting from Ghost, he gets there.


"Right, right," he mutters, rummaging through a pile of ammo cases and weapon parts on his work bench. He finds a small device which he uses to digitally sign your generator, and just like that, you've got a simple little program that can spit out a code that should open that case.


"Go see if it works," Banshee says gruffly.

entries.title: Armor Synthesis Introduction
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Folks are saying Ada-1's back? Don't remember her leaving," Banshee grumbles. His eyes narrow, but he doesn't stop repairing the Auto Rifle on his desk.


"Come to think of it, I guess I didn't see her for a while… anyway, I hear she's asking Guardians for help. Got some new project in the works, something about programmable matter… and Europa? The Fallen too… Hard to keep the details straight, but I'm glad she's keeping busy."


The servos in his hand whirr quietly as he works on the weapon.


"Maybe pay her a visit? Whatever she's making, I'm sure it's worth your time. She's always been a special talent."

entries.title: Banshee-44
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"I got a special relationship with loss. You know that." Banshee looks down at the gun he's polishing. "It's not easy, keeping spirits up during a holiday that's all about remembering."


He pauses, then looks up. "But those memories are in there somewhere. Deep down, maybe. So I try to honor them best I can, especially this time of year."

entries.title: Blade of Broken Dreams
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Head back to the Tower and speak to Banshee-44 about the broken blade.

entries.title: Blast from the Past
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee holds a slug shotgun in his hand, intricately ornamented and gleaming with polished metal. He rotates it, testing the weight distribution, then quickly spins it by the lever. A shell ejects as it lands back in his hands, pointed at you.


"Same as you ever were, old friend."


He lowers the barrel and inspects the weapon.


"This weapon was in Holliday's family a long time. Helped her make it to this city…"


"Look out for your friends, Guardian. This shotgun will help you do just that."

entries.title: Blast from the Past
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Didn't I ask Shaw to take care of this? Hmm, Holliday was right: 'delegate' might be his favorite word."


"Been trying to fix up an old family heirloom of Holliday's for a while now, something to remember her by. This'll help me calibrate the tooling. Only…"


Banshee wipes the grease from his forehead.


"Where did I put those charts? I'm going to need some time to crunch these numbers. Come back in a bit."

entries.title: Blast from the Past
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"A Holliday family schematic…"


Banshee's eyes shimmer.


"Holding this reminds me of those harebrained schematics Amanda used to create."


"I'll need to see how it performs in extreme temperatures. Europa might be a good spot to generate some data below freezing points. How about it?"

entries.title: Cayde's Will
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Banshee-44's eyes burn brightly as he speaks of repairing the Ace of Spades. But he can't do it alone. He'll need some biorhythmic data from you-and some parts from the secret caches Cayde hid across the system.

entries.title: Cayde's Will
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 forged Cayde's favorite gun, the Ace of Spades. He can't bear the thought of that prized piece in Uldren's hand.



        Banshee-44 forged Cayde's favorite gun, the Ace of Spades. He can't bear the thought of that prized piece in Uldren's hand.

entries.title: Cayde's Will
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Banshee's old hands rove over the Ace of Spades, sliding new pieces into place, closing a polished unscored chassis over its perfectly tuned mechanisms. It's done. The Ace of Spades is yours.

entries.title: Cayde's Will
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44's eyes burn brightly as he speaks of repairing the Ace of Spades. But he can't do it alone. He'll need some biorhythmic data from you-and some parts from the secret caches Cayde hid across the system.



        Banshee-44's eyes burn brightly as he speaks of repairing the Ace of Spades. But he can't do it alone. He'll need some biorhythmic data from you-and some parts from the secret caches Cayde hid across the system.

entries.title: //CHOIR: ESCALATE
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Hard to think with someone else's words in your head." -Banshee-44

entries.title: //CHOIR: ETERNAL
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "There's something down there. Something… singing." -Banshee-44

entries.title: //CHOIR: UPHEAVAL
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "I hear her voice… Can you hear it too?" -Banshee-44

entries.title: Dawning Delivery
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Banshee-44 blinks and stares at the gift, then takes it before you can question him.

entries.title: Dawning's Gift: Banshee-44
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Banshee looks like he recognizes what you've brought him, but you can't be sure. There's no mistaking the gratitude in his eyes, though.

entries.title: Decrypting Resonant Elements
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Glad you were able to get those Resonant Elements outta those Prime Engrams. I know Rahool will do his best to get as many as he can from them each week."


"Though if you're anything like me, it's hard keepin' track of something like Resonant Elements all the time. I hear the Relic Tether on Mars is great for that." 


Banshee scratches his head. "Hm. Now where was I? …Anyways, appreciate the help today, Guardian."

entries.title: Decrypting Resonant Elements
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Hey, Guardian," Banshee says. "Been working with Master Rahool, our resident Cryptarch, to help you get Resonant Elements at the point of Prime Engram decryption. If you got any of those engrams, make sure you take 'em to him."


• Have Master Rahool decrypt a Prime Engram, and he will provide you with Resonant Elements up to a limit each week.

entries.title: Decrypting Resonant Elements
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Acquire the quest from Banshee-44 to learn how decrypted Prime Engrams can provide Resonant Elements.

entries.title: Effort Rewarded
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "This should give you an edge in the field," Banshee says. "Happy to help."

entries.title: Eight Count
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Not bad. Reminds me of a time I was tangling with this Vandal… or was it a Hive Knight?" Banshee's voice trails off. After a brief pause, he shakes his head.


"Cayde would probably remember better than me, he was there. Anyway, hope you learned something, Guardian."


You can find additional finishers at the Eververse store.

entries.title: Enhancing Weapons
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee looks pleased to see you and hands you the weapon that he's just finished polishing. 


"You've earned this, Guardian-a weapon capable of using Resonant Elements and being enhanced. After that, you may just want to take this beauty to that Relic in the Enclave. I bet it'll be even better once you reshape it with enhanced traits."

entries.title: Enhancing Weapons
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"I've heard that place called Neomuna has some interesting weapons like this. I'm not much for rumors most of the time, but…" Banshee shrugs. "When it comes to weapons, don't leave nothing to chance."


Weapon enhancement is a powerful tool. Keep gathering Resonant Elements, and you'll be able to build an arsenal of enhanced weapons that the Relic in the Enclave on Mars can reshape to your liking.

entries.title: Enhancing Weapons
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee inspects the weapon in his hands as you approach. "Don't make these like they used to," he says under his breath. His eyes flit toward you. 


"I bet you can appreciate how hard it is to wake up a gun sometimes." He looks down at the one he's holding and shakes his head. "Resonant Elements won't help this one. But for ones that can be enhanced? Makes a world of difference in a firefight-so keep your eyes peeled for those."


His eyes gleam with inspiration suddenly. "Take care of a few things for me, and then I'll show you what I mean-find you a weapon worthy of enhancing and reshaping."

entries.title: Enhancing Weapons
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Acquire a quest from Banshee-44 to learn about weapon enhancement.

entries.title: Exalting the Flame
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 briefly looks up from his work. "Zahn's always been a pain. Glad someone put him in his place."


"Sounds like you made an impression on Ikora. She asked me to find a Solar weapon for you." The weapon that he hands you looks untouched, fresh from the armory. "This can Scorch, just like you. Should play well with your armor and abilities."


When you don't immediately leave, Banshee speaks up once more. "Not often that Ikora puts in a request like this. If you want to keep learning, go back to her. I think she'll make time for you."


Check back with Ikora to continue learning about your Light, including other Aspects, abilities, Fragments, and keywords.

entries.title: Experimental Weapon
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: The Gunsmith has a delivery for you: an experimental prototype weapon from Omolon foundry.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Your reputation with the Gunsmiths precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Dismantle Rare or Legendary gear to get Gunsmith materials and earn Level 20 rewards from the Gunsmiths.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Dismantle Rare or Legendary gear to get Gunsmith Materials and earn rewards from the Gunsmith.

entries.title: Finishing Touches
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Guardian. I found something I thought you'd find useful. Set it aside somewhere here. Let's see…"

entries.title: Forging Your Own Path
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 waves you over. "Got an interesting request for you here," he says. "I've got the rough specs for a weapon, but the particulars depend on how you gather the combat data."


"You can tackle this one your way: help Zavala with some strikes, do Crucible matches for Shaxx, or run through Gambit for that other guy."


Banshee-44 waves his hand. "I forget his name-smells funny, snakes on his clothes?"


"Anyway," he continues, "the weapon will come out the same no matter how you get the data, so just help whomever you like the most."


"Me, I'd go with Zavala. I don't know the Drifter, and that guy with the horns on his hat is just too loud."

entries.title: Grenade Logic
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 takes the Grenade Launcher from you and applies the catalyst.


"I had to do some real research into Hive stuff to figure out how to get it just right," he says.


"Saw some old names," he mutters. "Stirred up some old memories."


Work complete, he hands the weapon back to you with a wink.


"If you use that thing on Crota, tell him Banshee sent you."

entries.title: Grenade Logic
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"What are you doing?" Banshee-44 exclaims as you place the weapon before him. "You can't just take guns from the Hive and expect me to…"


He trails off as he picks up the weapon and turns it over in his hands. 


"Who's been working on this? Eris?" he wonders to himself. "She must have had Brya help."


He holds one of the dangling cards between his metal fingers and squints.


"These use Hive magic to keep the weapon intact, huh?" he says. "Smart. A little creepy, but smart."


Finally, he nods and hands the weapon back.


"You don't need to be a thanatonaut to see this thing has some deep ties to the other side. You want to earn its respect, you'll have to do a lot of killing, and not as much dying."

entries.title: Gunsmith Rank
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Complete daily Gunsmith bounties and dismantle weapons and armor. Earn armor and weapons at each rank, and powerful upgrades at major ranks.

entries.title: Gunsmith Rank
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Think you can handle serious hardware? Prove it." 
-Banshee-44

entries.title: Heavy Does It
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Nice work, Guardian." Banshee-44 looks up from his workbench. He hands you the repaired catalyst. 


"All that Cabal tech you seized worked like a dream. It's fully operational, and ready for the field."


"Good luck out there. Not that you need it," he quips.

entries.title: Heavy Does It
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Cabal tech is twice as thick as it needs to be, and three times as heavy. Get your hands on some Cabal tech to finish this rebuild."
-Banshee-44

entries.title: Heavy Does It
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"This is a fine looking piece of Cabal scrap," Banshee-44 says, turning the catalyst over in his hands. 


"But it needs to be rebuilt before you can use it in the field."


"Lucky for you," he continues, "I got a plan. All we need is some Cabal tech to study…"

entries.title: Heavy Does It
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Nice work, Guardian." Banshee-44 looks up from his workbench. He hands you the repaired catalyst. 


"All that Cabal tech you seized worked like a dream. It's fully operational, and ready for the field."


"Good luck out there. Not that you need it," he quips.

entries.title: Heavy Does It
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"This is a fine looking piece of Cabal scrap," Banshee-44 says, turning the catalyst over in his hands. 


"But it needs to be rebuilt before you can use it in the field."


"Lucky for you," he continues, "I got a plan. All we need is some Cabal tech to study…"

entries.title: Higher Voltage
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Looks like it worked," Banshee comments upon your return.


"Arcology's scientists were good, but they didn't have Guardians. Bet they never counted on channeling Arc Light through this thing."


He gives the weapon a final inspection, seemingly lost in thought.


"Heard about an old power source Sloane was carting around Titan for a time. Maybe this gun was meant to go with it."


Banshee shrugs as he hands the Centrifuse back to you.


"Guess we'll never know. Another memory, lost beneath the waves."

entries.title: Higher Voltage
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee examines the charred Centrifuse with a sharp eye.


"Impressive stuff," he mutters to himself before looking back to you.


"Cutting edge Golden Age tech. Some burnt out components, but… hmm…"


He crosses his arms in front of his chest and nods slowly to himself.


"Yeah. There's potential here. Need you to do some calibrating first, though."


Banshee hands the weapon back to you with a knowing expression.

entries.title: Illegal Trigger
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "I trust my own expertise in crafting weapons. For expertise in their use, I turn to you." -Ada-1

entries.title: Impossible Rumors
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Look… I'm not gonna tell ya there are weapons out there more complex… more deadly than the greatest gunsmiths could design. But there's rumors of an outbreak on Titan and a worm on Io that packs more punch than a Titan on a bad day. Don't take my word for it. Ask around."


Incredible weapons exist in the wilds beyond the City. Follow clues and learn from your fellow Guardians to discover what is myth and what is real.

entries.title: In-Flight Benefits
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "I trust my own expertise in crafting weapons. For expertise in their use, I turn to you." -Ada-1

entries.title: Increase Reputation
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Show the Gunsmith proof of your enthusiasm for destruction.

entries.title: Independent Study
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee is quiet for a while, then he says, "Say. I don't mind lookin' at this for you, but I'm gonna have to tell Ikora about it, all right?"


You nod. "You might as well throw this away and start from scratch," Banshee mumbles. "But… If you're really determined…"


By the time he sends you on your way with a detailed shopping list, he's forgotten the conversation entirely.

entries.title: Initial Calibration
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "I trust my own expertise in crafting weapons. For expertise in their use, I turn to you." -Ada-1

entries.title: Initial Calibration
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "How did it go? No, no, don't tell me. The telemetry must speak for itself." -Ada-1

entries.title: Initial Calibration
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Your test results were invaluable in the development process. We make a good fireteam-is that how a Guardian would say it?" -Ada-1

entries.title: Initial Calibration
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "The Shotgun needs some adjustments. Come back anytime, Guardian." -Ada-1

entries.title: Initial Calibration
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Come back soon, Guardian. We have yet to perfect our Bow!" -Ada

entries.title: Into the Abyss
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 gives you a curious look. "Never understood anything Ikora said about the Void. But I know weapons, and she asked me to find one for you."


The weapon that he hands you looks untouched, fresh from the armory. "Let's say you debuff a target with Void. Drop them with this, and you'll get a Void barrier for protection. Should work well with your armor too."


He lapses into a thoughtful silence before speaking up again. "You're not bad at this, Guardian. But nobody knows everything. If you want to get better, ask Ikora to keep teaching you."


Check back with Ikora to continue learning about your Light, including other Aspects, Fragments, abilities, and keywords.

entries.title: Legacy: //CHOIR: ESCALATE
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Hard to think with someone else's words in your head." -Banshee-44

entries.title: Legacy: //CHOIR: ETERNAL
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "There's something down there. Something… singing." -Banshee-44

entries.title: Legacy: //CHOIR: UPHEAVAL
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "I hear her voice… Can you hear it too?" -Banshee-44

entries.title: Lost Lament
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "This thing is givin' me flashes left and right. But they're scrambled. Something about a bunker hidden away among the ice. Must be Europa. Gotta ask you to help one more time. We're close, I can feel it."

entries.title: Lost Lament
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Bunch of Guardians storm the Deep Stone Crypt and next thing I know, I wake up in a daze sprawled out on the floor.


"Seems crazy to assume the two are connected, but then again, stranger things and all that, y'know?


"Now you walk in here and my insides go haywire all over again.


"Lotta weird images flashin' through my mind. Hard to make sense of 'em all. Vex… a blade… And a few dead Exos on Europa, unhappy with their lot in life, I imagine.


"Not sure what that's about. Maybe see about findin' 'em? Help me make sense of all this. I'll be waitin'."


-Banshee-44

entries.title: Lost Lament
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Well… that did it. I can see a bit clearer now. The thing-the big Exo head… It's me. And I'm… it. Both of us, Clovis Bray. Well that's… certainly something.


"I don't feel like the old man. But it's coming into focus more each minute.


"I know now I used that Sword to repel a takeover by the Vex during the Golden Age. Looks like you've done somethin' similar. No need to hand it over; it's yours now.


"Thanks for protecting, well, me. I think I'll be makin' a trip over there at some point. Visit my giant self. Learn more about who I was.


"I've got questions, and it sounds like I've also got answers. Hopefully I've got nothing left to answer for."

entries.title: Magnum Opus
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee stares silently at the weapon you place before him.


"Where did you…" he begins, but then stops. Carefully, he takes the incomplete weapon in his hands.


He tests its weight, its sights, considers the brutal efficiency of its design. "You've never brought me a piece like this before," he murmurs. "I'd remember."


Finally, he turns to you. "I can fix this," he says. "It won't be exactly how it was… I'll have to improvise. I don't know the make of any of these parts. I'm not even sure what kind of metal…"


He trails off again, then takes the weapon into the back of his shop.


"It'll shoot," he says when he reappears. "Thing'll kick like a warthog, but it'll shoot."


He hands you the sidearm with reverence. "A gun like that could make somebody a hero."


He chuckles. "Of course, it wouldn't hurt to be a hero to begin with."

entries.title: Magnum Opus II
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
You approach Banshee's work table with the Anomalous Weapon Part in your hand. Banshee reaches across and snatches it from you before you can say a word.


"Would you look at that," he marvels, inspecting the part. "There's only one weapon I've ever seen that matches this make. It's not the kind of piece you'd forget. Give me a minute, and I'll tune it up for you."


He disappears with the piece for a moment, then reappears, chuckling to himself. "This much power in a sidearm… I can hardly tell if this is the world's biggest pistol or the world's smallest rifle."


"Fine tune this in the field and you'll be legendary," he says with a wink. "Go get 'em, Guardian."

entries.title: Make Bows, Not War
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee looks up from his work as you approach. "Hey," he says. "Heard about the Moon. Nightmares. Vex." He shakes his head. "You're gonna want some, uh... Some real firepower for that."


His gaze loses focus for a moment, then he goes on. "Got somethin' in my workshop that I want you to have. Ain't a gun. Big Bow. It'll chew up those Vex real good. You go on up to my workshop, take a look at it. See if you like it. Cayde'll tell ya where the secret entrance is."


Another customer queues behind you. Best get going.

entries.title: Meet Banshee-44
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"It's always nice to meet a new Guardian. As a welcome to the Tower, here… take this weapon. Trust me. It's an upgrade."


Banshee-44 is the Tower's Gunsmith. He offers bounties, gear mods, and special rewards.


Hover over the weapon icon below, and select it with .


ACQUIRE WEAPON

entries.title: Messy Business
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Banshee-44 lifts the launcher for you to take. "See what you think. I tweaked it. Snappy and quick. Don't thank me, the work occupies… If anything, I should be thanking you."

entries.title: Messy Business
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 tunes an unfinished weapon frame as you approach him. "Lot of things coming to light recently. Maybe it's best to put it out of your head and focus on the simple things."


Banshee looks up from his work. "Get everything in tune before moving forward, you know? Here's your kit. Keep em on their heels."

entries.title: New Enhancements
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Let's see," Banshee says, leaning against the counter. "I think I could give this weapon a boost for you. Something to help you out in the field."


He nods. "But first, I need to see how you handle it. Get me some data, and I'll see what I can do."

entries.title: Nightfall
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Guardian. I found something I thought you'd find useful. Set it aside somewhere here. Let's see…"

entries.title: Nightfall: The Ordeal
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Guardian. I found something I thought you'd find useful. Set it aside somewhere here. Let's see…"

entries.title: No Trespassing
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"That catalyst polished up real nice," Banshee says. 


He hands it back to you and asks, "Who did the work?"


Ghost starts to answer, but Banshee's attention wanders to work on other weapons.


"See you around," he says.

entries.title: No Trespassing
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"This came in for you. Tech is Fallen. Could ask, uh… Splicers-yeah."


Banshee looks proud and then flips the piece over. "Wait… no. Forgot about this."


Banshee pulls a pin from the frame of the catalyst. He holds it up to looks at it. It lights up and emits a tiny projection of Calus.


"Welcome to my little game of tribute," the projection says. "If you want your treasure, you'll have to pay in blood."


"You are a trespasser in my home, just as the Fallen trespass in your home. Rid your home of the trespassers, and my gift will be yours."


The projection finishes with booming laughter and shuts off.


"Huh," grunts Banshee.

entries.title: Nock, Draw, Loose, Quiet
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 takes the Verglas Curve from you and applies the catalyst.


"It's not as complex as the system a compound bow has," he explains as he restrings the weapon, "but it should give you a little extra kick."


He finishes, then lets his hands linger for a moment on the dark wood.


"There's something honest about a weapon built like this," he says. 


"Take good care of it."

entries.title: Nock, Draw, Loose, Quiet
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
As you place the Verglas Curve in front of Banshee-44, a look of confusion crosses his face.


"Hey, look. I said I could improve your new weapon, but I didn't know it was…" he trails off as he picks up the bow and eyes it skeptically. 


"Is this made of… wood?"


He runs his metal fingers over the bowstring and delicate ferns of frost sprout from the tension. 


"Oh. Stasis," he grumbles. "I heard about Guardians using some kind of yarn power… well, at least I understand this." 


"Okay," he says with a shrug, "if you can shoot it, I can improve it. Any catalyst for this weapon would have been lost long ago, so we'll have to recreate one." 


He hands the bow back to you. "Take it to the field and let's figure out how it works."

entries.title: One Last Job
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Some guns need to finish what they started long ago. You're just along for the ride." -Banshee-44

entries.title: One Way, Many Paths
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 takes your combat data and returns with a gleaming rifle.


"I forgot to check whom you sided with, Guardian," he says, then chuckles. "It's kinda funny. Whomever you pick, you come back to me, right?"


"I guess everybody needs a weapon. That piece oughta do you good wherever you're headed next."

entries.title: Pain and Gain
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Got a weapon frame here you might like, but its pain matrix is on the fritz. Seems like trouble. Hmm…


"Had a friend who'd say 'trouble's the point.' He had a chicken and a sense of humor. Anyway...


"Have your Ghost track the thresholds of the punishment you take out in the wilds so we can fine-tune its systems to channel and redirect your, uhh… discomfort."


Follow the quest steps to complete the objectives as Banshee-44 helps you construct a powerful Exotic weapon.

entries.title: Points Piercing Forever
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"That's all the energy this thing needs," nods Banshee-44 as he hands you the completed catalyst. "Let me tell you, I think there's something funny about this bow. It messes with my internal chronometer."


"It feels like that thing was meant for your hands. Like it always belonged there."

entries.title: Points Piercing Forever
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"I've got a catalyst for that bow of yours," Banshee-44 says. "I think I've always had it, but I don't remember getting it."


"Charge the catalyst with energy and I'll work on it for you… but next time, can you just bring me a regular gun? Nothing that collapses timelines or whatever?"

entries.title: Prototype Tuning: Bowstring
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Thanks to you, I know just where to add the nocking point. I appreciate your help, Guardian." -Ada-1

entries.title: Prototype Tuning: Magazine
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Thanks to you, I got incredible data. If you got any closer, they would start blushing." -Ada-1

entries.title: Prototype Tuning: Traits
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Thanks to you, I got incredible data. If you got any closer, they would start blushing." -Ada-1

entries.title: Prototype Tuning: Traits
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Thanks to you, I know just where to add the nocking point. I appreciate your help, Guardian." -Ada-1

entries.title: Reach Level 20
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Increase your level to claim these rewards.

entries.title: Remembrance
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Never liked the Moon. Too many memories. Too many lost friends. Hate to see you end up the same… And I know you've walked where most wouldn't dare, but there's always lessons to learn, Guardian. Even some you think you already know."


Heed Banshee's words. Do as he asks, and earn an Exotic weapon catalyst for the Eriana's Vow Hand Cannon.

entries.title: Resonant Smithing
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Nice work, you've earned these Resonant Elements. I can only get my hands on so many each week. You can use you Relic Tether to check how many I've got left."


"Stick around a few moments and I'll teach you how you can earn more of those Resonant Elements. Not to mention how to put those things to good use."

entries.title: Resonant Smithing
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"You've been doing some gunsmithing of your own, haven't you?"


The Exo stares you down sternly.


"Nice. I'm not sure how you do it exactly, but Rahool mentioned these things are at the root of it."


Banshee flashes a couple Resonant Elements.


"Do some bounties for me, and I'll throw in a few of these."

entries.title: Resonant Smithing
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Acquire the quest from Banshee-44 to learn how to earn Resonant Elements for use in weapon shaping.

entries.title: REVISION 7.2.2
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Hear me out," Banshee says as he slams part of a jumpship drive and a datapad on the counter. "Your gun uses a Lorentz focuser to channel energized particles, so does this old Echo-class jump drive. Before it blew up. Unrelated."


"If we mod your gun with these drive components, we'll be able to give it a lot more…" Banshee says before slamming his fist down on the counter. Then he just stares vacantly for a moment and asks, "What're you doing here? Oh, right. Hear me out," Banshee says. "Your gun uses a Lorentz focuser to…"


You take the jump drive parts and the datapad before Banshee goes through his plan all over again.

entries.title: REVISION 7.2.2
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Huh, look at that," Banshee says with an approving nod. "Linear modulator's looking good, thermal caster is intact, joints to the intake valves are nice and solid. Heck, this looks like as good a job as I'd do."


Banshee stares down at the catalyst, eyes slowly narrowing. "Wait, did I do this? Somebody did." He looks around, furtively, then slides you the catalyst.


"I don't know where I got this, but I think it'll work in your gun," Banshee says without any recognition in his eyes. "Here, take it."

entries.title: Shaped Weapon Level Boosting
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
As you approach, Banshee waves you over and puts aside his latest project. 


"Guardian. Saw you've been collecting those Resonant Elements. Do yourself a favor sometime and use 'em to improve your weapon directly for a quick boost." He scratches his head. "Should work pretty well with one of them Shaped weapons." 


• Resonant Elements you collect can be used for more than Deepsight activation. They can improve your weapon's level directly; this is called weapon level boosting. Careful, though, as the higher the level, the more Resonant Elements it will cost. Take some Resonant Elements and try leveling one of your Shaped weapons.

entries.title: Shaped Weapon Level Boosting
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
While final blows with your weapon and activity completion will level the weapon, weapon level boosting using Resonant Elements will help you unlock additional reshaping options faster.


However, the more you level your weapon, the more expensive it will get.

entries.title: Shaped Weapon Level Boosting
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Acquire the quest from the Gunsmith to learn about weapon level boosting.

entries.title: Should You Choose to Accept It, Part IV
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee looks down at the components laid out in front of him. He doesn't even pick one up, but there's a look of recognition in his eyes; distant and intense.


"They found something on the Moon…" he says, distractedly. "K1 anomaly. Smells like wet soil." He shakes his head, picking up one of the components.


"Nice parts," Banshee says with sudden clarity. "I can put these together for you, no problem."

entries.title: Sight, Shoot, Repeat
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "MIDA. MIDA. Old name. Almost as old as me. Lost a bunch of my schematics when the Tower went down. Could recreate one for you. If that's the kind of thing you're into." -Banshee-44

entries.title: Spare Parts
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee eyes you with a skeptical stare.


"Huh? I don't remember asking you to do this…"


He shrugs. "Oh, well. Everything helps, I guess. Thanks for your work."

entries.title: Speak with Banshee
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Banshee thinks he can help boost your weapon's performance, but he needs you to do some work in the field first.

entries.title: Stasis Trigger
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
You overhear Banshee-44 talking to himself as you approach.


"Never saw a gun like that before," he says quietly. "Thing would go cold in your hands. Nothing good can come from a piece like that."


"Hey, Guardian," he says as he notices you. "Do me a favor: you ever find a Sidearm that runs cold, you be sure to keep this catalyst far away from it, y'hear?"


He holds up a damaged Sidearm catalyst.


"'Course, thing's busted pretty bad now. I'd need plenty of calibration data to get it up and running again."


"Get me some, would you?"

entries.title: Stasis Trigger
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 shivers as he holds the calibrated catalyst.


"There was some gun I was supposed to keep this away from," he says. "Something cold and dark. Can't really remember, though."


"Now that it's fully calibrated, maybe you could hold onto it to keep it safe."


His face brightens. "It might fit that Sidearm you've got there, in fact!"


Banshee-44 tosses you the catalyst, thanks you for your help, and goes back to polishing his weapons.

entries.title: Symmetry Remastered
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee takes a look at your gun and nods his approval. "I like the look of this one," he says. "But I bet I can help you kick it up a notch."


He leans back and crosses his arms. "Let me know if you want my help."

entries.title: Symmetry Remastered
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "This should help you get that extra edge I was talkin' about," Banshee says. "Not that you need it."

entries.title: Symmetry Remastered
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Let's see," Banshee says, leaning against the counter. "I think I could give this weapon a boost for you. Something to help you out in the field."


He nods. "But first, I need to see how you handle it. Get me some data, and I'll see what I can do."

entries.title: Taming the Storm
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 seems to be expecting you. "So you're the one who blew up that old Servitor? Good riddance, that thing's better off as scrap."


"Got something for you. Ikora said you needed an Arc weapon." The weapon that he hands you looks untouched, fresh from the armory. "This can jolt, just like you. Should play well with your armor and abilities."


Banshee goes back to his work, but not without a parting word. "Bit of advice, Guardian. Get used to seeing Ikora if you want to keep learning." 


Check back with Ikora to continue learning about your Light, including learning about other Aspects, Fragments, abilities, and keywords.

entries.title: Technical Knockout
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Don't let this gig fool you; I like the feel of a trigger under my finger, but sometimes ammo's short. Gotta find other ways to get the job done. Make sure you're prepared when that time comes."


Banshee encourages you to defeat enemies using your finisher.

entries.title: The Bank Job
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Banshee-44 wants to speak with you about the history of the Witherhoard.

entries.title: The Bank Job
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Some guns need to finish what they started long ago. You're just along for the ride." -Banshee-44

entries.title: The Fall Will Kill You
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Almost got it. Still need. Huh. Kind of a strange one. Still need some more data. For the tracker. Keep an open mind." -Banshee-44

entries.title: The Fall Will Kill You
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "That's it. Had to pare down some of the weirder features. Still works as a stellar sextant, cable splitter, avionics trawl, pneumatic drill, compass aligner... anyway. Enjoy the gun part." -Banshee-44

entries.title: The Form of the Danger
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 takes your Delicate Tomb and, after a few moments, installs and calibrates the catalyst.


"That should do it," he says, but his mechanical brow furrows. 


"Touching that weapon again… I don't know why, but I don't feel good about making it stronger." He hands you the gun, but as you take it, he holds his grip for a moment and looks into your eyes.


"I know you can handle anything, Guardian," he says, "but some things might be better forgotten."


He releases the gun and goes back to his business.

entries.title: The Form of the Danger
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 looks at your Delicate Tomb and whistles.


"Nice-lookin' weapon, Guardian," he says. He takes it from you and tests its weight. "Very-"


A strange look crosses the Exo's face. "Huh," he says quietly, "thought I heard something."


"Anyway," he says as he quickly hands the weapon back to you, "it's old construction, not anything I recognize, but I might know a way to tune it up."


He sends you back out into the field.

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Seen the trophy yet?" Banshee asks as you approach his counter. "Zavala asked me to make it for the Games."


He shrugs. "I don't much care who wins. But I like seeing the Tower all dressed up and everyone talkin' about something other than doomsday. It's nice." He nods. "Anyway. Happy, uh…" He pauses, clearly struggling to remember. "Happy… Revelry, Guardian."

entries.title: The Heart's Depths
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "I remembered where the name Arbalest came from… or at least, I had remembered. Hmm, well take 'er for a spin. Maybe that'll jog my memory."

entries.title: The Heart's Depths
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Arbalest… can't remember what this was named after. Either way, it's a handy weapon. You know what would help tune it just right? Getting some data from inside the Traveler's Pale Heart. You up for it?"

entries.title: The Queen Beckons
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
The gears turn in Banshee's head. Distant connections solidify into recognition.


"Right, let's see what you learned in the Throne World."


Banshee tinkers away at the workbench behind him, slowly turning with a completed weapon.


"Sweet, now back to business."

entries.title: The Queen Beckons
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee is distant, taking far too long to notice your presence.


"Hm? Schematic? Yeah. Calibrate. Throne World."

entries.title: The Vow
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Eriana went to the Moon. Many did. None came back. Well… Eris did. But that wasn't 'til later. And she came back… different.


"My point's not about the loss though. Point is they went. Despite the odds. Despite the unknown.


"Eriana may be gone, but that gun means she's still with us. Still able to teach Guardians lessons worth learnin'."

entries.title: The Vow
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Complete activities to prove your mastery of Eriana's Vow and Banshee will reward you with an Exotic weapon catalyst.

entries.title: The Vow
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Never liked the Moon. Too many memories. Too many lost friends. Hate to see you end up the same… And I know you've walked where most wouldn't dare, but there's always lessons to learn, Guardian. Even some you think you already know."


Heed Banshee's words. Do as he asks, and earn an Exotic weapon catalyst for the Eriana's Vow Hand Cannon.

entries.title: Tungsten Bowstring
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "I trust my own expertise in crafting weapons. For expertise in their use, I turn to you." -Ada-1

entries.title: Under the Hood
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Good start. That's a good start. Need more details, though. Ins and outs. Lots of Scouts run on MIDA principles. Crack them open. We'll see what we can find." -Banshee-44

entries.title: Visit Banshee-44
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Riskrunner's a real piece of work. Having a gun that gets aggressive when you're in a bad spot's a life saver. Sure, it may hurt a bit, but once that beauty gets humming, your enemies better watch out."


Your Riskrunner is complete. Use it on your journey to help shift the odds in your favor when the going gets tough.

entries.title: Volantes Violentiam
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Good job. Veist knows what they're about. But so do you." -Banshee-44

entries.title: Volantes Violentiam
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 takes your Manticore and considers it carefully.


"Got some old parts," he says, deep in concentration. "I remember-what was it? It was a long time ago."


He shakes his head as if trying to shake a thought from his mind. The Exo hands the weapon back to you with a look of resolve.


"Won't be too hard to punch it up. No reason we have to settle for what's given."

entries.title: Walk the Line
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Banshee-44 believes he can design a catalyst for the Exotic Shotgun Duality.

entries.title: Walk the Line
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Looks like some things can come back even better than they were before," Banshee-44 says as he processes your data and feeds the results into the Duality.


"Wish it could be that easy for all of us."

entries.title: Weapon Deepsight Activation
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Hey, Guardian. Got this weapon here for you, but you should know-it don't have Deepsight. Might work better with it, though. You get me some Resonant Elements, I'll see what I can do to help you activate this weapon."

entries.title: Weapon Deepsight Activation
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee nods as you approach. "Hey, Guardian. Wanted to make sure you knew that your Resonant Elements can be used to activate Deepsight on weapons-even those that don't have it."


"You set up that Deepsight activation, you can make Weapon Pattern progress with it."


"I'll find you something to test it out; would ya do a quick job for me while I get it?"

entries.title: Weapon Deepsight Activation
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee looks over your handiwork. "Not bad at all. You keep using your Resonant Elements for Deepsight activation, and you'll get more Weapon Patterns. And with more Patterns, you'll be shaping more weapons at that Relic in the Mars Enclave in no time."


"Just don't go expecting anyone to start callin' you the Gunsmith anytime soon." He winks and gives you an appreciative nod.

entries.title: Weapon Deepsight Activation
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Banshee-44 wishes to discuss how to activate Deepsight on weapons to have more control over your Pattern progress.

entries.title: Well Earned
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "This should help you get that extra edge I was talkin' about," Banshee says. "Not that you need it."

entries.title: Where Are the Keys, Sir
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee's pleased that you want the heavy Bow in his workshop. "Good," he says. "Real good. Uh. Problem is, though, lock on that case is real secure. Haven't opened it since we won the war against Ghaul. Not sure I even know where the keycodes are."


He contemplates a moment. "Well. That's all right. We can reverse engineer 'em. I'd say crack the glass, but…" He trails off. There is an ominous look in his eyes. "I don't recommend crackin' the glass."


He gives Ghost a number of diagnostics to generate a new keycode, and then sends you on your way.

entries.title: Always a Hero
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
Benedict Beneath



        "You have not yettttt faced the _#*&% greatest challenge his Highness has to offer." -Benedict 99-40

entries.title: An Imperial Summons
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
As Benedict's core processes seem to hitch and jitter, a commanding presence overtakes the poor frame. A different voice booms through Benedict's speakers.


Emperor Calus, the hedonistic ruler of the Leviathan, has been watching you for some time. He invites you to Nessus, offering riches.


Nothing suspicious about that!

entries.title: Beneath the Bazaar
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
Beneath the Bazaar



        "His Imperial Majest sends his regards. And a just reward for a truuuuuuuue champion_%$&*%%" -Benedict 99-40

entries.title: Benedict 99-40
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
x#4(_ This maintenance frame is amp;_ eager to assist you with #amp; TREASURES FROM THE EMPEROR.  x#9(_



        Emperor Calus was delighted to have you aboard the Leviathan again. You are always welcome at his table.

entries.title: Benedict 99-40
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
x#4(_ This maintenance frame is amp;_ eager to assist you with #amp; TREASURES FROM THE EMPEROR.  x#9(_



        Emperor Calus sees great potential in you. He wants you in his inner circle. And the Cabal emperor always gets what he wants. His Advocate will be in touch soon.

entries.title: Cabal Killer
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
Back to the Bazaar



        "vvvwwwweell done. His Royal Highness bids you show_$%& your loyalty. Use his gift to end the traitorzzzzzz." -Benedict 99-40

entries.title: Crown of Sorrow
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
The "Crown of Sorrow" raid is now active.


One of the Emperor's Loyalists believed he could control an Ascendant artifact. Now the Hive control him. Put Gahlran, the Sorrow-Bearer out of his misery and reclaim the Crown.

entries.title: "Crown of Sorrow" Raid Complete
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
You present Gahlran's helmet to the frame.


Calus speaks through it, as ever. He alludes vaguely to something that he saw out at the edge of the universe during his exile, something that he calls "the truth of the universe."


You'll need to cultivate a greater sense of appreciation for such truths. Perhaps if you spend more time with the Emperor, you'll learn more.

entries.title: Dawning Delivery
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote: Benedict sweeps the floor as you offer him the gift. He reaches to take it and says through a buzz of static, "All glory to the Emperor."

entries.title: End the Arms Dealer
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
Imperial Invitation



        "### Vzzzzt. Imperial Majesty … threat detected. Weaponsmith … continuing threat. Remove #&&_obstacle now. Reap the reward from his Highness." -Benedict 99-40

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote: Complete the "Leviathan" raid and challenges to obtain Emperor Calus tokens and earn Level 20 rewards from Benedict 99-40.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote: Your reputation in Calus's court precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote: Complete the "Leviathan" raid and challenges to obtain Emperor Calus tokens and earn rewards from Benedict 99-40.

entries.title: His Highness's Seal
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
Benedict at the Bazaar



        "kkkkkkzk still much to prove to his Highness. Return to the Leviathan. Seek glory in his nammmme." -Benedict 99-40

entries.title: Increase Reputation
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote: Show Benedict 99-40 proof of Emperor Calus's favor.

entries.title: Knight of Two Realms
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote: Calus is interested by your alliance with the Awoken of the Reef. Should the opportunity arise, he wants you to "put in a good word" for him.

entries.title: Maledict 99-40
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
Benedict stops sweeping and turns to face you. "His Highness sends his good wishes for you at this celebrated time of year," he says. "The Great Emperor rejoices in the overwhelming inevitability of death and is pleased that the Guardian-tribe does the same."


He turns and continues to sweep. "Feast and be merry in the Emperor's name."

entries.title: Meet Benedict 99-40
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
As Benedict's core processes seem to hitch and jitter, a commanding presence overtakes the poor frame. A different voice booms through Benedict's speakers.


Emperor Calus, the hedonistic ruler of the Leviathan, has been watching you for some time. He invites you to Nessus, offering riches.


Nothing suspicious about that!

entries.title: Rein It In
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
Benedict's eye pulses red in syncopated rhythm, solidifying upon your approach.


"You'll be pleased to know your efforts were not in vain and the weapon has been located. Emperor Calus would be satisfied if you could cavort to the Quarry Lost Sector (Legendary) in the EDZ to recover it. In celebration of his decadence, indulge in a merciless spree of Red Legion desecration. Spread delight in his Eminence's name."

entries.title: The Invitation
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
Calus is pleased by your swift progress, but the potential of the Chalice of Opulence far exceeds your efforts today.


Only by entering Calus's Menagerie on the Leviathan will you begin to unlock its true abilities.

entries.title: The Invitation
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
As Calus speaks through Werner 99-40's stolen body, the frame offers you a fragmented Chalice.


Calus invites you to restore the Chalice, a symbol of power for his Shadows-elite Imperial assassins, the epitome of their respective alien races.

entries.title: The Invitation
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote: "Scanning Tower inventory lists… Seems like another maintenance frame went on the fritz and disappeared from the Hangar a day or two ago." -Ghost

entries.title: Under Our Nose
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
Steam emanates from the head of the frame as its piercing red eye raises to meet yours.


"Ah, Guardian. The Exalted One anticipated your cooperation in his grand design. With his infinite wisdom, he requests your assistance in furthering his machinations. His Excellency intended to use the weapon to eliminate Red Legionnaires. It seems you share a mutual goal."


Benedict's body turns and resets.


"Unfortunately, the Shadow you seek has been disposed of. Calus's insubordinate daughter, Caiatl, dispatched a countermeasure-much to the Glorious One's displeasure. The weapon is lost. I can compile the data you've brought me of the deceased Shadow's log, but it is heavily encrypted. Encryption signals point toward the EDZ. Perhaps you can perform some… unscrambling?"

entries.title: A Brother's Guidance
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote:
Vance is studying his scrolls when you return.


"Osiris, the Forest, the Pyramid," he says. "There are connections here that go beyond simple prophecy-"


He stops abruptly, then whispers in the silence.


"As Guardians fall in the Trials, this Lighthouse chimes a dirge. Can't you hear it? Here, in the shadow of the Pyramid, the tones have grown richer."


He tilts his head for a moment, his mouth held in an open smile.


"There. It is the song of life and death."


Knowing there is much to be done, you leave Vance to his studies.

entries.title: Ascendant Lens
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote:
Queen Mara's eyebrows lift as you hand her the Ascendant Lens. "This is an exceedingly rare trinket," she says, peering at you through the lens.


"It may not look like much to a common Guardian, but in the hands of our Techeuns, it will be a valuable research tool. You were right to bring it to me."


"Allow me to repay your generosity," she says, handing you a handsome reward.


You start to thank her, but she's already walking away. You've been dismissed.

entries.title: Better Days Ahead
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote:
Brother Vance listens to your report with great interest. When you are finished, he smiles serenely.


"You have done me a great kindness," he says. "I regret I cannot join you in the City."


For a long moment, he stands peacefully in his cluttered sanctuary.


"I met Osiris once," Vance says. "'Write music,' he told me-among other things."


"The sacred tones came from the Lighthouse. The words are my own-no, not the tale of Osiris. My song is not one of worship, but one of hope, shining brightly in the dark."


"I will walk into the Infinite Forest and spread hope, Guardian."


His gives you a beatific smile.


"Hope for the future."

entries.title: Brother Vance
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote:
Panoptes is gone, but much of the Forest is still under Vex control.


The Infinite Forest is… well, suffice to say, infinite. There are many more mysteries still to discover among its uncountable branches.

entries.title: Dawning Delivery
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote: Brother Vance holds out his hands and accepts the gift. It's hard to tell his expression beneath that blindfold and hood, but you catch a hint of a smile.

entries.title: Discover Mercury
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote:
"You are welcome here, Guardian. The tales of your deeds-both in the past and those yet to come-hint at a legend in the making."


Brother Vance offers bounties, pursuits, and various rewards for Guardians who complete activities on Mercury.


Challenge yourself with adventures, patrols, public events, and a Lost Sector to earn Brother Vance's adulation.

entries.title: Endless Branches
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote: Acquire daily adventure tokens from Brother Vance to complete Mercury adventures and help Osiris protect the Infinite Forest.

entries.title: Endless Branches
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote: Panoptes is gone, but much of the Forest is still under Vex control. Help Osiris protect the Infinite Forest and thwart new Vex stratagems by taking on Mercury adventures.

entries.title: Evacuation: Mercury
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote:
Brother Vance recognizes your footsteps and brightens as you enter his sanctum.


"I believe I could refine traces of Osiris," he says with hushed excitement, "to allow one entrance to the Infinite Forest. There was a time I could not contemplate such an honor."


"Quantum cracks yawn in the Forest where echoes of Vex, Hive, Cabal, and Osiris swirl in a gyre. Strike these stress points, and I could seal the Forest from within."


You notice Vance's hands are balled tightly at his sides.


"The Pyramids draw close. Through this system and beyond, the Lightless are filled with fear. I am no Osiris, true, but in my small way, I will bring light to their darkness."


There is clarity in his voice. "I will tell them they must believe."

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote: Your reputation among the Followers of Osiris precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote: Complete adventures, challenges, patrols, and public events on Mercury to obtain Mercury tokens for Level 20 and higher rewards from Brother Vance.

entries.title: FLASHPOINT: MERCURY
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote:
Brother Vance thanks you for defeating the unbelievers on Mercury.



        Brother Vance thanks you for defeating the unbelievers on Mercury.

entries.title: FLASHPOINT: MERCURY
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote:
Complete various activities around Mercury, including public events, Lost Sectors, and Heroic Adventures.



        Complete various activities around Mercury, including public events, Lost Sectors, and Heroic Adventures.

entries.title: In Your Element
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote:
Brother Vance gestures for you to hold out your hand, and carefully deposits a handful of small, smooth candies into your palm.


"You call this celebration of yours 'Festival of the Lost,'" he says. "But remember, Guardian, that the dead are not truly lost. They are simply inaccessible to us." He pauses, then adds offhandedly, "For the most part."

entries.title: In Your Element
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote:
Brother Vance takes the stalk of celery from you and weighs it in his hand. "I will have to… mm, meditate on this gift, I suppose."


He turns back to his opened book, brushing his fingers over the pages. "The Forest is strange to me at this time of year. The wiser I am, the more Osiris's plans seem to evade me. I suppose that is the way."

entries.title: Increase Reputation
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote: Show Brother Vance proof of your deeds on Mercury.

entries.title: Infinity Plus One
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote: Choose a Heroic adventure from Brother Vance to take on even more challenging simulations in the Infinite Forest. You may undertake one Heroic adventure on Mercury per day.

entries.title: Infinity Plus One
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote: Select another Heroic adventure token to continue defending the Infinite Forest.

entries.title: Infinity Plus One

entries.title: Legends Lost
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote: Saint-14 died a hero, but he also died alone. It is essential that Guardians lean into each others' strengths.

entries.title: Legends Lost
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote: Saint-14 was the first Vanguard commander. Lost for decades, he is still a legend among Guardians. If he returns, his presence will have a huge and very positive impact.

entries.title: Lost Prophecies
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote: Osiris wrote his Lost Prophecies on these six-sided tablets, and hid within them a secret for the Guardian whose deeds he foresaw.

entries.title: Lost Prophecy Tablets
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote: Saint-14 died a hero, but he also died alone. It is essential that Guardians lean into each others' strengths.

entries.title: Lost Prophecy Tablets
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote: Once you have proven yourself worthy of the prophecy, bring it to the Infinite Forge.

entries.title: Preparation: Mercury
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote:
Brother Vance is running his fingers over his books when you arrive. You tell him of Zavala's concern.


He nods. "I will attempt to divine which prophesized end-time we find ourselves in."


Vance traces an arcing hypotrochoid spiral on a thick piece of parchment. "Osiris used obscene amounts of Fractaline to power the obelisks," he says, shaking his head at the paradoxes the old Warlock tempted.


"Now I feel this taut reality tremble and groan. It anchors countless timelines, all pulling against the chronological center. And this Pyramid threatens to collapse them all."


"The Infinite Forest is the key to all of this," he says. "How, I do not yet understand. Any help you could provide would be most welcome."

entries.title: Reach Level 20
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote: Increase your level to claim these rewards.

entries.title: Visit Brother Vance
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote:
"Osiris would be proud to call you his kin, Guardian. Your Light's glow is like a beacon, as is this Lighthouse, to all who would stand against Darkness."


Mercury has many challenges to face. Continue to explore and complete the various activities here, and Brother Vance will reward you.

entries.title: Ascendant Lens
entries.speaker: Campsite
entries.quote:
Queen Mara's eyebrows lift as you hand her the Ascendant Lens. "This is an exceedingly rare trinket," she says, peering at you through the lens.


"It may not look like much to a common Guardian, but in the hands of our Techeuns, it will be a valuable research tool. You were right to bring it to me."


"Allow me to repay your generosity," she says, handing you a handsome reward.


You start to thank her, but she's already walking away. You've been dismissed.

entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
Hey Guardian,



        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

entries.title: Clarion Call: Hunters
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote: Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

entries.title: Dawning's Gift: Cayde
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote: Cayde looks around quickly to see if anyone has noticed, and stashes the gift as only a Hunter could.

entries.title: Destined Heroes
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
When you approach Cayde, he motions for you to lean in close. His voice is a too-loud whisper.


"I see you got my coded message." It was just a regular message. "Listen, I've heard a thing or two about a big threat-I'm talking top priority, code red-wandering around the Pale Heart. We can't call in the big guns for this one. Gotta keep it quiet. So how's about you, me, and Crow go track it down and take it out? Quietly, remember."


All right. Nothing suspicious about this at all.

entries.quote: Your reputation in the Crucible precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

Hey Guardian,



        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

entries.quote:
Hey Guardian



        How's Io this time of year? Still crawling with Taken? Lovely.

Hey, Guardian, good job!



        Say hi to Ana Bray for me. Wait, don't do that. I think I owe her some Glimmer…

entries.quote:
Hey Guardian.



        Back from Nessus? I guess that means you didn't get caught in an infinite teleportation loop. Well, good for you.

entries.title: Flashpoint: Titan
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
Hey Guardian.



        Nice work on Titan. Might want to hit the showers, though. I'm picking up the distinct odor of soggy Hive shells.
