entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-so here I am again, back in the EDZ. I know, I know. I said I would leave the Shard alone, but there is something about it. I am not the type that goes fishing for answers, but it feels like this place holds them. Like the Traveler is trying to tell us something. Ahh, what am I talking about, its probably just all those Arc storms messing with my insides-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
I should've paid more attention to you, Ikora. My brain usually checks out when the words have more than three syllables. Who would've known you can't shoot your way out of a Vex teleporter? When I get out of this mess whaddya say you lay some Vex schooling on me?


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-This Ishtar gig is pretty wild, even for a lughead like me. Get it, Ace. Lughead. Come on. I'm trying. I'll get some better jokes, I promise. I knew I was here to secure some top-secret thing in the jungle, but I saw it today. They dug up the remains of a technological civilization that actually predates humanity. Don't tell anyone I told you, or you know, could be wipesville again.-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-I've tried everything, Ace. Tried re-rigging my Ghost's shell every which way, making a deal with Variks for one of his captured Ghosts, even thought about following Ikora to Io, then it hit me. I can end this real quick by hopping right on Gary's ship via some Vex trickery. So here I am. Nessus, my own little Vex playground. Here goes nothing-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-Things are even weirder now, Ace. This is my fourth assignment, and I am kind of losing touch with what came before this whole Exo thing and what's a leftover fragment from another tour. I knew this would have had its kinks; I guess this is one of them. You know me, I didn't bother reading the fine print, or anything. At least I know, you're real, right?-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote: Planet X Story 4 Vendor Flavor Text

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-Here's the skinny, Ace, never trust the Awoken. The Reef type. The ones back on Earth, they're ok. But if you ever find yourself washed up in the Reef, keep your distance. They play by a whole other set of rules, like they want to be untrusted. And whatever you do, do not stare into their eyes-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-couldn't tell you what it was, Ace, but it was trying to seize control of me, like I was nothing but circuits and steel. Didn't know who it was messing with. I guess the moral of that story is never fall asleep near anything marked with that symbol-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-what can I say, I was just in too deep, Ace. I had to do something. For your sake, above all. I had lost any hope of cashing in, and to be honest, that big payday wasn't coming, not with the jobs I was finding, so when I got word of what was going on out there-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-This has been fun, I guess. But it will all be gone tomorrow. I have been what they call "compromised," which is funny because I feel fine. Could use a few upgrades, but what Exo couldn't. But "compromised" means they are going inside my brain to wipe it from my memory. Met an interesting fellow Exo who leaves letters like this in caches, so whatever she gets saddled with next, she might come across one and take a trip down "lost memory lane." Ace, know that when I find you, I will never let them find me-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote: Eden Story 4 Vendor Flavor Text

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-and if you see Satomi, make sure she knows the deal. Speaker thinks he's onto something, and those Arcstriders know every Dead Zone. And Cayde, don't make me remind you again. You lost fair and square. When you come back, this seat is yours. 


Your old pal and soon-to-be-relieved boss,


-Andal

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-so there you have it, Ace, that's why I did what I did. I had no choice, really. It was that or the great beyond. Just know your dad did what he had to do if I ever wanted to see you and your mother again. You probably won't recognize me, since I'll be, well, a robot and all, but I'll find you, I promise-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-I know, it's hard to believe. Someone with a sense of humor even more beloved than mine. But that's Sagira for you. I gotta say, Ace, I don't know what her secret is. To be attached to a blowhard like Osiris for that many years and not lose your smile? Pretty impressive. Some days it feels like I'm Zavala's Ghost. Chained to him like I'm a magnificent sailing vessel and he's a frowny blue anchor. And-


-From the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-what can I say, Ace, you should've seen me. I got each and every one of them out of there. That gang of Fallen raiders, gone, courtesy of yours truly. I can get used to this superhero stuff. Even got a few big wet ones from these really cute twins. DO NOT tell your mother-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote: EDZ Story 4 Vendor Flavor Text

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote: Fleet Story 4 Vendor Flavor Text

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-Gotcha, Tevis! You scoundrel. Caught you red-handed! I knew it as soon as I saw that Ice Breaker on your back. I know where I left it and I saw those awful etchings you can't help but carve into trees. So put it back and walk away from this one, and whatever you do, DO NOT read my notes. Well, read this one but that's it! Nothing else!-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-so I thought the Reef would hold some answers for me. They've got some kind of Queen out there who knows things. But getting to her is proving to be quite the jaunt. She's got me chasing Vex all across the system looking for something called the Vault of Glass. Whaddya say, Ace, ever heard of it?-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-Whatever's going on down there, Ace, they don't want folks to know about it. But that's the job, so I'll do whatever it takes to find out. Might need a disguise. Hmm? Any ideas, Ace? Ooh! I know! How about a mustache?-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-Here's the truth, Ace. I don't remember you. Found your name in a journal I had on me when my Ghost rezzed me. I guess I used to write to you? And I kept doing it. Even though you're long dead, if you ever really existed. Just liked having someone to write to, I guess. So there you have it. Now, you'll never guess what happened today, Ace-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Patrols
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
Hey there, Guardian.



        With the patrol network back online, the Vanguard can monitor enemy activity across the system and dispatch Guardians to where they are needed most. 


Each week, complete public events on the Flashpoint world to earn valuable rewards.

entries.title: Patrols
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
Hey there, Guardian.



        With the Vanguard reunited, Zavala has prioritized re-establishing a network of patrol beacons to coordinate Guardian efforts across the system. He gave this task to Cayde-6, who would totally do it, except he has a bunch of other really important things going on. Vanguard things. So, you know. It falls to you. 


Travel to the European Dead Zone and complete the "Importance of Networking" activity.

entries.title: Patrols
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
With the patrol network back online, the Vanguard can monitor enemy activity across the system and dispatch Guardians to where they are needed most. 


Each week, complete public events on the Flashpoint world to earn valuable rewards.

entries.title: Patrols
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
With the Vanguard reunited, Zavala has prioritized re-establishing a network of patrol beacons to coordinate Guardian efforts across the system. He gave this task to Cayde-6, who would totally do it, except he has a bunch of other really important things going on. Vanguard things. So, you know. It falls to you. 


Travel to the European Dead Zone and complete the "Importance of Networking" activity.

entries.title: The Red War
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
Hi Guardian



        Cayde went on his lone adventure and came back with one revelation: adventures are better (and safer) shared with partners. He's itching to get back out there and dig up more trouble and treasure-and wants you to watch his back. 


Swing by Cayde's corner for more treasure-hunting with a dash of roguish charm.

entries.title: The Red War
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
Cayde went on his lone adventure and came back with one revelation: adventures are better (and safer) shared with partners. He's itching to get back out there and dig up more trouble and treasure-and wants you to watch his back. 


Swing by Cayde's corner for more treasure-hunting with a dash of roguish charm.

entries.title: Unnamed Interaction
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
Hey Guardian,



        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

entries.title: Wild Card
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
Cayde hears your approach and turns to you. He's holding a sniper rifle. While familiar in shape, its design certainly feels like Cayde has had his hands on it. He offers it to you.


"You didn't think I'd give Crow something and not cook up something for you too, right? Come onnnn," he says. "He got a shiny new cloak and, potentially, crushing responsibility. It's only fair that you get a new gun courtesy of yours truly."


Cayde crosses his arms and considers you for a moment. It feels as though the quiet is intentional, appreciating your presence, until he nods his head and pulls himself back to reality.


"It was nice gettin' into trouble with you again," he says, words laced with sincerity that lingers despite how quickly he tries to move on.


"Now, I've gotta go figure out how to get the rest of this Screeb juice out of my clothes before the big battle." Cayde sniffs his cloak, still rancid from the Screeb slime, and recoils. He whispers, "…At this point, I might just burn 'em."

entries.title: A Guardian Rises
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"I see you've finished your rounds. These people are invaluable resources for your journey as a Guardian. You would do well to remember that as you take your next steps.


"Speaking of which, I have your first assignment. Shaw has successfully tracked down Navôta in the Cosmodrome; I'm authorizing a strike operation to eliminate her, and I want you to on it.


"Navôta is responsible for the death of two fellow Guardians. We cannot allow her to cull any more from our ranks. I'm trusting you and Shaw to get the job done.


"Good luck, Guardian."

entries.title: A Guardian Rises
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala welcomes you to your new home: the Last City.


He encourages you to continue meeting the residents of the Tower and informs you that there's a gift waiting for you in his office.

entries.title: A Guardian Rises
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"I see you've finished your rounds. These people are invaluable resources for your journey as a Guardian. You would do well to remember that as you take your next steps.


"Speaking of which, I have your first assignment. Shaw has successfully tracked down Navôta in the Cosmodrome; I'm authorizing a strike operation to eliminate her, and I want you two on it.


"Navôta is responsible for the death of two fellow Guardians. We cannot allow her to cull any more from our ranks. I'm trusting you and Shaw to get the job done.


"Good luck, Guardian."

entries.title: A Guardian Rises
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala offers a small smile. "I hope you found the Tower accommodating."


His eyes harden. "I've got news. The Hive Wizard you and Shaw were pursuing-we've pinpointed her location in the Cosmodrome. If you're able and willing, we need a Guardian on the ground. Shaw offered to run support."


"Accept this mission, and you're in. You fly your first strike as a Guardian. Eyes up."

entries.title: A Looming Threat
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Ana believes Rasputin can help destroy the Almighty before it hits the City. He's reluctant to trust the Warmind, but asks you to go to Mars to speak with Ana.

entries.title: A New Tradition
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Welcome, Guardian," Zavala says as you approach. "My friend Eva Levante was kind enough to remind me that, even in times of crisis, people need levity and Light.


"And so I've proposed a new holiday: the Guardian Games. This is an opportunity for Titans, Warlocks, and Hunters to compete and demonstrate their unique strengths."


He hands you a piece of gear. "Wear this proudly. It will help you contribute to your class's score." He smiles. "And good luck, Guardian."

entries.title: A Spark of Hope
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Exemplary work, Guardian. Strikes are an important component in our defense of humanity. As of now, I'm approving you for our full range of strike protocols; we're always in need of more fireteams ready to take the fight to the enemy's door."


Zavala holds one hand against the other palm.


"There are other matters at hand, however. We've analyzed the superconductor, and it's exactly what we hoped for. We believe it can be used to reconstruct a powerful Arc weapon; a salvaged piece of Golden Age technology."


"Ikora led the research efforts; she's waiting for you now. Good luck."

entries.title: A Spark of Hope
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Riskrunner suits you, Guardian. I had planned to add it to the Tower's vault, but based on your performance, I think the only suitable place for it is in your hands.


"Weapons like this are the backbone of our arsenal. As you continue your journey, you would be wise to seek out other remarkable assets.


"Only by combining our Light with the most powerful of armaments can we hope to succeed against the forces of Darkness. Remember that, Guardian."

entries.title: A Spark of Hope
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Riskrunner suits you, Guardian. I had planned to add it to the Tower's vault, but based on your performance, I think the only suitable place for it is in your hands.


"Weapons like this are the backbone of our arsenal. As you continue your journey, you would be wise to seek out other remarkable assets.


"Only by combining our Light with the most powerful of armaments can we hope to succeed against the enemies of humanity. Remember that, Guardian."

entries.title: A Spark of Hope
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Exemplary work, Guardian. Strikes are an important component in our defense of humanity. As of now, I'm approving you for our full range of strike protocols; we're always in need of more fireteams ready to take the fight to the enemy's door."


Zavala holds one hand against the other palm.


"Now it's time for you to commemorate your success. You're ready for the next Guardian Rank. The ceremony starts at the tree behind you."


Zavala smiles.


"Don't delay."

entries.title: A Spark of Hope
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala's gaze is weighty, a mixture of pride, worry, and hope.


"Congratulations on reaching the second Guardian Rank. If you ever lack clarity on what to do next, the Ranks offer constructive guidance."


"There are two important tasks ahead of you. First, the superconducter. Completed analysis tells us it's exactly what we hoped for. We believe it can be used to reconstruct a powerful Arc weapon; a salvaged piece of Golden Age technology."


"Ikora Rey led the research efforts; she'll brief you on the specifics."

entries.title: All Clear
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Shock tactics are an important tool for the Vanguard," Zavala says. "The aural and optical devastation of a large ordnance provides a significant tactical advantage and wreaks havoc on enemy morale. Further, while I'm glad to have the comms channels free of such bombast…"


A hint of a smile flashes across his face.


"…even I'll admit the experience is satisfying. Take this, Guardian, and make sure they get your message."

entries.title: At Your Fingertips
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Upon Osiris's request, I've cleared you for more outings. He seems to think there are additional Foundry relics aboard that derelict that could enhance your rifle."


Zavala rests his chin on his knuckles. "I'm more concerned with these experiments Calus was conducting. If they were able to coax a response from the Darkness… Gather all the intel you can, and if you recover something useful, all the better."

entries.title: At Your Fingertips
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Caiatl assisted your investigation? It seems our enemies can be reasonable when they choose… or when it benefits them."


"If she wants to divulge intelligence let her, but keep your knowledge close to your chest."


"That piece you brought back. It… looks like an oddity."

entries.title: Balistraria Wrap
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Well done," Zavala says. "I wish all our Guardians could be as accurate as you."


With measured, ceremonial movements, he wraps a Vanguard banner around your rifle.


"Display this with pride," he says.

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Well done, Guardian." Zavala nods appreciatively. "Now that you're up to speed, challenge yourself with some more dangerous foes."


"Practice all week," he advises, "because during the weekends, you'll be able to earn high scores that will grant you rewards and buffs for the following week."


"We'll use a different operation to test you each week, so you'll have time to prepare your tactics. Keep track of your scores as you go," he concludes, "and show the whole Tower what you're made of."

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"I'm glad you're joining the Guardian Games this year," Zavala greets you. "It's important to stay sharp, even when we're enjoying ourselves."


"To that end," he continues, "we've instituted a new way to track your accomplishments. You can now earn Vanguard Medals, which specifically track your achievements during those missions." 


"Remember: Guardian Games is not just about representing yourself or your class." The commander crosses his arms across his broad chest. "It's about honing our skills to become the best Guardians we can be."

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:

"Practice all week," he advises, "because during the weekends, you'll be able to earn high scores that will grant you rewards and buffs for the following week."


"We'll use a different operation to test you each week, so you'll have time to prepare your tactics. Keep track of your scores as you go," he concludes, "and show the whole Tower what you're made of."

entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:

"To that end," he continues, "we've instituted a new way to track your accomplishments. You can now earn Vanguard Medals, which specifically track your achievements during those missions." 


"Remember: Guardian Games is not just about representing yourself or your class." The commander crosses his arms across his broad chest. "It's about honing our skills to become the best Guardians we can be."

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Guardian. Good to see you participating in the Guardian Games." Zavala nods approvingly. "At times like these, we could all use a reprieve." 


"We'll be arranging different missions for you each week. This year, I leave it to you to decide how much of a challenge you're up for." He smiles knowingly. "Perform well and you'll win the right to light the ceremonial torches in the tower. Eva's set aside some interesting prizes."


Zavala's expression grows serious. "These Games have always been a means for Guardians to demonstrate their discipline. Their mastery of Light… and Dark." 


"But they also serve to remind the people of the City that we're here for them. That they can believe in us. Do them proud, Guardian."

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Guardian. I'm glad to see you joining your fellow Lightbearers in this year's Games." Zavala is solemn despite the cheerful decorations surrounding him.


"Eva has outdone herself this year to make sure the Games are an event to remember.  Perform well and you'll win the right to light the ceremonial torches in the Tower. Along with a year's worth of bragging rights, as Eva would like me to remind you."


Zavala looks to the empty skyline. "The Witness is coming. We cannot forget the threat hanging over us. But the Guardian Games are just what we need: a test of discipline, a reminder of our strength, a celebration of who we are."


"We have faced the worst. We have not faltered yet." He nods to you. "And we won't. Get out there, Guardian. Show us your mettle… and have some fun."

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Eva has outdone herself this year to make sure the Games are an event to remember. Perform well, and you'll win the right to light the ceremonial torches in the Tower. Along with a year's worth of bragging rights, as Eva would like me to remind you."


"There is a new challenge for you to overcome: Rushdown. Here's what you need to know." Zavala hands you a missive that reads:


RUSHDOWN
• Guardians are tasked with defeating 5 powerful combatants before the timer runs out.
• Each combatant defeated will increase the difficulty of combat.
• Guardians earn points by progressing quickly to reach higher score thresholds.
• Each day, there is a new combination of 5 powerful combatants to overcome.

entries.title: Beyond Light
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Now that Eramis is defeated, the Vanguard hopes to reclaim Europa for humanity. Zavala asks your help in destabilizing what remains of House Salvation. He informs you that Variks will help guide you through your first mission: sabotaging a Fallen weapons factory on Europa.


Return to Variks on Europa for more details.

entries.title: Beyond Light
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"These are unprecedented times. The arrival of these… Pyramids could change everything," Zavala says, gazing at the Traveler. He turns to face you.


"And yet, it changes nothing about our responsibility as Guardians. Now more than ever, with the Darkness at our door, it's important to remember who we are. Protectors. Warriors. Symbols of hope for all humanity."


"I don't know what you'll find if you journey out into the unknown, and I can't stop you from going. But I implore you…"


He looks back towards the Traveler, his brow tensed.


"Hold fast to your Light, Guardian. It could be the only thing between us and destruction."

entries.title: Challenger's Proving VII
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Commander Zavala has informed you that you have been chosen to fight for the City aboard the Imperial Land Tank, the Halphas Electus, on Nessus. Caiatl has accepted the challenge. Zavala tells you to assemble your fireteam and bring Caiatl's champion to their knees. He reminds you that if Caiatl suffers defeat here, she will have no choice but to concede or risk humiliation.

entries.title: Challenger's Proving VII
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Commander Zavala looks you over and considers how much you've kept from him. He congratulates you, and celebrates a victorious City, but expresses a need for trust, for unity. He says that without those things the City could be destroyed from the inside like the Cabal were.

entries.title: Clarion Call: Titans
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Hey Guardian,



        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

entries.title: Clarion Call: Titans
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

entries.title: Closing Ceremony
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: "Wear your medals proudly. They've been earned against the best." -Eva Levante

entries.title: Commander Zaval-AAH!
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"The Festival of the Lost is a City-wide tradition," Zavala says. "Guardians see death differently than others do, but we all know loss. And that brings us together."


He smiles. "As does celebration. We remember the dead and celebrate the living, so enjoy yourself, Guardian."

entries.title: Commander Zavala
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala carries upon his shoulders the burden of guilt for the loss of the City. The truth is this was a wake-up call for all of humanity. It's time to shore up our defenses and take the fight to our enemies. 


Report back to Zavala for Nightfall and strike activities.

entries.title: Dawning Delivery
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala's expression is unreadable as he accepts the cookies, but he nods in recognition of the thoughtful gift.

entries.title: Dawning's Gift: Zavala
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala thanks you for the thoughtful gift, and begins squeezing it immediately. Forcefully.

entries.title: Defender of Light
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala is grateful that you defeated Kridis, but he now has other concerns. He believes that any compromise regarding the Darkness will only lead to disaster. Now that Eramis and her council are defeated, Guardians must no longer wield the Darkness. He hopes you'll respect this decision and help defend it. The people of the Last City need you now more than ever.

entries.title: Done and Done
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"When you achieve the success seen here today, it's not just a personal victory. It's a victory for us all. You ensure that the enemy knows we give no quarter."


Zavala offers a small nod of approval. "Take this and keep reminding them."

entries.title: Engram Tracker
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
A recorded message from Master Rahool plays when you pick up the engram tracker: 


"Guardian! This is a new device of my own manufacture. It will allow you to monitor the number of engrams available at each of the vendors in the Tower."


"If you ever lose it, you can pick up a new one from any of those vendors. I look forward to seeing you deploy this device."

entries.title: Exodus: Evacuation
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala looks over the City. "Preparing for battle across four fronts… we're spread too thin," he says quietly.


"As of now, our plan changes from preparation to evacuation."


He takes a measured breath. For a moment, he looks old.


"Sloane asked whether we could spare a Vanguard ship to relocate important cargo. Coming from her, that's a full-on distress call. Head to Titan, help her tie up loose ends, and bring her home."


"I have also been in contact with Asher Mir on Io. He insists the data he's gathering is too important to abandon. Of course, his phrasing was a bit more colorful."


You nod.


"Thank you, Guardian," he says reflexively. It's clear his mind is far away.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Complete strikes and challenges to get Vanguard Tactician tokens and earn Level 20 rewards from Commander Zavala.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Your reputation in the Vanguard war effort precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Your reputation in the Crucible precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Complete bounties for XP and undertake quests for valuable gear. Completing strikes grants you tokens, which can be turned in here for packages.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Complete strikes and Battlegrounds. Earn armor and weapons at each rank, and powerful upgrades at major ranks.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Complete Vanguard Ops. Earn armor and weapons at each rank, and powerful upgrades at major ranks.

entries.title: Final Dawn
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala's gaze is transfixed on the empty space where the Traveler once hung in the sky.


"For a moment," he says quietly, "I thought my greatest fear had become reality. That the Traveler had decided to leave us to fend for ourselves."


He turns to face you, a look of tired relief in his eyes. "But in that moment, I also had another thought."


Gesturing broadly to the City, Zavala casts his eyes upward once more. "The last time I saw Cabal ships in the sky over the City, I looked to the Traveler to save us. But now? Cabal, Eliksni, Awoken… our allies have rallied to us. We look to each other, instead."


Zavala rolls his shoulders, then squares them to the challenge ahead. "In the wake of Rasputin's sacrifice, the Wrathborn have begun pulling back their forces. But I can't shake the feeling that they're just making way for an even greater threat."


When he looks at you again, it is with steel in his eyes. "Whatever the Traveler's intentions, it chose to stay with us. Just as we have chosen to stand together."

entries.title: Forsaken
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala doesn't have the luxury of revenge. He has the City to think of. He won't give you his blessing as you head to the Tangled Shore in mission "High Plains Blues."

entries.title: Forsaken
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: You got the revenge you wanted, but Commander Zavala reminds you of what you risked to do so. Uldren's death will have consequences. Of that Zavala is sure.

entries.title: Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: "It's all fun and games until somebody loses a bet." -Prak'kesh

entries.title: Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: "Congratulations on your performance in this year's Guardian Games. You should be proud of your accomplishments, regardless of the outcome. It's time to honor all of our classes and celebrate their achievements. Visit the podium to see the results of this year's competition." -Commander Zavala

entries.title: Heroic Strikes
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Commander Zavala has prepared a list of priority targets for strike operations. 


Join other Guardians and complete strikes to take down powerful foes and earn rewards.

entries.title: Heroic Strikes
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala congratulates you on your performance in strikes-and offers a reward fit for such a heroic effort.

entries.title: Holding Patterns
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Commander Zavala gives you a weary wave as you approach. 


"Guardian, I'm glad to hear that your siege-breaking operation is a success. Every member of the Witness's forces you defeat on Earth may well be one less we'll face on the other side of that portal." He gestures broadly toward the sky. 


"That's especially important because we won't be able to bring all our forces through at once. It will be all we can to just to keep the portal stabilized. We'll need to begin the assault with a small advance team-and you'll be the tip of the spear."


He lets out a frustrated sigh. "Unfortunately, until then there's little left to do but wait."


"I've never had Saladin's patience. Or Shaxx's… raw instinct."


"For a Titan like me, the calm before the storm is anything but." His attention is caught by a strident signal on his datapad. Another high-priority report, no doubt.


He gives you a brief nod. "Go get some rest, Guardian. You'll need it."

entries.title: In Rides a Pale Horse
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Guardian, there's something I'd like you to retrieve from the Vanguard vault. We've been storing certain high-value weapons here since losing our vaults during the Red War. The Cabal seek to destroy us with the Almighty. I want to send them a message, and I have the perfect delivery method. Take this keycard to the vault."


Before you can take the keycard, Zavala pulls it back.


"You'll have to go through my office to access it. I normally do not allow Guardians in there, so I'm trusting you not to disrupt any of my… personal effects. Grab the weapon and come back to me."

entries.title: Increase Reputation
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Show Zavala proof of your deeds in the Vanguard war effort.

entries.title: Legacy: Beyond Light
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Now that Eramis is defeated, the Vanguard hopes to reclaim Europa for humanity. Zavala asks your help in destabilizing what remains of House Salvation. He informs you that Variks will help guide you through your first mission: sabotaging a Fallen weapons factory on Europa.


Return to Variks on Europa for more details.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"A hollow man… leading others to die… for a silent god."


Zavala's failure to complete the ritual of severance has shaken him to the core of his faith. The Nightmare that haunts him-Safiyah-is unknown to the Vanguard, yet has great power over his heart.


"She wants me to speak her name… To confide my feelings in you. What good does it do?"


"Go and see Eris. I'll tell her you're coming. She'll know what to say."


Travel to the H.E.L.M. and see what Eris knows.

entries.title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving VII
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Commander Zavala looks you over and considers how much you've kept from him. He congratulates you, and celebrates a victorious City, but expresses a need for trust, for unity. He says that without those things the City could be destroyed from the inside like the Cabal were.

entries.title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving VII
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Commander Zavala has informed you that you have been chosen to fight for the City aboard the Imperial Land Tank, the Halphas Electus, on Nessus. Caiatl has accepted the challenge. Zavala tells you to assemble your fireteam and bring Caiatl's champion to their knees. He reminds you that if Caiatl suffers defeat here, she will have no choice but to concede or risk humiliation.

entries.title: Legacy: Forsaken
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala doesn't have the luxury of revenge. He has the City to think of. He won't give you his blessing as you head to the Tangled Shore in mission "High Plains Blues."

entries.title: Legacy: Forsaken
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: You got the revenge you wanted, but Commander Zavala reminds you of what you risked to do so. Uldren's death will have consequences. Of that Zavala is sure.

entries.title: Legacy: HIGH ALERT: ANOMALY DETECTED - H.E.L.M.
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala sees you coming and steps forward to meet you.  "I heard."


He exhales slowly. "Calus's plans are foiled-his vessel stranded without a heartbeat above the Moon." He shakes his head. "I'm not sure how he projected himself into the H.E.L.M., but it was the same here, over the homes of the people we protect."


His brow furrows with focus. "Only a coward terrorizes innocents."


Zavala looks you dead in the eyes. "Calus, and this… Witness think they can intimidate us. It's always the ones who claim to be invincible that crack first, and they've just challenged every Guardian in the system."


"Another conflict on the horizon. I can't say I'm eager to meet it, but if it's in defense of our citizens… not the Traveler, not the Light, but for the people behind our walls… we'll be ready."

entries.title: Legacy: Last Will and Testament
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Commander Zavala hands you a handwritten note from Amanda Holliday:


"Guardian-


If you're reading this, then I guess I'm not 'round the Hangar anymore. 


"I hope I went out on a mission, not by getting run over by some New Light figuring out how their landing gear works.


"Either way, I'm leaving you my personal ship. She's seen me through a lot of scrapes, and I know you'll take good care of each other. 


"I've always been bad at goodbyes, so instead, I'll just say… give 'em hell, Guardian. 


-Amanda"

entries.title: Legacy: Lightfall
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"We stand alongside more friends than ever before." The Humans of Neomuna are just as much included in that as those of the Last City. They have stood fast on the front lines of this conflict, and because of them, the Last City has been saved from more violence at its doorstep.


It isn't everything, but that thin line has made a huge difference.


"Now, I look up and see the hope we've built for ourselves." There is a gentle awe in the way Zavala regards the sky: the fleets of ships, the symbols of allies of the Last City. The Vanguard is no longer one last bastion against the Witness, but one of many.


Even without the Traveler, we are not alone.


And we'll need all the allies we can get. This war is far from over. Ikora has been in contact with Osiris regarding the mysteries yet unsolved. Visit her to learn more.

entries.title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
No need to waver, Guardian. The Vanguard stands behind you every step of the way.


The Light is our strength. The Darkness will never take that from us. 


Fight on.

entries.title: Lightfall
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"So much has changed." Zavala stares into the space where the Traveler once hung.


"I once stood here to gaze at the savior of humanity, our only hope. Now that hope is gone from my sight.


"But I see something in its place. I see the fruits of alliance, I see the tenacity of our people, I see a fighting chance.


"So as the Witness plagues our skies…


"Fight, Guardian. Fight."

entries.title: Loaded Question
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala congratulates you on your dedication to fighting the biggest threats to humanity, and he gives you a reward worthy of your heroism.

entries.title: Making an Impact
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Making an Impact



        For Zavala, trust once broken is not easily mended. But if you continue to put the effort into repairing this relationship, so will he.

entries.title: Making an Impact
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Making an Impact



        The City's defense falls on Zavala's shoulders, and Zavala needs proof that he can count on you to fight with the Vanguard.


Prove your dedication to the Vanguard by completing a strike wearing a full set of Vanguard armor.

entries.title: Meet Commander Zavala
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Welcome to the Tower, Guardian. I am Commander Zavala. I, and every citizen of the Last City, need your help."


Commander Zavala is the leader of the Vanguard. He offers bounties, pursuits, and special rewards for challenges in strike activities.


Hover over the quest icon below and select it with .


ACQUIRE QUEST

entries.title: Meet with Zavala
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
The perpetually concerned look on Zavala's face lifts briefly as you approach.


"I see that your recent victories haven't dulled your edge. You're still pushing yourself to get better every day-an example I hope our New Lights follow."


"It's easy lose ourselves in the heady cosmic concerns that threaten the City, but in the heat of battle, a Guardian is only as good as their training."


He nods appreciatively at your battle-worn armor. "And I rest easy knowing that nobody trains harder than you."

entries.title: Meet with Zavala
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala looks exhausted, but alert. He hails you warmly as you approach.


"It's important that everyone in the Tower sees you training so fiercely. Your legend now exceeds even my own. Everyone looks up to you - both civilians and Lightbearers alike."


"You may not be a member of the Vanguard, but you set the tone for the Tower. Your work in the field is the realization of all of our efforts, right down to the sweeper bots."


"Thank you for taking your role, and our safety, as seriously as you do."

entries.title: Missing in Action
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Stolen? No one outside of the Vanguard should have access to the vault, let alone revoke our access. If this is a breach, we will need to boost security measures considerably. While we were looking up to the sky, someone snuck in right under our noses."


Zavala rubs his chin, pensively.


"I want answers and I want that weapon recovered. I know of some BrayTech equipment that can help us track it down. Go see Ana on Mars."

entries.title: Nightfall
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Hi Guardian.



        The City has been liberated, but threats to our survival remain. Zavala has authorized the Nightfall protocol to dispatch elite Guardian fireteams for surgical strikes against the greatest of these threats. 


Each week, assemble your fireteam and complete the Nightfall strike to earn valuable rewards.

entries.title: Nightfall
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Hey there Guardian.



        The Nightfall protocol is authorized only in the event of an imminent threat to the City. Thanks to you, that threat is ended.

entries.title: Nightfall
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
The City has been liberated, but threats to our survival remain. Zavala has authorized the Nightfall protocol to dispatch elite Guardian fireteams for surgical strikes against the greatest of these threats. 


Each week, assemble your fireteam and complete the Nightfall strike to earn valuable rewards.

entries.title: Nightfall
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: The Nightfall protocol is authorized only in the event of an imminent threat to the City. Thanks to you, that threat is ended.

entries.title: Nightfall
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"You have stood against every foe and driven them to break. A commendable effort, Guardian. One that does not go unnoticed.


"I assume you've heard the people recounting your deeds throughout the City? You command their respect, and hold their hope. They look to you as the first who will stand against the coming tide. I know you will not fail them. Carry on." -Commander Zavala

entries.title: Nightfall
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Commander Zavala straightens his stance and meets your eyes directly. "I've heard of your… adventures." His shoulders relax. "Impeccable work, Guardian. You've transcended our expectations yet again."


Zavala buries a prideful smile. "However, there is always more work to be done. Remain on the fireteam, and remain vigilant. Carry on."

entries.title: Nightfall: The Ordeal
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Commander Zavala straightens his stance and meets your eyes directly. "I've heard of your… adventures." His shoulders relax. "Impeccable work, Guardian. You've transcended our expectations yet again."

entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:

entries.title: On the Offensive
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Rahool once told me of an ancient Earth idiom: the best defense is a good offense. I've found it to be lasting advice.


"We cannot hide behind the City walls forever. It's important that we strike out and take the fight to our enemies, not only to remind them of our strength… but also to remind ourselves.


"The solar system once belonged to humanity. If we ever want that to be true again, we must continue to run strikes against our enemies.


"I look forward to hearing about your future successes, Guardian."

entries.title: On the Offensive
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: "Your Light has grown, Guardian, and it is time you put it to the test in Vanguard Operations. I know we can count on you to keep the Last City safe." -Commander Zavala

entries.title: Raising Our Defenses
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Travel to Mars to speak to Ana about Rasputin.

entries.title: Reach Level 20
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Increase your level to claim these rewards.

entries.title: Redeployment
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Redeployment



        With a quiet kind of ceremony, Zavala presents you with your reward: a new Oxygen SR3.


"Carry it proudly," he tells you.

entries.title: Renegades
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala greets you with a grim but hopeful smile. "I'm impressed. You've more than proven yourself worthy of the Guardian title… I wish I could tell you it gets easier from here." 


He turns and looks out at the Last City below. "Humanity needs our help now more than ever, and we need Guardians like you on the front line." 


"Right now, that front line is Drifter's ship, the Derelict. He's operating outside the Vanguard's mandate… but he needs help."


"Aunor is leading the charge, and she's requesting your assistance. Help her keep the Drifter out of trouble, if such a thing is even possible."

entries.title: Renegades
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala has called us to answer for our actions, but he seems reluctant to restrict your off-world activities.

entries.title: Report to Zavala
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"How are the evacuations proceeding?"


The commander doesn't wait for an answer, as though he already knows. He speaks with single-minded purpose.


"On Mars, Ana Bray believes she can salvage part of Rasputin. I hope she's right. Help her, then get her off-world safely."


"I've also received strange messages from Vance about being drawn to the Infinite Forest. This isn't the time for a pilgrimage. Bring him back to the Tower."


"Help them understand-help them all understand," Zavala says and sets his jaw. "We don't leave people behind."

entries.title: Report to Zavala
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"The Darkness is pushing deeper into our territory," Zavala intones gravely. The air around him crackles with energy.


"Mars. Tell Ana Bray what we've learned about the Pyramids so far. Help her defend against the creatures they draw."


"Then I need you on Mercury. Vance is in the Lighthouse there and needs to be brought up to speed. The Infinite Forest has strategic value but is not our top priority."


The air is suddenly still. Zavala speaks softly, almost to himself.


"There's so much we can't afford to lose."

entries.title: Report to Zavala
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Without another word, Zavala hands you a weapon.

entries.title: Return to Zavala
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
You bring your collected reports to Zavala. He looks them over slowly, one entry at a time.


"Give Sloane the time she needs to come up with her plan," he says. "She's the best there is."


"Asher, on the other hand… his theories had better produce results-and quickly."


"Ana thinks some part of Rasputin survived? I hope she's right, for all our sakes."


"Vance's reaction is… troubling. We need him clearheaded. Fanaticism is a luxury we cannot afford."


"Our territories are holding together," Zavala says, but the tension doesn't leave his face. "Continue to aid them in any way you can."


"Thank you," he says, and turns back to the Traveler.

entries.title: Rite of Dawning
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
The commander greets you with an uncharacteristic smile. "I just received a message from Caiatl," he says. "She received the gifts you brought her."


"She said that, in the old times, the vestments were worn over battlescarred armor, the wine was justly taken from those defending it, and the humble cup reminded those gathered that opulence was no better than moderation. It was a tradition her father did not practice, but one carried out by the elders she respected."


Zavala's eyes soften. "Thanks to you, she was able to perform that ritual with those close to her. You honored her, and our alliance is stronger for it."


"You did a wonderful thing this Dawning, Guardian," he says. "You should have the pleasure of telling Eva that her plan was a success."

entries.title: Rite of Dawning
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"You've amassed quite a collection of Cabal artifacts," Zavala says as he admires the vestments, cup, and wine. "These will surely remind Caiatl of the traditions she left behind when she came here. But there is one final step I'd like to ask of you."


"In Cabal culture, gifts are most meaningful if the giver has overcome great hardship to deliver them. I'd like Caiatl to know how much we value her as an ally."


Zavala levels a look at you. He almost sounds guilty when he speaks: "I must ask you to enter Caiatl's Land Tank and defeat her champion Ignovun in the Rite of Proving. Leave the ceremonial objects behind when you leave-Caiatl will understand their significance."


Zavala places a hand on your shoulder. "Thank you for this, Guardian. I know it's not easy, but you'll be showing someone how important she is by respecting her traditions this Dawning, and that's a great kindness."


"Now get out there and kill Ignovun."

entries.title: Rite of Dawning
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Commander Zavala raises an eyebrow as you explain Eva's plan.


"Frankly, Eva may have a point," he says. "We could welcome Caiatl to the Tower and celebrate the Dawning here, with all of us."


He stops briefly to watch two Guardians near the Postmaster. They pelt one another with snowballs before launching themselves over the railing and falling to their deaths. Their Ghosts patiently resurrect them where they stood. The Guardians laugh and break briefly into dance before charging off toward the Crucible.


"On the other hand, our Dawning traditions may be strange to an outsider," Zavala muses.


He claps his hands. "Very well. Let's do something for the empress. The Cabal homeworld was ravaged by the Hive, but perhaps we could bring some of its magic back to them this year."


"Head down to the EDZ and see if you can find some intel on Cabal celebrations. I'd ask Caiatl personally, but…"


He smiles. "…wouldn't it be better if it was a surprise?"

entries.title: Season 5: Nightshade
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala recognizes your devotion to completing Vanguard bounties and rewards you with a weapon worthy of that hard work.

entries.title: Strike Salvager
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: "Well done, Guardian. We conduct strikes in this manner not only to keep and hone our own skillsets, but also to create… memorable defeats for our enemies." Zavala smiles. "Their stories of our might are just as powerful as the weapons we wield against them. Leaving an impression can dissuade future aggressions. Any battle we don't have to fight is a good one-and, of course, to the victor go the spoils. Enjoy."

entries.title: Strikes
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Hey Guardian



        For exemplary performance in the completion of Vanguard Strikes.

entries.title: Strikes
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Hi Guardian.



        Zavala has resumed his duties as commander of the Vanguard. He has prepared a list of priority targets for Strike operations. 


Join other Guardians and complete Strikes to take down powerful foes and earn rewards.

entries.title: Strikes
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: For exemplary performance in the completion of Vanguard Strikes.

entries.title: Strikes
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala has resumed his duties as commander of the Vanguard. He has prepared a list of priority targets for Strike operations. 


Join other Guardians and complete Strikes to take down powerful foes and earn rewards.

entries.title: Strikes Challenges
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Hi Guardian.



        The City is a little safer today, thanks to you.

entries.title: Strikes Challenges
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: The City is a little safer today, thanks to you.

entries.title: Summons from Zavala
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala looks over the City. "Preparing for battle across four fronts… we're spread too thin," he says quietly.


"As of now, our plan changes from preparation to evacuation."


He takes a measured breath. For a moment, he looks old.


"Sloane asked whether we could spare a Vanguard ship to relocate important cargo. Coming from her, that's a full-on distress call. Head to Titan, help her tie up loose ends, and bring her home."


"I have also been in contact with Asher Mir on Io. He insists the data he's gathering is too important to abandon. Of course, his phrasing was a bit more colorful."


You nod.


"Thank you, Guardian," he says reflexively. It's clear his mind is far away.

entries.title: The Cannibal
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala nods respectfully as you approach. His Ghost transmats a Grenade Launcher into his hands.


"This is the Wendigo, so-named for its monstrous hunger. Carry it with honor."

entries.title: The Edge of Fate
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala greets you with a grim but hopeful smile. "I'm impressed. You've more than proven yourself worthy of the Guardian title…. I wish I could tell you it gets easier from here." 


He turns and looks out at the Last City below. "Humanity needs our help now more than ever, and we need Guardians like you on the front line." 


"Right now, that front line lies somewhere out there in the mysterious space of Kepler." 


"Ikora is leading the charge and is requesting your assistance out there. She needs you."

entries.title: The Exodus Begins
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"The Pyramids are on our doorstep," Zavala says as you arrive. "Eris is researching the signals. Even the Drifter is helping, in his way."


There's no hesitation in his voice as the commander gives his orders.


"Eris made Io her base of operations, but she can't report on the surface while she's studying that tree. Meet up with Asher Mir. He should have some strong opinions about what to do next."


"Down on Titan, Sloane should be more pragmatic. She'll want to tear the ship from the sky with her bare hands."


You see a glint in his eyes. "See that she does."

entries.title: The Final Shape
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala greets you with a grim but hopeful smile, "I'm impressed. You've more than proven yourself worthy of the Guardian title…. I wish I could tell you it gets easier from here." 


He turns and looks out at the Last City below. "Humanity needs our help now more than ever, and we need Guardians like you on the front line."  


"Right now, that front line lies at the precipice of our very existence: the Pale Heart." 


"We've devised a way inside the Traveler to break the Witness's hold on it. We have only to take the next step forward."


He turns back to you, a spark of defiance in his eye, "It's time to face our greatest enemy head on. Join us."

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: "Enjoy the Games, Guardian. This is a chance for the people to see our passion for what we do." He lowers his voice. "And a chance for Titans to prove our mettle. Don't tell Ikora I said it, but the Warlocks are the ones to watch out for." He glances off toward the Bazaar. "Give them a fight they won't forget. Titans deserve a little time in the spotlight."

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala gazes toward the podium as you approach. "The Guardian Games were hard fought, but ultimately the Titans took the gold with shield and hammer." He's unable to hide the glint of pride in his eyes. "This is a victory for every Guardian. Titans may be on top right now, but the Warlocks and Hunters will work hard to make sure we don't stay there. That strengthens us all."


"Now if you'll excuse me, I need to prepare." The smile fades from Zavala's face. "Lord Shaxx is eager to celebrate our win in the 'traditional Titan way.'"

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala gazes toward the podium as you approach. "The Guardian Games were hard fought, but ultimately the Hunters took the gold with bow and blade." He shakes his head, unable to hide a small smile. "I may have been pulling for the Titans to bring us a victory, but when their backs are to the wall, count on Hunters to find a way every time."


"We all grow stronger together." Zavala adjusts his spaulders. "Next year my Titans will just have to grow a little more quickly."

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala gazes toward the podium as you approach. "The Guardian Games were hard fought, but ultimately the Warlocks took the gold with their finely honed powers." He glances down at his armor and rubs absently at a scuffed patch. "I would have preferred a Titan victory, but I can't say I'm surprised. Warlocks are true masters of the Light. They demand respect - and if it isn't given, they take it."


The ghost of a smile plays across Zavala's face. "Ikora taught me that. And I feel her Warlocks just taught their opponents the same lesson

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Welcome, Guardian," Zavala says as you approach. "My friend Eva Levante was kind enough to remind me that, even in times of crisis, people need levity and Light.


"And so I've proposed a new holiday: the Guardian Games. This is an opportunity for Titans, Warlocks, and Hunters to compete and demonstrate their unique strengths."


He hands you a piece of gear. "Wear this proudly. It will help you contribute to your class's score." He smiles. "And good luck, Guardian."

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Thanks to your hard work, we now have some time to breathe, and enjoy our successes.


"To that end, I've asked Eva Levante to bring back the Guardian Games. It will give Guardian of every class an opportunity to come together in camaraderie and competition. Talk to Eva to get started.


"Before you go, take this gear as a thanks from the Tower. Good luck in the Games, Guardian."

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Thanks to your hard work, we now have some time to breathe and enjoy our successes.


"To that end, I've asked Eva Levante to bring back the Guardian Games. It will give Guardians of every class an opportunity to come together in camaraderie and competition. Talk to Eva to get started.


"Before you go, take this gear as a thanks from the Vanguard. Good luck in the Games, Guardian."

entries.title: The Red War
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Hi Guardian



        Zavala carries upon his shoulders the burden of guilt for the loss of the City. The truth is this was a wake-up call for all of humanity. It's time to shore up our defenses and take the fight to our enemies. 


Report back to Zavala for Nightfall and strike activities.

entries.title: The Red War
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala carries upon his shoulders the burden of guilt for the loss of the City. The truth is this was a wake-up call for all of humanity. It's time to shore up our defenses and take the fight to our enemies. 


Report back to Zavala for Nightfall and strike activities.

entries.title: The Vanguard's Take
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
No need to waver, Guardian. The Vanguard stands behind you every step of the way.


The Light is our strength. The Darkness will never take that from us. 


Fight on.

entries.title: The Vex Offensive
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Speak with Zavala about the emerging Vex crisis on the Moon.



        Never a dull moment for the Vanguard. While Zavala orchestrates regular operations across the system and directs the fight to keep our hold on the Moon, he trusts you and Ikora to tackle the Vex crisis head-on.

entries.title: The Voice on the Other Side
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Tex Mechanica…" Zavala admires the rifle's craftsmanship. "This rifle was a custom craft. Its creation was never reported to the Vanguard."


After a moment of hesitation, Zavala holds out the rifle. "If it doesn't exist, then there's nothing to confiscate, so long as it's in good hands."


Zavala's smile fades as his face turns grim. "Your discoveries were troubling. Keep me informed of any developments."

entries.title: The Voice on the Other Side
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala looks grim as he considers the possibilities behind a new Guardian-coded distress beacon sounding off from the Reef, especially given that it's rooted in an encoded Loyalist signature used by Calus. He laments that the Vanguard can't immediately respond to every call for help, but fears Caiatl is already on her way to this one and wants you to investigate it personally.


Zavala says your Ghost forwarded the signal to Rahool when you found it, and he confirmed that the transmission itself has been tainted by some sort of Darkness radiation.


He urges you to be cautious, and informs you that Osiris will run command on your mission. He suggests you don't go alone.

entries.title: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"These are unprecedented times. The Witch Queen's machinations have left us ill at ease," Zavala says, gazing at the Traveler. He turns to face you.


"And yet, that changes nothing about our responsibility as Guardians. Now more than ever, shrouded in uncertainty, it's important to remember who we are. Protectors. Warriors. Symbols of hope for all of humanity."


"I do not know why Mars has returned, or why Savathûn is so keenly interested, but we must pursue the truth that lurks behind these questions."


He looks back towards the Traveler, his brow tensed.


"Mars beckons, Guardian. Will you heed the call?"

entries.title: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"These are unprecedented times. The Witch Queen's machinations have left us ill at ease," Zavala says, gazing at the Traveler. He turns to face you.


"And yet, that changes nothing about our responsibility as Guardians. Now more than ever, shrouded in uncertainty, it's important to remember who we are. Protectors. Warriors. Symbols of hope for all of humanity."


"I do not know why Mars has returned, or why Savathûn is so keenly interested, but we must pursue the truth that lurks behind these questions."


He looks back towards the Traveler, his brow tensed.


"Mars beckons, Guardian. Will you heed the call?"

entries.title: Unnamed Interaction
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Hey Guardian,



        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

entries.title: Unnamed Interaction
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala greets you. He seems pleased. "Another crisis laid low. You succeeded where Ana and I failed-and we are grateful. Past victories have driven the Cabal to dangerous measures, but I wouldn't have it any other way." The Commander nods. "It's time we turned the tide in this system. With you at the tip of the spear, I've come to believe anything's possible."

entries.title: Vanguard
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala doesn't have the luxury of revenge. He has the City to think of. He won't give you his blessing as you head to the Tangled Shore in mission "High Plains Blues."

entries.title: Vanguard
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: You got the revenge you wanted, but Commander Zavala reminds you of what you risked to do so. Uldren's death will have consequences. Of that Zavala is sure.

entries.title: Vanguard Service
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala nods approvingly as you approach.


"Excellent work, Guardian. Even smaller tasks play a big part in the Vanguard's operations. Your diligence sets a strong example for us all."

entries.title: Vanguard Vestments
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala nods to you as you approach.


"Banshee told me you might be headed this way," he says. "Something about championing the Vanguard in battle?" He looks down over the railing at the City, toward the Eliksni Quarter.


"Very well. In times like these, I think we could use a little positive representation."

entries.title: Vanguard Vestments
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"You have done well, Guardian. As I knew you would."


He shakes his head, but there is a faint smile on his face. "These days, when we can't even be sure the sun will rise, it's important to be able to count on something."


He hands you a weapon ornament.


"Thank you," he says.

entries.title: Victory Enduring
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala will never trust Rasputin, but for now he'll put his faith in Ana Bray. The future may be uncertain, but he is reassured knowing he has a Guardian he can trust. You have earned his praise by destroying Xol and saving Mars.

entries.title: Visit Commander Zavala
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Welcome back, Guardian. Your fight against the enemies at our gates has only just begun."


Return to Commander Zavala to acquire bounties, gear, and other rewards related to strike activities.

entries.title: Visit Commander Zavala
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Guardian… To hold off oblivion, we must be vigilant against the enemies who threaten our existence."


Vanguard bounties offer focused objectives for Guardians to complete while playing strike activities.


Select Vanguard bounties from Commander Zavala. Complete their objectives, then claim your completed bounties to gain XP and rewards.

entries.title: Warmind
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Warmind



        Zavala will never trust Rasputin, but for now he'll put his faith in Ana Bray. The future may be uncertain, but he is reassured knowing he has a Guardian he can trust. You have earned his praise by destroying Xol and saving Mars.

entries.title: Zavala
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Commander Zavala has heard of your success in saving Saint-14 from the Infinite Forest and wishes to thank you. Visit him in the Tower Courtyard.



        Zavala is amazed by your continuing ability to do the impossible. On behalf of the City, he thanks you for saving Saint-14. He also asks that you help Saint-14 adjust to his new life in the Tower however you can. He expects his return to the City will be a little overwhelming.

entries.title: Zavala Recruits
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"You have stood against every foe and driven them to break. A commendable effort, Guardian. One that does not go unnoticed.


"I assume you've heard the people recounting your deeds throughout the City? You command their respect, and hold their hope. They look to you as the first who will stand against the coming tide. I know you will not fail them. Carry on." -Commander Zavala

entries.title: Zavala Recruits
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Commander Zavala straightens his stance and meets your eyes directly. "I've heard of your… adventures." His shoulders relax. "Impeccable work, Guardian. You've transcended our expectations yet again."


Zavala buries a prideful smile. "However, there is always more work to be done. Remain on the fireteam, and remain vigilant. Carry on."

entries.title: Containment Ritual
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote: "The Crown of Sorrow struggles against this unintended purpose. We must endeavor to maintain the Crown's containment… lest we suffer a breach." -Eris Morn

entries.title: Influence Reward
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote: Complete Seasonal Challenges, Nightmare Containment Tiers, and open Sever chests to increase Crown Influence. Rewards Seasonal gear and upgrades.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote:
"Only one connection remains to the lunar Pyramid, and Calus has barely reacted," Eris says. From the tone of her voice, it is apparent this has weighed heavily on her. "There is a piece of his agenda that we cannot yet see, I know it."


"To be this close and still feel as though it is but a mirage is… infuriating," Eris says, and it is clear she intends to find out Calus's true motivations one way or the other.


For now, the task ahead of you is clear: continue containing the Nightmare threat aboard the Leviathan and await further instructions.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote:
"As time progresses, Calus's hold on the lunar Pyramid grows in strength. For each connection we have severed, the remaining grow stronger," Eris says in dire warning.


With a heavy heart, she adds, "The Nightmares only increase in number, and soon I fear they will overflow from the Leviathan and spread across the system."


But there is hope. Zavala is ready to face his past again, and he wants you by his side. 


Return to the Leviathan and prepare for the next ritual of severance.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote:
"We stand at the precipice of victory. There is but one final link that remains between Calus and the Pyramid, and we are ready to strike at it."


Eris bound Caiatl to the Crown of Sorrow and gave the empress as much of an edge as possible in her impending confrontation with Ghaul. 


"However," Eris warns, "by my estimates, Calus has already infiltrated the paracausal matrix of the lunar Pyramid."
"The dark below groans and churns with excitement at this revelation. Emanations from the lunar Pyramid whisper a singular psychic demand to all who can perceive it: REJOICE."


Eris urges you to go and gather the necessary energy to complete the final ritual of severance, before Calus can wrest control of the Pyramid.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote:
"It is as I feared. We were too late."


Eris has learned that the final severance ritual came too late. Caiatl's brazen and failed sever attempt was the time Calus needed to complete his plan. He has extended his full consciousness into the lunar Pyramid and has begun assuming control.


Yet there is still hope. Not all of Calus's power has merged with the Leviathan. There is still time to try one final-desperate-severance ritual at the seat of Calus's power to dislodge him from the Pyramid before the change becomes permanent.


Doing so will require the aid of Crow, Zavala, Caiatl, and Eris together. 


Eris urges you to collect the necessary essence for such a ritual as soon as possible.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote:
Eris has returned with a plan to drive Calus out of the lunar Pyramid by converting the remaining Nightmares bound to the ritual participants into Memories. With these powers at her disposal, Eris can permanently sever Calus's connection to the Pyramid.


Commander Zavala also weighs in with his own experiences. "Recently, I've been… visited in the H.E.L.M. and elsewhere, by one of the Nightmares Eris bound to the Crown. We need to push harder," he says, visibly unnerved.


"I'll be accompanying your next severance mission to weaken Calus's connection to the Pyramid. You and I will get this done."


Prepare for the next ritual of severance by returning to the Leviathan to capture Nightmares.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote:
You are bound.


Eris has successfully bound your Light to that of Crow and Zavala, enabling you to traverse the Leviathan with some measure of protection from the Nightmares there.


"Calus has begun to forge a bond between the Leviathan and the dormant Pyramid buried on the Moon," she says. "I do not yet know why, or how."


You are tasked with exploring the Leviathan to uncover the truth behind Calus's mission, and gather essential components so that Eris can begin severing his connection to the lunar Pyramid, which will mean confronting one of the ship's most powerful Nightmares.


"You will assist Crow when it comes time to perform the first severance ritual. We both know what form his Nightmare will take," Eris warns you.


There is no turning back now.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote:
"Zavala's wounds run deeper than he allows us to see," Eris says. She understands his pain and his unwillingness to reach out to others to help. But in that same respect, she knows that he must in order to move beyond the past that haunts him.


"Zavala only knows grief. But perhaps there is hope in others, in the counsel of friends and family. There is no running from his truth any longer," Eris adds, knowing that such change takes time.


Return to the Leviathan and help contain the growing Nightmare threat while Eris plans what to do next.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote:
Eris realizes she underestimated the situation. The Leviathan has become an extension of the lunar Pyramid. Finding victory here may be a greater challenge than she first anticipated.


Calus's connection to the Pyramid remains intact. "Crow was unprepared to face his own demons when we attempted to sever it," she says. "And though I may be able to counsel him through the next confrontation, that will take time."


Eris encourages you to continue containing Nightmares on the Leviathan until she has time to develop a new strategy.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote:
Eris sees no cause to celebrate. "This was not a victory, Guardian. It has merely bought us time."


Even though Calus was defeated here, he is not gone. He has become a herald of the Witness and the harbinger of the second Collapse.


"Calus may be gone, but the Leviathan remains, and it will take months to clear out the rest of the Nightmares and ensure it is no longer a threat," Eris says.
"But even those efforts may be for naught. We have reached the point of no return. The Witness is near."
"It is the beginning of the end."

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote:
"I have long said that the Darkness can be used as a power for good, even when others doubted," Eris said, elated at the shared victory.


"Uldren is as much a part of Crow as the Darkness is a part of you or I. And there is more to it than pain." She continued, saying, "In this success, we have discovered the key to our victory. Through our bond to the Crown of Sorrow… we could convert the Nightmares into a force against Calus."


Eris is prepared to wield this new power-one of Memories-against Calus. She will need time to determine how best to proceed. In the meantime, continue containing the Nightmare threat aboard the Leviathan.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote:
"It is no mere curiosity that drew Calus to the lunar Pyramid. He is a consciousness that spreads out like a vascular system…" Eris says. "And he is attempting to become one with the lunar Pyramid, so that he may control it. So that he may wield its power."


It is now clear that Calus, at the behest of the Witness, is seeking to claim the power of the lunar Pyramid to aid the Witness in bringing about the second Collapse.


Eris is going to prepare a ritual of binding for Caiatl so that you may-together-attempt to sever Calus's final connection to the Pyramid before he completes his task.


For now, Eris urges you to return to the Leviathan and help contain the growing Nightmare there while there is still time.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote:
"Victory sits before us, and yet it feels strangely hollow." There is no joy in Eris's words.


"I cannot help but feel as though we have not weathered the storm, but merely stepped into its eye. The Nightmares contained within the Crown of Sorrow are seething," Eris says, her voice taking on a hopeless, lost quality.


She has seen no reaction from the Leviathan, the Pyramid, or Calus, even though the connection is severed. Something is happening, something overlooked. 


"Something is coming, Guardian, and we are not prepared."


Do your best to contain the Nightmares in the Leviathan while the Vanguard assesses the situation.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote:
Eris has returned from her studies with a renewed perspective. She is convinced that while the Nightmares are like weapons, they can still be turned against their creators.


With that perspective in mind, she has determined how to approach the ritual of severance anew. "We approached the last ritual of severance the wrong way, attempting to banish the Nightmare of Uldren Sov. But I should have known… denial is not the way."


Now it is on you to return to the Leviathan and contain the necessary Nightmare essence to fuel another attempt at the ritual.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote:
The situation is dire. "The Leviathan's corruption spreads like a plague. Even as we succeed, Calus's influence strengthens," Eris explains.
