"Caiatl has observed Crow and Zavala's successes from afar. She wishes to help us sever Calus's connection to the Pyramid by confronting the Nightmare of Dominus Ghaul," Eris says. "…But Caiatl was not bound with us. There is no certainty a ritual would succeed."


Eris has advised Caiatl to stay aboard her flagship while she looks for another solution. 


For now, gather the necessary resources in preparation of another severance ritual.

entries.title: Legacy: The Leviathan Returns
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote:
"The Leviathan has become an extension of the lunar Pyramid, channeling feelings of shame and regret into reality," Eris explains, adding that the Nightmares were originally a product of the lunar Pyramid's security systems.


Eris fears, with the Leviathan acting as a point of resonance, the Nightmares could spread to Earth or elsewhere. She also is concerned about what Calus is planning to do with the Pyramid.


Eris shakes her head. "Crow was unprepared to face his own demons when we attempted a severance." She explains that she will help guide Crow so that the next time you venture into the Leviathan's depths, he will be ready.


But growth takes time, and Eris requests that you use yours to continue battling Calus's forces and collecting Nightmares for containment.

entries.title: Legacy: The Leviathan Returns
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote:
"It is done. We are inexorably bound to the power of this Hive artifact, and to one another," Eris says, her voice carrying off into the unsettling hum of the Crown.


She tells you that you will become a Reaper of Nightmares, dooming them to containment within the Crown of Sorrow. She assures you that their doom will grant her the knowledge needed to identify and sever Calus's fledgling connection with the lunar Pyramid.


Eris asks you to take an artifact, crafted by her and an associate. She calls it the Nightmare Harvester, and claims that it will offer you protection and contain defeated Nightmares so they may be returned to the Crown. "Seek out concentrations of these Nightmares," Eris requests.


She hopes these battles will prepare you, for it is you who will venture into the Leviathan's depths with Crow once Eris is ready to strike.


Lastly, the Nightmare Harvester is wrapped in a note that reads, "A paracausal hand may find this implement manifested as weapon in areas of high Nightmare concentration. Wield it well."

entries.title: Seasonal Heirloom
entries.speaker: Crown of Sorrow
entries.quote: This item is required to collect Vestiges of Dread from Season of the Haunted.

entries.title: Ascendant Lens
entries.speaker: Darbi 55-30
entries.quote:
Queen Mara's eyebrows lift as you hand her the Ascendant Lens. "This is an exceedingly rare trinket," she says, peering at you through the lens.


"It may not look like much to a common Guardian, but in the hands of our Techeuns, it will be a valuable research tool. You were right to bring it to me."


"Allow me to repay your generosity," she says, handing you a handsome reward.


You start to thank her, but she's already walking away. You've been dismissed.

entries.title: A Spark of Hope
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
"Ah, welcome to my cozy hideaway, Guardian.


"Ikora said you'd be coming, told me what's what. Sounds like you're looking for a weapon frame, one of Cayde's old treasures.


"I'm happy to help, but there's a bit of a snag. The former Hunter Vanguard was notorious for hiding his goodies behind elaborate puzzles; in this case, that meant splitting his treasure map into separate components and squirreling them away.


"Unfortunately, that was a long time ago, and I believe the Fallen have stolen the components. Hard to finish the jigsaw without all the pieces, eh?


"You raid some Fallen Lost Sectors, I bet you'll find what you need. Cheers, and good luck."

entries.title: A Spark of Hope
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
"I met Cayde enough times to know a thing or two about his codenames for things. Cosmonaut Club…"


Devrim scratches his beard and stares out the window of the steeple.


"I'd bet the pot he's referring to the Cosmodrome. Must have been spooked by something and decided to relocate the package there."


"You're probably best off checking the interior of the Cosmodrome wall; that's the only place he could reliably hide something from the Fallen in Old Russia."


"Good luck, Guardian. Don't forget a coat. It gets a bit nippy in Siberia this time of year."

entries.title: A Spark of Hope
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
"Ah, welcome to my cozy hideaway, Guardian."


"Ikora said you'd be coming, told me what's what. Sounds like you're looking for a weapon frame. It was one of Cayde's old treasures, recovered during a Vanguard operation."


"I'm happy to help, but there's a bit of a snag. The former Hunter Vanguard was notorious for hiding his goodies behind elaborate puzzles. In this case, he divided the map containing the frame's location, and squirrelled the map components away."


Devrim pauses and shakes his head. "Unfortunately, that was a long time ago, and the Fallen have stolen the fragments of Cayde's map. Hard to finish the jigsaw without all the pieces, eh?"


"You raid some Fallen Lost Sectors, I bet you'll find what you need. Cheers, and good luck."

entries.title: A Watchful Eye
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
"What's that? Shaxx had you look in on me? Whatever for?"


Devrim listens attentively as you explain Shaxx's instructions. 


"Ah, training. I understand. Tell him I told you something pithy about follow-through."


Devrim offers a tight smile. "I'm a little… busy, here. Never a quiet moment in the EDZ. But then, things are heating up everywhere. Word is the Witness's forces are hitting the Mothyards, in the Cosmodrome."


"None of us know what's coming next. I'll admit I'm… not entirely sure I shouldn't be back in the City with Marc and Suraya." 


Devrim's stoic facade falters only briefly; another breath, and he's unreadable. 


"I'd better get back to it. As for you, I think you're best suited for the front lines, fighting the battles we can't."

entries.title: Armament Protocol
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Devrim greets you with a stern, but familiar nod. 


"Got it done just in time, Guardian. The fight's far from over, but with you in it, I'd wager we've got a chance."

entries.title: Armament Protocol
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
"Welcome to Call to Arms, Guardian. Gather the best gear you can and put it to the test. "


"I'll have new shipments of the latest gear every day here at the Tower. If you're on the hunt for something specific, my scouts can help you find that special weapon you're looking for."

entries.title: Casualties of War
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
"The Red Legion hit us hard," Devrim says, glancing out his window at the warring Cabal and Fallen outside the church. "Where we were most vulnerable. We lost many people, Guardians and civilians alike."


He turns to face you again, managing a smile. "But we can do more than just honor the memory of the people we lost. We can help those who still remain. The safer these areas are, the easier it is for Hawthorne and her people to help refugees find their way to the City. Perhaps you can help with that."

entries.title: Clarion Call: EDZ
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Hey Guardian,



        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

entries.title: Clarion Call: EDZ
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote: Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

entries.title: Dawning Delivery
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote: Devrim is polite as always in his gratitude and waits for you to depart before returning his attention to the window.

entries.title: Dawning's Gift: Devrim
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote: Devrim raises an eyebrow at the gift, but his gratitude seems genuine. He does not take a sip, however.

entries.title: Devrim Kay
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Devrim has heard of your victory over Ghaul in the City, and wishes to congratulate you. Speak with him in Trostland.



        Devrim congratulates you on your victory over Ghaul.


While the head of the Red Legion has been slain, the Red War continues across the solar system.

entries.title: Devrim Kay
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
With the Vanguard back together, more adventures await in the EDZ. Speak with Devrim in Trostland to learn more.



        Devrim describes the new challenges you'll face in the wilds of the European Dead Zone


Explore the area for new adventures to complete.

entries.title: Devrim Kay
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Devrim has noticed your efforts in the European Dead Zone and wishes to speak with you.



        Devrim thanks you for the significant progress you've made in the EDZ.


Continue your adventures on the planet to earn his appreciation and rewards.

entries.title: Devrim Kay
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Devrim is grateful for your many successful adventures in the EDZ. Speak with him in Trostland.



        Devrim thanks you for the work you've done in securing the EDZ.


New challenges appear on the horizon, however.

entries.title: Devrim Kay
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Devrim Kay is no stranger to loss. But the wise know that death never gets easier. Go check in on Devrim to see how he's doing in the wake of Cayde's death.



        If you ever want to talk, or even just keep an old man company for a bit, Devrim will always be there with a warm cup of tea.

entries.title: Devrim Kay
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
The communication network is in place, but a nearby Cabal outpost has been jamming all outbound signals. Hawthorne needs to get her message out to the survivors. 


Take Devrim's signal booster and help Hawthorne by completing mission "Combustion."

entries.title: Discover the EDZ
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
"Ahh, Guardian. Welcome to the EDZ. I can always use your help to keep the local riffraff in check. From the Outskirts to the Gulch, we've got plenty of nasties roaming these hills. And don't get me started on the Cabal's Firebase."


Devrim Kay offers EDZ bounties, pursuits, and various rewards to Guardians who fight to reclaim the EDZ.


Help Devrim by completing the EDZ adventure, "A New Frontier." Then, complete his other challenges to earn a new reward.

entries.title: Discover the EDZ
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
"Ahh, Guardian. Welcome to the EDZ. I can always use your help to keep the local riffraff in check. From the Outskirts to the Gulch, we've got plenty of nasties roaming these hills. And don't get me started on the Cabal's Firebase."


Devrim Kay offers EDZ bounties, quests, and various rewards to Guardians who fight to reclaim the EDZ.


Help Devrim by completing the EDZ adventure, "A New Frontier." Then, complete his other challenges to earn a new reward.

entries.title: Earth Reclaimed
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Devrim nods approvingly at your scratched and spattered armor.


"I've been watching you battle back Maya's forces. Impressive stuff. With a sustained effort like that, we may even be able to resettle the Plaguelands someday."


His optimistic tone becomes tempered by years of war fatigue.


"But I still don't think we've gotten to the bottom of Maya's ambitions in the region. Keep working with Caiatl's Psions to learn what her endgame is with all this Golden Age tech."


The sniper gives you a jaunty salute. "Keep up the good work, Guardian."

entries.title: Earth Reclaimed
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Devrim waves you over with a fire in his eyes.


"Maya's attack on the Tower started a new gold rush across Sol. She's losing control of her collective and needs the latent power from Golden Age tech to maintain it."


Devrim gives your loadout a quick up-and-down, nodding in approval.


"We need to beat her forces to that tech and reclaim lost territories while you're there. We'll be inserting you into some former quarantine zones, so be ready for anything."

entries.title: EDZ Challenges
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote: The EDZ remains as hotly contested as ever, but today you've done your part.

entries.title: Enhance!
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
The Fallen stole technology from the Cabal and were using it to make enhanced Ether. Now that they can't make any more, it's time to find any remaining caches of the stuff and destroy them. 


Seek out caches of enhanced Fallen Ether on EDZ and destroy them.

entries.title: Enhance!
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote: The Fallen stole technology from the Cabal and were using it to make enhanced Ether. Now that they can't make any more, it's time to find any remaining caches of enhanced Ether and destroy them.

entries.title: Enhance!
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Devrim has a strange tale to tell of the Fallen.



        Oh, Guardian, while you're here… The Fallen are up to something nearby, and it might be worth your time to investigate.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote: Your reputation in the EDZ precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote: Complete patrols and public events in the EDZ to get EDZ tokens, and earn Level 20 rewards from Devrim Kay.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote: Your reputation in the Crucible precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote: Complete patrols and public events in the EDZ to get Dusklight Crystals and earn rewards from Devrim Kay.

entries.title: FLASHPOINT: EDZ
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Devrim thanks you for keeping the EDZ safe.



        Devrim thanks you for keeping the EDZ safe.

entries.title: FLASHPOINT: EDZ
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Complete various activities around the EDZ, including public events, Lost Sectors, and Heroic adventures.



        Complete various activities around the EDZ, including public events, Lost Sectors, and Heroic adventures.

entries.title: Foregone Conclusions
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
"Stellar job, as always," Devrim says when you return. "I greatly appreciate it."


He glances out his lookout window, and then back at you. "The Festival of the Lost is an important tradition for the people of the City. Our struggles have made us very resilient, very determined to remember the past and to look forward, hopefully, to the future. Guardians like yourself participating in that tradition is important to us." He nods. "Anyway. Here's a little something for your efforts, hm?"

entries.title: Foregone Conclusions
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Devrim turns from his sniper post, lowering his gun to take the gift you offer. "Thank you," he says, examining it. "Marc does send me care packages sometimes. But it's difficult to get them here. The Fallen activity is quite persistent, and I've been out of ammo for ages."


He glances up. "I like the gifts he sends, but the notes are the real treat. I re-read them sometimes, when it's quiet."

entries.title: Increase Reputation
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote: Show Devrim Kay proof of your deeds in the EDZ.

entries.title: Reach Level 20
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote: Increase your level to claim these rewards.

entries.title: The Last Hurrah
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote: Devrim pats you on the back. "Thanks for helping the Last City during the Call to Arms, Guardian. You've helped us fortify our arsenal, and that has not gone unnoticed. Celebrate and collect your rewards!"

entries.title: The Last Hurrah
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Devrim nods your way. "That was the last rally horn and the Call to Arms has quieted. You did good, Guardian." 


"Well, there's plenty to enjoy as Celebration Week marches ahead. Take advantage of attuning your weapons and gathering Daily Shipments for the rest of the week. Who knows, there might be a little bonus for you, too."


He motions behind him. "I'll need to pack the gear and head back to the EDZ soon. Enjoy while it lasts, Guardian!"

entries.title: The Last Hurrah
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Devrim chuckles, "The Call to Arms was answered. You can relax now, Guardian." 


"Please, take the time to celebrate this week. Attune your weapons and gather daily shipments while you can. I hear there's some extra goods around for you, too."


He shrugs, then sighs. "I have to return to the EDZ after packing all this gear. Don't be a stranger in the meantime."

entries.title: The Red War
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Hi



        Devrim has been working to set up a regional communication network to let the scattered people of the City know they can find safety and community on the Farm. But the Fallen are not making that task easy. 


Learn more about the EDZ by completing adventure "A New Frontier."

entries.title: The Red War
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Hi again



        The communication network is in place, but a nearby Cabal outpost has been jamming all outbound signals. Hawthorne needs to get her message out to the survivors. 


Take Devrim's signal booster and help Hawthorne by completing mission "Combustion."

entries.title: The Red War
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Devrim has been working to set up a regional communication network to let the scattered people of the City know they can find safety and community on the Farm. But the Fallen are not making that task easy. 


Learn more about the EDZ by completing adventure "A New Frontier."

entries.title: The Red War
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
The communication network is in place, but a nearby Cabal outpost has been jamming all outbound signals. Hawthorne needs to get her message out to the survivors. 


Take Devrim's signal booster and help Hawthorne by completing mission "Combustion."

entries.title: Unnamed Interaction
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
Hey Guardian,



        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

entries.title: Visit Devrim Kay
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote:
"Hello again, Guardian. Getting a feel for the old place? There's constant trouble nipping at our heels out here… They don't call it the European Dead Zone for nothing."


As you continue to explore the EDZ, you'll earn XP and rewards for completing adventures, Lost Sectors, public events, world quests, and EDZ bounties.

entries.title: Where in the EDZ Is Archie?
entries.speaker: Devrim Kay
entries.quote: "Ah yes, Archie came through not too long ago. What a good lad. He kept watch while I brewed some tea, then darted away claiming to have seen a bird made of light… and I think he took my favorite mug, the little scamp."

entries.title: A Rising Tide
entries.speaker: Donations Chest
entries.quote:
Collect Captain's Coins from Ketchcrash and Expedition activities, destination chests, Lost Sectors, public events, Dares of Eternity, and the "King's Fall" raid.


Donate the Captain's Coins here at the Donations Chest to help Mithrax and Spider improve the Eliksni Quarter.

entries.title: A Rising Tide
entries.speaker: Donations Chest
entries.quote:
As you draw close to the unfamiliar chest, Mithrax's voice crackles over the radio.


"I require your assistance," he says, but then hesitates. "I must ask… that you work alongside… someone…"


An exasperated Spider cuts into the feed, sparing Mithrax further embarrassment. 


"I'll take it from here, Misraakskel," he says.


He outlines the plan Mithrax and the Vanguard have come up with: Guardians are being asked to scour the system for any remaining pirate treasure and bring as much as they can back to the Tower. The recovered funds will be used to improve the Last City, starting with the Eliksni Quarter.  


While the Guardians are working together, Mithrax will be able to focus on studying the relics of Nezarec-he feels he is close to a breakthrough. He has asked Spider to distribute the resources and finance the improvements the Eliksni Quarter needs.


"Bring me everything you can get your hands on!" Spider says.


"And may the Light provide," he adds begrudgingly.

entries.title: A Death of Nightmares
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
It is possible you've done a terrible thing in caging such power. But terrible things have forced your hand. Unleash your fury across the system, until all who consider themselves the fever dreams of our eternal torment understand. You, when pushed, are the only nightmare worth fearing.


You have crafted a weapon of corruption and doom, powered by the stolen might of the Hive's wicked Song.


Unleash its fury upon your enemies. Become death.

entries.title: A Dubious Bento
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Eris greets you with a muted smile. This time, she does not appear surprised as she reaches out to retrieve the meal you've brought her. 


"Ah… Drifter has always dedicated himself whole-heartedly to even the most foolish causes, though he protests all the while. Be it that cynical game of his, or…" She taps the food container. 


"I imagine he only sought to spite us all, in those early days. Prove us wrong. Fortunate, then, that neither you nor I are very good at backing down from an argument."


Eris laughs quietly.


"Do you recall our entreaties to the Nine? Our communion with the entity we believed to be the Darkness itself? Those first, hesitant steps?"


"Drifter is right, I think. We make an effective fireteam."

entries.title: A Persistent Threat
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Speak to Eris.



        Your success in entering the Pyramid and obtaining the Unknown Artifact has prepared us more than ever for the looming threat of the Darkness. But this is no time for rest.



Help Eris dispel the phantoms of her lost fireteam

Hunt Nightmares at higher difficulties

Uncover the secrets of the Moon's Lost Sectors

Find further Nightmare Essences spread across the Moon

Gather Phantasmal Fragments to choose Essences from the Lectern of Enchantment

entries.title: Another Step Closer
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"It is no surprise that the Pyramid now inflicts the phantom of Omar Agah upon me. The Pyramid will do anything to stop us from getting inside."


Hashladûn has been disposed of, and with her death comes a path to victory: the Hive Cryptoglyph.


Travel to the Hellmouth and locate the Catacombs within. Hashladûn's Cryptoglyph lies inside for the taking.

entries.title: Back from the Dark
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"The phantom of Eriana-3 now haunts me alongside the rest. They are a burden that weighs heavy on my mind."


The Cryptoglyph must be used to empower the Lectern of Enchantment near Eris. In tandem with the cleansed Essence of Anguish, this will yield another piece of Dreambane armor.


Empower the Lectern of Enchantment with the Cryptoglyph before setting off to hunt the remaining Nightmares.


More Nightmare Essences are required to craft the remaining three pieces of Dreambane armor.

entries.title: Catching Up
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"A phantom of my deceased fireteam member Sai Mota haunts me. It is only a trick of the Pyramid."


From the Nightmare of Crota, you received an unknown object that harbors a dark energy. You leave it with Eris Morn so she can unearth its secrets.


In the meantime, the Moon hosts further mysteries to uncover regarding entering the Pyramid. The Hive seem to be exhibiting strange behavior that may be related.


Investigate the strange Hive behavior near the Scarlet Keep.

entries.title: Dawning Delivery
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote: Eris takes the gift from you, looks at it a moment, and then smiles very faintly. She thanks you and wishes you well.

entries.title: Dredgens of Yore
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"Guardian, I wish to express my gratitude. Not only for the food, which has been… unexpectedly appetizing."


"I have enjoyed these regular visits. They invite recollection, without sorrow. As much as I have lost, today I find myself in the company of those who will extend to me their kindness and their trust, and that is a great gift."


"We are not the same people we were even a few years ago. To risk connection is to be changed. And we have changed too much already to fear what the future may bring. I only count myself fortunate that, when I walk forward to meet it, I will not do so alone." 


"…And please, tell Germaine that he is not fooling anyone. He wouldn't leave now that he's just begun showing off his culinary skills."

entries.title: Eris Morn
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Eris Morn has heard of your victory over the Undying Mind and wishes to speak to you. Visit her in Sanctuary on the Moon.



        While Eris is pleased that you defeated the Undying Mind, she warns you not to let your guard down. There are greater threats on the horizon. She urges you to keep those threats at the forefront of your mind-and prepare accordingly.

entries.title: Essence, Cleansed
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"The Pyramid wastes no time-a phantom of Toland has arrived with every intention of distracting me. It will not work."


During Eris's time in the Hellmouth, she discovered many Hive curios. All that remained was an ancient talisman pulsating with Hive magic. Now, the union between the talisman and the Essence of Despair has yielded a powerful tool in the fight against the Nightmares.


Take this piece of Dreambane armor and use it to hunt the Nightmare of Omnigul.

entries.title: Eyes on the Moon
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Though you made short work of the Vex on the Moon, it will all be for naught if the source of the incursions is left untended. Eris has found a way into their staging grounds in the Black Garden, but she must keep her attention fixed on the mysterious Pyramid for now. She asks that you and Ikora attend to this threat in her stead. Your investigation begins at the source, in the Black Garden.


Descend into the Black Garden and complete the Vex Offensive activity.

entries.title: Finality
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"This… communes with me. And I know it… I know him. This is what remains of dear Omar. Tortured by the Hive. I knew not that he would be transformed by Crota's twisted experiments…


"I am sorry I couldn't save you, friend. In life, you may have been unable to escape their grasp. But you will have your vengeance yet."


Eris has kept in her possession one of Omar's greatest assets: his beloved Machine Gun. Eris empowers it with the spirit of Omar, and grants it to you.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Eris Morn greets you with a grim demeanor. "Guardian. If Caiatl cannot complete her severance, we must find another way forward. In the meantime…"


Eris looks past you, to a point in the distance. "Sorrow's Harbor is again teeming with Nightmares. The Leviathan is to blame, but intelligence suggests that Calus has a more direct influence than I previously assumed."


"It would appear he is reaching out to the Witness's other denizens on the Moon, and the Hive weave rituals beneath the lunar surface to accommodate him. You will find them preparing such a ritual in the sector known as 'K1 Revelation'."


Eris's focus snaps back to you. "Xivu Arath's forces still hold much of this place, despite the Lucent Brood's attempts to usurp them. You will no doubt encounter their warriors attempting to block your path," Eris says.


"I imagine, in your path, they won't remain obstacles for long. Find out what foul scheme Calus intends to hatch and if we can manipulate it for our own purposes."

entries.title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"The phantom of Eriana-3 now haunts me alongside the rest. They are a burden that weighs heavy on my mind."


The Cryptoglyph must be used to empower the Lectern of Enchantment near Eris. In tandem with the cleansed Essence of Anguish, this will yield another piece of Dreambane armor.


Empower the Lectern of Enchantment with the Cryptoglyph before setting off to hunt the remaining Nightmares.


More Nightmare Essences are required to craft the remaining three pieces of Dreambane armor.

entries.title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
You now stand at the precipice of the future. The Pyramid holds many secrets within. Lift the veil, and find a way inside. Look for something within-anything that might help humanity fight the oncoming storm.


Return to the Enduring Abyss with a full set of Dreambane armor equipped, and find a way inside the Pyramid.

entries.title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"It is no surprise that the Pyramid now inflicts the phantom of Omar Agah upon me. The Pyramid will do anything to stop us from getting inside."


Hashladûn has been disposed of, and with her death comes a path to victory: the Hive Cryptoglyph.


Travel to the Hellmouth and locate the Catacombs within. Hashladûn's Cryptoglyph lies inside for the taking.

entries.title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"A phantom of my deceased fireteam member Sai Mota haunts me. It is only a trick of the Pyramid."


From the Nightmare of Crota, you received an unknown object that harbors a dark energy. You leave it with Eris Morn so she can unearth its secrets.


In the meantime, the Moon hosts further mysteries to uncover regarding entering the Pyramid. The Hive seem to be exhibiting strange behavior that may be related.


Investigate the strange Hive behavior near the Scarlet Keep.

entries.title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"It appears the screams of Sai's phantom have brought forth another burden for me to bear-the phantom of Vell Tarlowe."


As the Nightmare of Omnigul swept through camp, Eris noticed a strange reaction from the Essence of Despair. Upon further investigation, it appears the Essence can be of use in fighting these Nightmares. But first, it must be cleansed of any dark energy.


Take the Essence of Despair and purify it any way you can. Then, return to Eris Morn.

entries.title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
You have acquired further Nightmare Essences but are out of Hive curios with which to create more Dreambane armor.


After discovering the Hive's ability to shield themselves from the Nightmares, Eris learned of a dark power possessed by the Hive inside the Scarlet Keep. This power may be our answer to how they've protected themselves-and our key to creating more Dreambane armor.


Investigate the dark power within the Scarlet Keep.

entries.title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"The Pyramid wastes no time-a phantom of Toland has arrived with every intention of distracting me. It will not work."


During Eris's time in the Hellmouth, she discovered many Hive curios. All that remained was an ancient talisman pulsating with Hive magic. Now, the union between the talisman and the Essence of Despair has yielded a powerful tool in the fight against the Nightmares.


Take this piece of Dreambane armor and use it to hunt the Nightmare of Omnigul.

entries.title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Eris believes that whatever these things are, they want nothing more than to destroy everything we hold dear.


Eris takes the Unknown Artifact from you. She desires to study it in hopes of making sense of all that you saw within the Pyramid.

entries.title: Lingering Torment
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Speak to Eris in Sanctuary.



        Somehow, within the Pit of Heresy, the remaining Daughters of Crota managed to revive Zulmak, strengthened and protected by the Darkness within the crystal. With their rejection of sword logic, Crota's daughters have become far more dangerous. You may have scared them off for now, but there is no doubt they will seek revenge.

entries.title: Martial Mementos
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Eris accepts the container with a polite nod. 


"…Perhaps someday, we might all share a meal together. If we can ever find the time." 


"Until then, Guardian, please feel free to claim a gift."

entries.title: Memory of Eriana-3
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"Eriana-3 was the Praxic Warlock who led our fireteam of six into the Hellmouth and… unknowingly… to our doom. I do not blame her, Guardian. During the Great Disaster, Crota snuffed out the love in her heart and left only venom. In the end, before she lost her life in the Oversoul Throne, Eriana-3 came to regret her haste for vengeance."


Reclaim the true memory of Eriana-3 for Eris Morn.


Begin by recovering stolen treasures from Lunar Scavengers beneath the surface of the Moon.

entries.title: Memory of Omar Agah
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"Of the six of us who descended into the pit, the Hunter Omar Agah surely suffered the most terrible fate. Captured alive by the Heart of Crota, Omar's Light was cut away from him in small bits, used to feed and coax newborn creatures from their cocoons. I will never forget the sounds he made as he died."


Reclaim the true memory of Omar Agah for Eris Morn.


Begin by defeating a powerful Hive Wizard using Super abilities.

entries.title: Memory of Sai Mota
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"Sai Mota was a Hunter who walked with us on our doomed journey for vengeance against Crota. Most of us did not make it, however. She… fell to the Wizard Omnigul, laughing as she died."


Reclaim the true memory of Sai Mota for Eris Morn.


Begin by searching for the system core vault within the K1 Revelation Lost Sector.

entries.title: Memory of Toland, the Shattered
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"Toland, the mad. Toland, the cursed. The exiled. And finally, the Shattered. He knew more about the Hive and the 'song' of their Deathsingers than any other. Had Eriana-3 questioned his convenient obsession further before recruiting him to our fireteam, things might have been different. But fate is fate. That he could not control."


Reclaim the true memory of Toland for Eris Morn.


Search the Moon's surface for a Hive Trove Guardian obscuring a hidden path.

entries.title: Memory of Vell Tarlowe
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"Vell Tarlowe was one of the strongest Titans I've ever known. A member of the Pilgrim Guard, but even his Light was smothered by the waves of Thrall that rush beneath the surface of the Moon. He underestimated them… and he paid the price."


Reclaim the true memory of Vell Tarlowe for Eris Morn.


Begin by completing an active replayable story mission on the Moon.

entries.title: Nightmare Kills
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"Ah. I see our dinner conversations have come to a close. For now, at least." Eris tips her head in acknowledgment as she retrieves her final delivery. 


"Drifter has great admiration for you. He may obscure it all he likes with jokes and affected bewilderment… it remains plain to see. You are a part of this City in a way some part of him longs for." 


Eris pauses, thoughtful. "To serve as lofty inspiration alone would be dispiriting. But I hope you know that we both consider you a friend." 


"I, at least, am content to communicate that directly."

entries.title: Nightmare Lunch
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"Drifter sent you here with… lunch?"


Eris warily regards the container you've brought her, then cracks it open. The air fills with a tantalizing blend of aromas. 


"…Dumplings," Eris observes with solemnity. 


She sighs. 


"The Drifter and I have been-cautiously-discussing the past. That is, we have been reflecting upon my tendency to cling to material remnants of years gone by… and the Drifter's reluctance to divest himself of his old reputation." 


"This seemed an adequate opportunity in which to make a fresh appraisal of all that I have gathered throughout the years. I believe Drifter meant this small kindness as… encouragement." She smiles faintly.


"…I would not wish for you to leave empty-handed. Please: take something. Consider it a fair exchange."

entries.title: On the Other Side
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Eris believes that whatever these things are, they want nothing more than to destroy everything we hold dear.


Eris takes the Unknown Artifact from you. She desires to study it in hopes of making sense of all that you saw within the Pyramid.

entries.title: Raisin the Dead
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"As ever," Eris says gravely, "I am bidden to grant you dried fruit candies."


She hands you a small box of raisins. "It's traditional at this time of year to trade small gifts and sweets. Perhaps there is someone in this System who would be willing to make a trade for this."

entries.title: Snakebite
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"…He really found pineapple." Eris's voice softens. 


"We lost so much with the arrival of the Black Fleet. It seemed senseless to mourn my little garden on Io, at the time. But sometimes I think on how frightened we all were, in the face of a second Collapse… and what it meant to me, to plant a garden at the end of the world." 


"The garden is gone. But the hope remains."

entries.title: Symphony of Death
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
It is possible you've done a terrible thing in caging such power. But terrible things have forced your hand. Unleash your fury across the system, until all who consider themselves the fever dreams of our eternal torment understand. You, when pushed, are the only nightmare worth fearing.


You have crafted a weapon of corruption and doom, powered by the stolen might of the Hive's wicked Song.


Unleash its fury upon your enemies. Become death.

entries.title: Symphony of Death
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"This skull is only the first instrument in our new symphony. With its guidance, we will twist the Hive's tainted lullaby to our will. But first we must bind its gifts. Scour the Moon. Bring me the bones of the damned."


Hunt enemies on the Moon. Gather bones for Eris by completing the activities she requires.

entries.title: Symphony of Death
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"Memories buried, only now remembered. Years ago, I recall reports of music, of a hymn murmured by Deathsingers beneath the Moon's surface."


"This is a song of destruction, our destruction. I believe we can harness this power and turn it against the Hive."

entries.title: Tainted Lullaby
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"This skull is only the first instrument in our new symphony. With its guidance, we will twist the Hive's tainted lullaby to our will. But first we must bind its gifts. Scour the Moon. Bring me the bones of the damned."


Hunt enemies on the Moon. Gather bones for Eris by completing the activities she requires.

entries.title: The Dance of My People
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Eris takes the Void Fizz from you and studies it. "Elemental candies," she says thoughtfully. "A strange way to exploit the power of the Void."


She sets the candy aside and looks at you. "Thank you, Guardian." She pauses."I sometimes wonder if our people rely too much on candy and masks to divert the sting of loss. But then, I'm guilty of my own diversions."

entries.title: The Dance of My People
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote: Eris thanks you for taking part in the celebration. She speaks about the meaning of the Festival and her own experiences with loss, and then hands you a toothbrush.

entries.title: The Deepening Wake
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"Our focus is to be shifted. We created a wake when we destroyed Hashladûn and took the Cryptoglyph-and that wake has grown and grown. Hashladûn's two remaining sisters appear to have picked up where her foul plans left off. Once again, strange Hive rituals have commenced near the Keep. We must tame these plans before they become too grand to handle."


Investigate the Hive rituals in Sorrow's Harbor.

entries.title: The Deepening Wake
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
The strange Hive rituals within Sorrow's Harbor have proven to be only the tip of the iceberg. Eris believes the remaining Daughters of Crota are sacrificing Nightmares to obtain their dark energy. What the Daughters are using them for, she does not know. But all signs point beneath the Harbor itself.


Search Sorrow's Harbor for the entrance to the Pit of Heresy.

entries.title: The Encroaching Nightmare
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"It appears the screams of Sai's phantom have brought forth another burden for me to bear-the phantom of Vell Tarlowe."


As the Nightmare of Omnigul swept through camp, Eris noticed a strange reaction from the Essence of Despair. Upon further investigation, it appears the Essence can be of use in fighting these Nightmares. But first, it must be cleansed of any dark energy.


Take the Essence of Despair and purify it any way you can. Then, return to Eris Morn.

entries.title: The Infection Runs Deep
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Speak to Eris regarding discoveries made within the Black Garden.



        The efforts of Guardians within the Black Garden seem to have unlocked the Unknown Artifact. It now provides communications from something… sinister. Eris warns us not to bow to it but believes the Artifact too valuable to dispose of.


Collect any further communications it sends, but remain cautious. There is little here to trust.

entries.title: The Journey
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"This… communes with me. And I know it… I know him. This is what remains of dear Omar. Tortured by the Hive. I knew not that he would be transformed by Crota's twisted experiments…


"I am sorry I couldn't save you, friend. In life, you may have been unable to escape their grasp. But you will have your vengeance yet."


Eris has kept in her possession one of Omar's greatest assets: his beloved Machine Gun. Eris empowers it with the spirit of Omar, and grants it to you.

entries.title: The Journey
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"There is a mystery here," Eris says softly. She turns the tablet around in her hands. "A memory stirs. I think…no."


She shakes her head. "The runes indicate the Anchor of Light. You may begin there to unravel the threads of this enigma."


Make your way to the Anchor of Light on the Moon to begin this journey.

entries.title: The Keep Looms
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
You have acquired further Nightmare Essences but are out of Hive curios with which to create more Dreambane armor.


After discovering the Hive's ability to shield themselves from the Nightmares, Eris learned of a dark power possessed by the Hive inside the Scarlet Keep. This power may be our answer to how they've protected themselves-and our key to creating more Dreambane armor.


Investigate the dark power within the Scarlet Keep.

entries.title: The Pyramid Awaits
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
You now stand at the precipice of the future. The Pyramid holds many secrets within. Lift the veil, and find a way inside. Look for something within-anything that might help humanity fight the oncoming storm.


Return to the Enduring Abyss with a full set of Dreambane armor equipped, and find a way inside the Pyramid.

entries.title: The Stuff of Legends
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Eris takes the container gingerly from your hands.


"I see that this will not be a… one-time occurrence." 


She pauses, then lifts the lid to peer inside. You catch the flicker of a smile before Eris snaps the container shut and regards you intently. 


"I have been reflecting upon power, of late. How it accumulates. How it can be bent to purpose. And… what becomes of it, when that purpose is fulfilled." 


"A line of thought that flowed, inevitably, to you. To the role you have played in each of our lives. Your triumphs have altered the fates of entire stars. Today, I see the good you do for the City, and that, too, seems a sweet and indulgent vengeance." 


"My gratitude, Guardian, for this gift. Perhaps something in my collection will suit you in kind."

entries.title: Where on the Moon Is Archie?
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote: "Hmm? Oh, yes. Archie was here. He wanted very much to play fetch." Eris pauses for a moment. "I managed to divert his attention to the railgun."

entries.title: Whispers in the Dark
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.


Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.



        "What first appeared as nonsense and trickery has begun to reveal itself. Certainly we are being manipulated through these interactions, though there is an honesty here… a spark of truth that speaks louder than I sought to allow. I will give it some credence, but please, do not let my curiosity infect your truths."

entries.title: Whispers in the Dark
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.


Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.



        "Please do not think I have strayed from the Light. Understand that first and foremost, knowledge will save us all. Know thy enemy… a cliché, yes. But for a reason. Please realize-this enemy, it is not like our other enemies. It fights with a different kind of force. Were we to simply shoot at it, I fear we would never stand a chance. Sometimes you must accept another's truth to understand their weakness. I hope you'll join me on this journey."

entries.title: Whispers in the Dark
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.


Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.



        "Pay little attention to the false equivalencies within these messages. They seek to use familiarity to lead us into the darker recesses of our minds… Do not misunderstand-these are certainly fascinating places to explore. But we do so at the risk of giving ourselves to something without our best interests at heart."


Press Accept to receive a mysterious transmission.

entries.title: Whispers in the Dark
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.


Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.



        "Sinister transmissions seep out from our Unknown Artifact. Their intentions are anything but pure. Place your eyes upon them only if you seek to find truths among the lies."


Press Accept to receive a mysterious transmission.

entries.title: Whispers in the Dark
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.


Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.



        "How long have we lived without questioning the nature of our crafted existence? Do not mistake my curiosity for a turnabout of loyalty-the Light has given us life, while these things have given us only deceit and dysfunction. But… perhaps we are not as in control as we'd like to be. After all, what is the point of life without liberty?"


Press Accept to receive a mysterious transmission.

entries.title: Whispers in the Dark
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.


Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.



        "These words contain an ancient and unknown power. They are something beyond manipulative ruminations. There is a cry within them, one that seeks to be heard, lost in a sea that only dampens their truths. We must let them be heard. It may be our only way to prepare for whatever comes next."


Press Accept to receive a mysterious transmission.

entries.title: Whispers in the Dark
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.


Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.



        "We know we should keep ourselves from these deceptive interactions, but what we are learning here are truths previously untold. They are asking to be understood. To be known. Perhaps their intentions are far less black-and-white than we first assumed. As always, stay cautious… but perhaps we should not stray from learning the secrets of the universe."


Press Accept to receive a mysterious transmission.

entries.title: Whispers in the Dark
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:

        "What first appeared as nonsense and trickery has begun to reveal itself. I will give it some credence-but please, do not let my curiosity infect your truths."


Press Accept to receive a mysterious transmission.

entries.title: Whispers in the Dark
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Whispers continue to flow from the Unknown Artifact, but their transmissions have stopped.


Eris, however, has a message for you.



        "Their transmissions have ceased. But I am confident it is not the end of their trechery. You have continued to stand by me through it all. A beacon of light shining through their forced darkness. For that, I have only this remaining message to give."


Press Accept to receive Eris's message.

entries.title: Whispers in the Dark
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.


Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.



        "Somewhere in the space between it all… between the truth and the lies, between power and weakness, between day and night, I have lived. In the gray. I believed not by choice, but by force. Chaos reigned, and I embraced it, but ultimately sought to regain equilibrium. Now, however, if these stories are true, I wonder… Perhaps there is only chaos. Perhaps it is the only thing worth embracing."


Press Accept to receive a mysterious transmission.

entries.title: Whispers in the Dark
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.


Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.



        "Please do not think I have strayed from the Light. Understand that first and foremost, knowledge will save us all. Know thy enemy… a cliché, yes. But for a reason. Please realize this enemy-it is not like our other enemies. It fights with a different kind of force. Were we to simply shoot at it, I fear we would never stand a chance. Sometimes you must accept another's truth to understand their weakness. I hope you'll join me on this journey."


Press Accept to receive a mysterious transmission.

entries.title: Whispers in the Dark
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.


Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.



        "Perhaps what we think of ourselves is simply within our minds, not in our makeup. Perhaps what built us is not what we thought it was. Always prescribing rationale to the chaos. Always finding light within the dark. Never considering the possibility of a parallel existence within the very building blocks of life. The cards are not what we thought they were. But we still must play the game."

entries.title: Whispers in the Dark
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.


Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.



        "You must see this… The implication is an alteration of the very fabric of reality as we know it. Who or what has life descended from? It cannot be what these transmissions suggest. But at the same time, perhaps maybe… I believe you must judge for yourself."


Press Accept to receive a mysterious transmission.
