entries.title: Whispers of the Past
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Eris Morn turns to face you, the Ahamkara bone in her palm glowing faintly. Even through her blindfold, Eris's gaze is piercing. 


"Guardian," she begins, "it's my understanding that you're sharpening yourself against the forces of the Witness. Making ready for a final reckoning."


"My brief time as a Hive god made it clear to me that some preparations can be made without. Others must be made within," she says. 


"I have a proposal to do both," she says. "If you are willing to delve into a troublesome memory, I can use your forgotten recollections to reassemble a great weapon from your past."


"And in facing the Darkness," she concludes, "you may find even more power than you imagined."

entries.title: Whispers of the Past
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Eris grasps your hands and mutters under her breath. You feel light-headed as her incantation takes hold. After a moment, an enigmatic smile plays over her face.


"Yes," she mutters. "I can see it. I can feel it. I can hear it. The whispers. I had almost forgotten myself."


She drops your hands and disappears from view. She returns a moment later and gives you a hauntingly familiar weapon. 


"Wield this," she commands you. "Use it to test your foe. Let this be your worship."


She turns from you, looking out over the barren Moonscape. "Aiat."

entries.title: Whispers of the Taken I
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
"Memories are not passive," Eris says as you approach. "Unlike a Crucible feed or one of Eido's fables. They are constructed and reconstructed. Reborn anew each time we recall them."


"They are generative," she concludes. "And in your case, they have created something wholly new."


She touches your weapon and concentrates fiercely. After a moment she relaxes.


"You shall find this weapon… expanded. Explore its new facets, that you may guide it toward its highest form of service."

entries.title: Whispers of the Taken I
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Eris cocks her head as you approach, listening to something you can't hear.


"Darkness binds as much as the Light," she greets you. "It connects us to each other, and to ourselves."


"Mastery of the Darkness may give one access to memories occluded from our conscious minds," she explains. "Harvest Taken Essences to coalesce this power within yourself."


"Then return to the memory of your investigation on Io," she instructs you. "Vanquish your enemies there, opening neural pathways to knowledge that even you did not know you possessed."


"Do this and I will manifest the connection as something… useful."

entries.title: Whispers of the Taken II
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Eris Morn is finishing up a call as you approach.


"Missing has to do with attention on an absence, rather than the absence of attention. A process which is entirely within one's own psyche. Think on it."


She pauses.


"I feel the same, Rat. We'll speak again soon."


Eris turns her attention to you. "Memories are what bind us. They create a collective experience from which we may construct an entirely new reality."


She reaches out and takes your weapon. "Let our communion empower you for the tribulation lying ahead."


After a moment she hands the gun back, and it feels heavier somehow.

entries.title: Whispers of the Taken II
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Eris marks your approach with a grim smile.


"Most people work tirelessly to avoid unpleasant memories," she says. "Yet you face them time and again in the pursuit of power."


"A quality you share with the Witness."


"Such power is limited only by one's own will," she explains. "And yours has yet to reach its limits."


"Continue gathering Taken Essences and delving into your investigation of the anomaly," she commands you. "I will use what you glean to ensure that you remain indominable in the face of our ancient enemy."

entries.title: Whispers of the Taken III
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Eris Morn places one hand on your weapon, and the other on your shoulder. You feel a pulsing connection, and flashes of memory wash over you.


When it ends, Eris seems to sag under her own weight.


"You've seen so much violence," she mutters. "As much as any of us. With so much more to come. I've done all I can in this matter." 


She looks into your face, searching. "Take this weapon and face whatever may come with your full power. Win for humanity what we all yearn for: a future free from the whispers of the past."


"Now go," she concludes. "I must rest."

entries.title: Whispers of the Taken III
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Eris seems fidgety as you approach. 


"The whispering. It gets louder with each visit," she says.


"I will honor my commitment to empowering you in the face of our ancient foe, but this must be the last time."


"Delving into the memories of another can produce a profound disassociation. A blurring at the edges of identity." She rubs her temples and flexes her jaw. 


"But it's nothing I haven't overcome before," she says resolutely. "Provide me with the means, and I shall fill you cup once more."

entries.title: With a Vengeance
entries.speaker: Eris Morn
entries.quote:
Eris gives you a smile of acknowledgment as you approach.


"I hear that Shaxx has you on the front lines again," she says. "Wielding weapons of ill repute, no less. The unofficial Iron Lord never was a master of subtlety."


"I would lend my expertise," she continues, "but my transformation to and from Hive godhood took a greater toll than even I anticipated. And regrettably, my body no longer recovers as quickly as it once did." 


You detect a note of persistent weariness in the former Hunter's voice. "In the absence of a Ghost, I must make do with tea and silence."


"Let me then serve as a reminder, Guardian: every creature has limits. For the Lightless, they are hard and uncompromising."


"I suggest you visit a few more of us mere mortals. Devrim and Hawthorne, for instance. I'm sure your strength will raise their spirits, as it has mine."

entries.title: A Classy Reward
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "Excellent work, dear," Eva says. "You've shown great spirit during the Games. I hope this little reward will help you remember them all year."

entries.title: A Classy Reward
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "Very impressive," Eva says with a smile. "You've earned this. Please choose your favorite. If you keep up this enthusiasm, perhaps you'll earn another next week."

entries.title: A Classy Reward
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "Well done, my friend!" Eva says. "I had these made so that Guardians of all kinds could show their appreciation for one another. Choose your favorite, and if you show the same spirit next week, you can earn another."

entries.title: A Glowing Solstice
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva makes a playful show of shielding her eyes from your glowing armor.


"I must say, isn't this a bit much? What if you were to start a fire?"


She grins as she lowers her arm and applauds you.


"It may seem like a silly thing, to place such importance on a show of light and heat. But I assure you, there is little silliness about it."


Eva turns her eyes to a nearby Solstice banner, emblazoned with a golden sun.


"Every sun sets. Every fire burns out. But if we hold their warmth in our hearts, if we keep hope alive, then eventually the sun rises again. A new fire springs to life, from the ashes of the old. Just like the phoenix."


She turns to you with a smile as bright as your armor.


"And seeing you glow? That reminds us that warmth-that hope-is still alive and well. Thank you, Guardian. And have a Happy Solstice."

entries.title: A Glowing Solstice
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva once again appraises your Candescent armor.


"Now that you've rekindled one piece of your armor, why not do the same for the others? After all, what better way to celebrate Solstice?"


She grins and waves you off, as if encouraging you to have some fun.

entries.title: A Glowing Solstice
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva once again appraises your Sunlit armor.


"Now that you've rekindled one piece of your armor, why not do the same for the others? After all, what better way to celebrate Solstice?"


She grins and waves you off, as if encouraging you to have some fun.

entries.title: A Glowing Solstice
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva once again appraises your Sublime armor.


"It's beginning to look rather radiant," she says approvingly. "Why not finish the set out? You will shine like the sun, and I for one always love to see it."


She waves you off beaming, looking forward to your progress.

entries.title: A Glowing Solstice
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva once again appraises your Lustrous armor.


"It's beginning to look rather radiant," she says approvingly. "Why not finish the set out? You will shine like the sun, and I for one always love to see it."


She waves you off beaming, looking forward to your progress.

entries.title: A Guardian in Shining Armor
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
The corners of Eva's eyes crinkle as she gives you a kindly smile.


"You shine as bright as the sun, Guardian. But knowing you, I suspect that your flame has only begun to burn."


She reaches out to offer a stack of Silver Leaves.


"Please, take these and continue celebrating Solstice. Something tells me you have more bonfires to light."

entries.title: A Guardian in Shining Armor
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva takes a moment to look over your armor.


"I see the embers of your armor glowing with renewed spirit. A small fire, wanting to grow. Perhaps with more Kindling and some Silver Ash from the bonfire, we can help it along!"

entries.title: A Spooky Good Time
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Eva smiles when you walk up. "Welcome," she says, and then gestures to the decorations adorning the Tower. "A beautiful transformation, isn't it? These decorations honor a yearly tradition here in the City. I am so pleased to invite you to be part of it."

entries.title: And to All a Good Flight
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Happy Dawning!" Eva cries as you approach. The scent of fresh cookies surrounds her like a Well of Radiance.


"Baking treats for those you care about is a Dawning tradition. I know you spend most of your time with bullets and bombs, but during the Dawning, a handful of raisins can be more important than a grenade!"


She leans close to you. "Don't tell Shaxx I said that."


"Now, I know Amanda has prepared something special for you. Why don't you bring her a fresh-baked cookie? She'd be so thankful, and I have all the ingredients right here!"

entries.title: And to All a Good Flight
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
There's pride in Eva's eyes as you approach. "Thank you for showing the commander kindness," she says.


"One thing I've learned about Zavala… he's reluctant to let himself enjoy things. The man is responsible for so much, and he feels our losses more deeply than most."


"A bite to eat, a cup of coffee," she steals a glance at Zavala, who stands in the distance, issuing orders to a group of Guardians. "Help him however you can-these are difficult times."


She looks back to you. "Now, while you've been busy spreading Dawning cheer, Amanda finished her gift for you! I know generosity is its own reward, but you deserve it."


"Tell her I wish her a happy Dawning!"

entries.title: And to All a Good Flight
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva still holds the cookie you brought her. "Thank you, dear! These are my favorite."


She takes a generous bite. "Oh," she says. "This is… it's quite…"


She swallows, then composes herself with a bright smile. "Listen," she says as she reaches up and clasps your shoulder, "what's important is that you never stop improving!"


She hands you a package. "Amanda asked me to give you this. She said she still has improvements to make, so while she works, go spread the spirit of the Dawning across the system. We can't let our friends think we've forgotten them, especially not at this time of year!"

entries.title: And to All a Good Flight
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva is grateful when you report that Eris enjoyed the cookies you brought her.


"How was she? Did she seem healthy?" she asks, then waves her hands to shoo the questions away. "I'm sorry, I just worry about that girl sometimes."


She absentmindedly pulls at the fringes of her shawl. "She holds the Darkness closer than most, and has suffered greatly for it," she says.


Eva looks up at you with a sad smile. "I hope the Dawning can bring her some joy-even if it is only once a year."

entries.title: And to All a Good Flight
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva greets you as you return from the Tangled Shore. 


"Did you bring something to that new Guardian?" she asks. She seems genuinely concerned.


"I hear he keeps to himself. It's important to respect that, but you must also reach out from time to time and make sure he feels welcome."


"No one should feel alone," she says, "especially not during the Dawning!"

entries.title: And to All a Good Flight
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva is pleased to see your return. "I hope Devrim appreciated your visit."


"I know he enjoys the occasional shortbread, but the Dawning isn't only about cookies. Your deliveries show that while the people we care about may leave our sight, they never leave our thoughts."


Eva sighs, no doubt picturing Devrim celebrating the Dawning alone in his isolated church.


"That dear man spends more time around the Fallen than he does other Guardians," she says. "I'm sure your visit meant more to him than he let on."

entries.title: And to All a Good Flight
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva nods as if expecting your question about the Dawning spirit.


"Despite our festive decorations, you may have felt… an emptiness," Eva says quietly, glancing at an untouched bowl of Radiolarian Pudding. "We have known loss before, but recently, we have faced tremendous difficulties. I fear we need the Dawning spirit this year more than ever."


The woman lifts her eyes to the peaceful sky. "But though the wind may be cold, the air remains full of stories."


"Raise the spirits of those around you. Spread hope, Guardian. Amanda will make sure you're well rewarded for your efforts, but the true reward will be in the eyes of those in need."

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Welcome to the Guardian Games!" Eva greets you warmly. "I'm glad you decided to join us. As always, Titans, Warlocks, and Hunters will all be competing against each other for yearly bragging rights."


"Let's get you a class item to make your class selection official," she says, proffering an array of fancy items.


"I've also got some Laurels to get you started," she says. "You can earn more by using your class abilities to defeat your adversaries, or by defeating especially powerful ones."


"Now, get out there and show the other classes what you're made of," she says with mock seriousness. "May the best class win!"

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Very impressive, Guardian!" Eva smiles warmly. "Now that you've gotten your bearings, you can really start showing off by earning those Medallions!"


"If you're up for a challenge, you could even try a Diamond Card. As a former couture professional, I can assure you that diamonds are always in style."

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "Very impressive, Guardian!" Eva smiles warmly. "Now that you've gotten your bearings, you can really start showing off by earning those Medallions!"

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"I see you've earned your first Medallion!" Eva's eyes twinkle with delight. "This is just the first of many."


"With skills like yours, you'll soon have more Medallions than you know what to do with!" She gives you a friendly wink.


"Here's a little something to hold all of your trophies," she says, handing you a Medallion Case. "Now you'll be able to track all of your class contributions and look back on your achievements with pride."

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"You're off to a great start," Eva encourages you, "but there's still plenty you can do!"


"The more Medallions you turn in, the more you'll help you class," she adds, "and the better individual rewards you'll earn."


"Track your weekly contributions so you know how close you are to your next reward threshold. Now go have fun with your friends," she encourages, "and earn some Medallions for your class!"

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Looks like you're all caught up on this year's Guardian Games," Eva says approvingly.


"Now, enjoy yourself by earning some Medallions for your class. And maybe even bank some points for yourself," she adds, "if you're feeling sassy." 


She lowers her voice conspiratorially. "Don't tell the other Guardians, but I saw this and thought of you." She hands you a handsome weapon. "I hope it fits."


"Go show everyone what you can do, and have fun!"

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Very impressive, Guardian!"


Eva smiles warmly. "Now that you've gotten your bearings, you can really start showing off. Get out there and start earning those Medallions. You can take on Guardian Games strikes or compete in Supremacy matches. I'm certain Zavala and Shaxx are both keeping an eye on the top contenders!" 


"Oh, but first: I set this aside for you. For good luck."

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Welcome to the Guardian Games!" Eva greets you warmly. "I'm glad you decided to join us. Once again, Titans, Warlocks, and Hunters will all be competing against each other for yearly bragging rights."


"Let's get you a class item to make your class selection official," she says, proffering an array of fancy items.


"Now, get out there and show the other classes what you're made of," she says with mock seriousness. "May the best class win!"

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"I see you've earned your first Medallion!" Eva claps her hands in delight. "The first of many, I'm sure."


"With skills like yours, you'll soon have more than you know what to do with!" She gives you a friendly wink.


"Here's a little something to hold all of your trophies," she says, handing you a Medallion Case. "Now you'll be able to track all of your class contributions and look back on your achievements with pride."

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Welcome to the Guardian Games!" Eva greets you warmly. "Once again, Titans, Warlocks, and Hunters will be competing for bragging rights. I've been hard at work with Zavala to set up a new scoring model for this year. Your Light protects us all, Guardian. The least I can do in return is give you a competition to remember!"


Eva indicates a selection of gleaming class items. "Ikora herself gave me a hand with the finishing touches on these. The bonds, marks, or cloaks of our winning class will receive a special something to make sure they stand out in any crowd-just as they will deserve."


"Now, go show the other classes what you're made of," she says with mock seriousness. "If you want those bragging rights, you'll have to earn them!"

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Very impressive, Guardian!" Eva smiles warmly. "Now that you've gotten your bearings, you can really start showing off. This year, the Vanguard has helped me set up Focus Activities. Hunters, Titans, Warlocks-you'll compete to earn the most points in an activity as a class over a limited time."


"Now get out there and start earning those Medallions!" Eva winks. "If you're up for a challenge, you could even try a Diamond Card. As a former couture professional, I can assure you that diamonds are always in style."

entries.title: But Wait, There's More!
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Isn't it a marvelous idea!" Eva exclaims as you approach. "An island in the sky. My goodness. When I was a little girl, I read stories about such things, but you Guardians can actually make them real."


She sighs, sobering as she offers you a gift: a set of ruined armor from the Red War. "But of course, the Solstice is more than just floating islands. Take this armor to the Statue of Heroes, dear. Try to think about everyone who came before you, everyone who made it possible to stand here in this Tower today…"

entries.title: Celebrating Solstice
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"You look splendid, Guardian! Speaking of which…"


Eva reaches out her hand. In her palm rests a small pile of leaves that appear to be made of silver. They shimmer in the light of the sun.


"Beautiful, aren't they? Leaves like these have been seen all across the solar system. I believe they are… what's the word? Paracausal? Yes, that is how Rahool described them."


She smiles as she presents you with the leaves.


"You know, Ms. Holliday has been planning to build a bonfire in celebration of Solstice. Doing so in the Tower could be dangerous, so Ikora has raised the European Aerial Zone into the sky once again. Why don't you bring Amanda some leaves for her fire?"


Eva meets your eyes before handing over the leaves and gives you a knowing wink. 


"And please, watch your step while you're up there."

entries.title: Celebrating Solstice
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Happy Solstice, Guardian."


Eva welcomes you to the celebration, smiling with deep warmth. 


"I am so pleased to see you here. There is always something special about Solstice, isn't there? We remember what has been, and we celebrate the life and hope of here and now, of the future yet to come with the people by our sides."


"I have asked Zavala to devise some exciting new challenges for you to overcome this year, Guardian. You'll have access to these during your Operations this Solstice. It is our hope that these will drive you to ever greater heights, and that you shine brightly for all to see."

entries.title: Celebrating Solstice
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Welcome back, Guardian." 


Eva greets you with a warm smile and a gentle wave. She looks you over and nods.


"I am glad to see you are making good use of the forge, and that you are well on your way to creating the armor of your dreams. I dare say I have nothing else to teach you this year… but I hope you'll keep coming back. There is more to forge, and I am always happy to see you."

entries.title: Celebrating Solstice
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva clasps her hands together as she greets you with a warm smile.


"What a splendid new purpose for your Silver Ash! I see how it makes your armor shine in the sunlight, a beacon of hope for all whom you encounter."


She reaches for the table, picks up a bundle of Silver Leaves, and offers them to you.


"Amanda is always looking for more leaves to build a new bonfire. Please bring these to her with my blessings, along with any other leaves you find on your adventures. The more you bring to her, the more Silver Ash the fire will leave when it has burned out. I look forward to seeing how bright you can shine!"

entries.title: Celebrating Solstice
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Did you enjoy the bonfire, Guardian?"


Eva listens as your recount your adventure in the EAZ, including throwing the Silver Leaves onto the fire and how they were transformed into Silver Ash.


"How wonderful," she remarks with a smile. "When the flames have gone out, the ashes they leave behind bring us hope for the future."


Eva inhales deeply and takes stock of the surrounding greenery.


"The spirit of Solstice is in the air, and everyone is in the mood for some well-earned celebration. I wanted to help organize the festivities, so I put together a list of things to do. Why don't you take a look?"

entries.title: Celebrating Solstice
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Happy Solstice, Guardian!"


Eva beams as you approach, gesturing to the verdant splendor that now decorates the Courtyard.


"It brings me such happiness to see life thriving in the Tower. If we focus only on what we've lost, we can easily lose sight of the hope and beauty that surrounds us."


She folds her hands in front of her and gives you a kind smile.


"Have you heard the legend of the phoenix? A mythical bird from pre-Golden Age folktales, it was said that it would burn within its own flames and rise anew from the ashes."


"That is the spirit of Solstice. Not one of sorrow, but of joy at the chance for renewal."


Reaching for the table next to her, Eva picks up a neatly wrapped package and hands it to you.


"May this gift remind you that, just like the phoenix, a bright future rises from the ashes of the past. Now go out there and celebrate all that life has to offer!"

entries.title: Celebrating Solstice
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"You look splendid, Guardian! Speaking of which…"


Eva reaches out her hand. In her palm rests a small pile of leaves that appear to be made of silver. They shimmer in the light of the sun.


"Beautiful, aren't they? Leaves like these have been seen all across the solar system. I believe they are… what's the word? Paracausal? Yes, that is how Rahool described them."


She smiles as she presents you with the leaves.


"Saint-14 and Saladin have agreed to build a bonfire in celebration of Solstice. Doing so in the Tower could be dangerous, so Ikora has raised the European Aerial Zone into the sky once again. Why don't you bring them some leaves for the fire?"


Eva meets your eyes before handing over the leaves and gives you a knowing wink. 


"And please, watch your step while you're up there."

entries.title: Celebrating Solstice
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva clasps her hands together as she greets you with a warm smile.


"What a splendid new purpose for your Silver Ash! I see how it makes your armor shine in the sunlight, a beacon of hope for all whom you encounter."


She reaches for the table, picks up a bundle of Silver Leaves, and offers them to you.


"Saint-14 and Saladin will need more leaves to build a new bonfire. Please bring these to them with my blessings, along with any other leaves you find on your adventures. The more you bring to them, the more Silver Ash the fire will leave when it has burned out. I look forward to seeing how bright you can shine!"

entries.title: Celebrating Solstice
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva greets you with a smile, as she ever does. "You're doing good work with that Forge, I see," she says, and reaches out. "Allow me? I have something that will unlock its potential for you."


She takes the Forge and, referring to a carefully-sketched diagram, removes the back panel. She keeps talking as she installs a piece that glows in a rippling, humming sort of way. "This will let you reconfigure its material needs to suit your preferences. It's all very technical." Eva laughs warmly as she closes the Forge up again and hands it back to you. 


"And you'll need these as a catalyst." The last thing she gives you is a small stack of Silver Leaves.


You can use Silver Leaves to refresh the selection of bounties per category offered in the Solstice Forge. Use this to help you better align your objectives across each of the armor piece categories. To earn more Silver Leaves, complete activities while carrying the Solstice Forge.

entries.title: Celebrating Solstice
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Welcome back, Guardian." 


Eva greets you with a warm smile and a gentle wave. She looks you over and nods.


"The Solstice Forge truly seems to suit you! I am glad to see you are making good use of it, and that you are well on your way to creating the armor of your dreams. I dare say I have nothing else to teach you this year… but I hope you'll keep coming back. There is more to forge, and I am always happy to see you."

entries.title: Celebrating Solstice
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Happy Solstice, Guardian."


Eva welcomes you to the celebration, smiling with a deep warmth. 


"I am so pleased to see you here. There is something special about Solstice, isn't there? We remember what has been, and we celebrate the life and hope of here and now, of the future yet to come with the people by our sides."


She offers you something: compact, lightweight, humming gently. 


"In honor of the occasion, a gift. This year, the Solstice Forge will help you create your new armor. I look forward to seeing what you create, Guardian. May your fire blaze ever higher!"

entries.title: Cheer Up?
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva is delighted to see the completed blueprint. She thanks you for your hard work and rewards you with a festive sparrow.


"I'm sure this will help you show off your Dawning spirit," she says warmly.

entries.title: Classic Carving
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva studies the tome beside her. "Even now, The Book of the Forgotten is simultaneously amazing and unnerving. I still don't understand how it knows whether your additions are Spectral or Manifested Pages."


She shakes her head in disbelief. "But who am I to judge after all this time? It's clearly much better at telling stories than me," she laughs. "I believe the book thrives best when you collect Spectral Pages, manifest them by fighting your way through Haunted Sectors, and then add the Manifested Pages to the book…"


"If you dare," she adds with a wink.

entries.title: Classic Carving
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Thank you for helping the Tower get into the festival spirit, Guardian," Eva says. "Here's a little something for your troubles." She hands you a package, her eyes twinkling with delight.


"Keep filling the Book of the Forgotten with those Manifested Pages, and don't forget to visit me from time to time," she encourages you. "I've got plenty of masks, treats, and festival gear to go around!"


Eva grasps your hands warmly. "Happy Festival of the Lost, Guardian!"

entries.title: Classic Carving
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "I found one more gift for you to finish the festival strong."

entries.title: Classic Carving
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva's eyes twinkle as she gives you a warm smile. "There you are." 


She reaches behind her, picking up a mask. "I made this just for you. I patterned it from a similar one that Maria had when she was little. Her head was a bit smaller though." 


She chuckles fondly. "Well, try it on!"

entries.title: Classic Carving
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "Hello, dear. Would you believe that this old lady has a new trick up her sleeve?" she asks with a wink. "If you bring back the mask, I'll tailor some personal touches in. You'll love it."

entries.title: Classic Carving
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Thanks for helping the Tower get in the festival spirit, Guardian," Eva says. "Here's a little something to help you on your expeditions." She hands you a package, her eyes twinkling with delight.


"Keep filling the Book of the Forgotten with those Manifested Pages, and don't forget to visit me from time to time," she encourages you. "I've got plenty of masks, treats, and festival gear to go around!"


She leans in and whispers conspiratorially, "And do watch out for that grumpy Hive Ghost. He is nothing but trouble if you ask me. Keep Eido and Glint close by if you can-it'll put my worrying mind at ease."


Eva grasps your hands warmly. "Happy Festival of the Lost, Guardian!"

entries.title: Classic Carving
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva's expression warms as she sees you. "Happy Festival of the Lost, dear! I am so grateful that you are here, celebrating. I know this can be a bittersweet time for many of us, and it is important that we acknowledge our grief as well as our joy. I hope you will allow yourself as much time as you need to embrace all the feelings you hold in your heart this year."


She motions toward the pedestal beside her. "And when you find yourself in the mood for a little mystery or magic, I have no doubt that you will discover something ghoulish in the latest volume of the Book of the Forgotten!"


"Just watch out for anyone trying to spoil the celebration for you. I'm sure they'll be nothing but trouble," she says with a wink.

entries.title: Classic Carving
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "There's no better way to scare up some Spectral Pages than with a festival mask!" -Eva Levante

entries.title: Classic Carving
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Thank you for feeding the Book of the Forgotten," Eva says appreciatively. "If you keep giving it Manifested Pages, I'm sure it will reveal some fascinating tales."


"Take a peek at your Event Card, and don't forget about the masks and goody bags I've prepared for all the Guardians!" She gestures proudly to an array of handmade crafts and treats.


"Nothing like a creepy sweet to get us in the festival spirit!"

entries.title: Classic Carving
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva looks relieved as you stride into the Courtyard.


"You've got some Manifested Pages? Thank goodness. I get the strangest feeling that the Book of the Forgotten is… hungry." She regards the book with concern. "I could swear I heard it grumbling."


Eva waves you over to the tome. "Add your Manifested Pages to the book, Guardian. Hopefully that will keep it quiet!"

Eva studies the tome beside her. "Even now, The Book of the Forgotten is simultaneously amazing and unnerving. I still don't understand how it conjures up the stories."


She shakes her head in disbelief. "It's clearly much better at telling stories than me," she laughs. "I believe the book thrives best when you collect Manifested Pages and then add them to the book…"


"If you dare," she adds with a wink.

entries.title: Cookie Delivery Helper
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Eva grips your hand tightly as you approach and smiles warmly.  "You've been busy this year. I'm sure our new Aionian friends and that adorable Exo puppy were delighted with what you baked them. But no doubt you can come up with a few more recipes to make in that Dawning oven. I'll bet your old friends throughout the system could use a tasty treat. You've all fought hard this year, faced existential dread-again. I'm sure they'll all be glad to spend some time with you outside of a crisis." She gives you a rosy-cheeked wink "Here's a few ingredients to get you started."

entries.title: Dawning Delivery
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva accepts the cookies with a warm smile. "Happy Dawning to you," she says. "Things may be grim at times, but the world is full of things that remind us never to give up hope."


She laughs. "I'm talking about you, Guardian. Of course, the cookies help, too."

entries.title: Dawning Duty
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "A gift need not be material. Sometimes your presence, a little favor, or some advice is just as welcome. The Dawning is a time to care for one another." -Eva Levante

entries.title: Drop In
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva has a special offering for you this year: Earth's homegrown take on a Cloudstrider's skyboard, built for swift movement and flashy tricks. 


This brand-new Skimmer comes courtesy of a mysterious benefactor with an equally mysterious message: "A peace offering, to a place that used to be home."  


"That's a nice sentiment, isn't it?" Eva smiles warmly. "Now, the Games are all about the spirit of friendly competition. If you want to keep this Skimmer after the Games end, you'll have to earn it!"


Eva gives you a grandmotherly wink. "I've left some choice open in how you do, which means there's room for the most important element of all: personal style."

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Congratulations, my friend!" Eva says, beaming. "The Warlock banner rose to the top yesterday, bringing your team one step closer to the Guardian Games Cup."


She hands you a reward for your contributions. "Take this reward for your excellent work. And don't let up-the Hunters and Titans won't!"

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"You are doing your team proud, my dear," Eva says. "Even in adversity, you Warlocks show us all how to be resolute in our goals. Perhaps today will be your day."


She hands you a reward for your contributions. "Take this reward for your part in yesterday's competition. Well done, and don't give up."

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Congratulations, my friend!" Eva says, beaming. "The Hunter banner rose to the top yesterday, bringing your team one step closer to the Guardian Games Cup."


She hands you a reward for your contributions. "Take this for your excellent work. And don't let up-the Titans and Warlocks won't!"

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"You are doing your team proud, my dear," Eva says. "Even in adversity, you Titans show us all how to stand strong. Perhaps today will be your day."


She hands you a reward for your contributions. "Take this reward for your part in yesterday's competition. Well done, and don't give up."

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"What a terrific effort you Warlocks made yesterday!" Eva says. "Silver looks good on you. But I see the fire in your eyes-you want the gold!"


She laughs. "Don't give up, my friend. Please take this reward for all of your efforts so far. Let it inspire you as you move forward."

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"What a terrific effort you Hunters made yesterday!" Eva says. "Silver looks good on you. But I see the fire in your eyes-you want the gold!"


She laughs. "Don't give up, my friend. Please take this reward for all of your efforts so far. Let it inspire you as you move forward."

She hands you a reward for your contributions. "Take this reward for your part in yesterday's competition. Well done, and don't give up."

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Congratulations, my friend!" Eva says, beaming. "The Titan banner rose to the top yesterday, bringing your team one step closer to the Guardian Games Cup."


She hands you a reward for your contributions. "Take this for your excellent work. And don't let up-the Hunters and Warlocks won't!"

entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"What a terrific effort you Titans made yesterday!" Eva says. "Silver looks good on you. But I see the fire in your eyes-you want the gold!"


She laughs. "Don't give up, my friend. Please take this reward for all of your efforts so far. Let it inspire you as you move forward."

entries.title: Festival of the Lost
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Welcome to the Festival of the Lost, Guardian," Eva says. "The people of the City use this time to celebrate life and remember the lost. We eat sweets, light candles, and wear masks to scare away our own fears."


She smiles. "The other vendors in the Tower may have some gifts for you. Go and wish each of them good tidings this holiday."

entries.title: Festival of the Lost
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva waves as you approach. "Happy Festival of the Lost, Guardian. This time of year reminds us that no one is truly lost as long as we remember them."


She raises her eyebrows at the nearby Book of the Forgotten. "Of course, some things are better left forgotten."


She gives you a cheeky smile. "But you and Glint will discover that for yourselves, I'm sure. Be safe out there!"

entries.title: Festival of the Lost
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva waves as you approach. "Happy Festival of the Lost, Guardian! This time of year reminds us that no one is truly lost as long as we remember them."


She raises her eyebrows at the nearby Book of the Forgotten. "Of course, some things may be better left unremembered."


She gives you a cheeky smile. "But you and Eido will discover that for yourselves, I'm sure. Be safe out there!"

entries.title: From Eva, for Solstice
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: A gift from Eva celebrating the Solstice of Heroes. Refit courtesy of Amanda Holliday.

entries.title: Gone but Not Forgotten
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva looks shocked as you hold up the Manifested Pages.


"My goodness," she exclaims. "I didn't think you'd actually find physical proof of the Headless Ones. Glint must be so pleased!"


Eva waves you over to the Book of the Forgotten. "Add your findings to the book. Soon we'll have a tome for the ages!"

entries.title: Gone but Not Forgotten
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"So you and Glint proved that the Headless Ones really do exist," Eva says with raised eyebrows. "I can't wait to read your additions to Book of the Forgotten." 


"Please continue adding pages as you discover them, and don't forget about the masks and treats I prepared." She motions to an enticing array of goodies.


She fixes you with a kindly smile. "Happy Festival of the Lost, Guardian."

entries.title: Gone but Not Forgotten
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"It's so good of you to help Glint on his little research project, looking for the Headless Ones," Eva says as she hands you a Festival Mask.


"I wouldn't expect you to find anything," she says conspiratorially, "but that shouldn't stop you from enjoying the festive spirit."


"Whatever you do or don't discover, remember to come back for some special goodies, and a peek at the Book of the Forgotten!"

entries.title: Gone but Not Forgotten
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"You're very kind to accompany Eido on her research expedition," Eva says as she hands you a mask.


"I don't think she would last long on her own," she says confidentially, "but I'll rest easy knowing you're watching over her."


"Whatever you do or don't discover, remember to come back for some special goodies, and a peek at the Book of the Forgotten!"

entries.title: Gone but Not Forgotten
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"The Book of the Forgotten is amazing," Eva says, eying the tome warily. "But I'm not afraid to say that it gives me the creeps."


"Somehow it knows whether the pages you're adding are Spectral or Manifested." She shakes her head in disbelief. "How could it know a thing like that?! It's unnatural."


"Best to keep it happy," Eva continues. "Collect Spectral Pages, manifest them by fighting your way through Haunted Sectors, then add the Manifested Pages to the book…"


"If you dare," she adds with a wink.

entries.title: Gone but Not Forgotten
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Thanks for helping the Tower get in the Festival spirit, Guardian," Eva says. "Here's a little something to help you on your expeditions." She hands you a package of rewards, her eyes twinkling with delight.


"Keep filling the Book of the Forgotten with those Manifested Pages, and don't forget to visit me from time to time," she encourages you. "I've got plenty of masks, treats, and Festival gear to go around!"


She leans in and whispers conspiratorially, "And do look after that young Eido, won't you? She doesn't seem quite seasoned enough to go it alone. It'll put my worrying mind at ease."


Eva grasps your hands warmly. "Happy Festival of the Lost, Guardian!"

Eva looks relieved as you stride into the Courtyard.


"You've got some Manifested Pages? Thank goodness. I get the strangest feeling that the Book of the Forgotten is… hungry." She regards the book with concern. "I could swear I heard it grumbling."


Eva waves you over to the tome. "Add your Manifested Pages to the book, Guardian. Hopefully that will keep it quiet!"

"Take a peek at your Event Card, and don't forget about the masks and goody bags I've prepared for all the Guardians!" She gestures proudly to an array of handmade crafts and treats.


"Nothing like a creepy sweet to get us in the Festival spirit!"

entries.title: Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Welcome to the ceremony! At the end of each week, everyone celebrates their contributions and receives rewards for their efforts. Go to the podium and see how you and your fellow Guardians did this week.

entries.title: Guardian Games Registration
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Isn't the Guardian Games podium lovely?" Eva asks. "Many people in the Tower came together to create it. That is where we will track the progress of your class across the event. The class banners will rise and fall depending on your place in the competition."


She smiles. "Even the Drifter took part. He was kind enough to donate his deposit technology. It only took a little convincing." She hands you a medal. "Bring this to him, and he will register your new class item. Then you can deposit this medal and begin the Games."

entries.title: …Into the Future
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Your voice is unleashed.

entries.title: Key to Power
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Eva beams with pride. "Well done, my dear. That kind of work ethic will carry you through your whole life… let alone the summer! Ha!"

entries.title: Let the Games Begin
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"You're ready to start the Games, Guardian," Eva says. "I will have medal challenges for you every day. These challenges will allow you to support your class in the Games. Every medal you deposit at the Guardian Games podium will improve your class's daily standing."


She smiles. "Good luck, Guardian. Make your class proud. And have fun."

entries.title: Masked Purpose
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Welcome, welcome!" Eva says with a smile, though it's clear the normal cheer in her eyes is somewhat diminished. "An auspicious start to the festival this year, isn't it? But what time is more important to remember those who have passed than in the face of impending loss? The sacrifices of those who came before allow us to be here today, making it all the more important that we acknowledge them."


"I know it's… beyond belief out there. I know people are scared. But fear is normal; fear is a human reaction. You can be afraid and still be brave. That's part of what the masks of the festival show us. We can be strong on the outside, even if we're frightened within."

entries.title: Masks Upon Masks
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva seems relieved that you've returned safely from the Haunted Forest.


"I heard what the Spider asked you to do, and during the Festival of the Lost of all times!" Eva scowls. "I don't appreciate being manipulated into putting a Guardian at risk for some Glimmer or whatever treasure he had you hunting, but at least it ended well. Here, let me give you a little something extra for all your trouble."


"And if nothing else good comes of this, I learned a valuable lesson about dealing with the Spider…"


"Don't."

entries.title: Master Class
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Master Class



        "Well done, dear," Eva says with a warm smile. "You are a perfect example of the Guardian Games spirit. And you've made your class proud." She gives you a gift to thank you for all your work. "Keep enjoying the Games."

entries.title: Mystery Gifts
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "Exchanging presents is time-honored Festival of the Lost tradition. Bring your extra sweets to me and trade them for a gift." -Eva Levante

entries.title: Nadir to Apex
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Your voice is unleashed.

entries.title: On Your Laurels
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"I've set up a little challenge for you Guardians," Eva says. "The rewards are three handsome Ghost Shells to allow you and your Ghost to remember the Games all year long. Play hard each week and you can earn all three."


She smiles. "It will be a lovely way to celebrate Guardians of every shape and size."

entries.title: On Your Laurels
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "Excellent work, dear," Eva says. "You've shown great spirit during the Games. I hope this little reward will help you remember them all year."

entries.title: On Your Laurels
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "Very impressive," Eva says with a smile. "You've earned this. Please choose your favorite. If you keep up this enthusiasm, perhaps you'll earn another next week."

entries.title: On Your Laurels
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "Well done, my friend!" Eva says. "I had these made so that Guardians of all kinds could show their appreciation for one another. Choose your favorite, and if you show the same spirit next week, you can earn another."

entries.title: Reforged in the Light
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: You tell Eva about your meditation. She nods. "The greatest thing we can do to honor those we've lost is to live well and be our best selves. Take that armor. Go out into the world. Reforge it. Make it into a symbol of something strong and proud and beautiful."

entries.title: Rekindle the Spark
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Brilliant! I can already see the fire of your armor burning anew. What a perfect expression of Solstice!"


Eva takes your hands in hers and presses a bundle of Silver Leaves into your palm.


"And as with Solstice itself, this is not an end, but a new beginning. Rekindle the rest of your armor, and shine brighter than the tallest bonfire."

entries.title: Rekindle the Spark
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"It seems that your armor's long-extinguished power is ready to be reignited. All you need is a spark."


Eva inspects your armor and nods to herself with a twinkle in her eye.


"Gather more Silver Ash and Kindling, and let's see if we can set your armor ablaze once again!"

entries.title: Rite of Dawning
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva listens to your story of bringing Dawning cheer to Caiatl's Cabal. Though she doesn't quite agree with the rampant bloodshed, she understands the importance of respecting tradition, and she admits that she's gone to similar lengths to bring cookies to those who truly deserve them.


She looks over toward Zavala, sees his smile, and thanks you dearly.


Then she sits back down and returns to what she had been busy doing: knitting an absolutely massive pair of Dawning booties.

entries.title: Rite of Dawning
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
As always, Eva Levante seems to be surrounded by a brightness and cheer that cuts through the tension of the Tower.


"Welcome, Guardian," she says warmly. "I was wondering if you could assist me in something of a diplomatic matter."


"Our dear Commander Zavala has been maintaining our alliance with Caiatl and her Cabal through sheer will. I thought he might appreciate a little help, and what better way to make Caiatl feel included than a festive gesture?"


She frowns in thought. "I considered knitting her a pair of Dawning booties, but her feet are… beyond my abilities. If you bring this up to Zavala, he might be able to think of something. He is such a clever fellow."


She clasps your hands in hers. "Go on, spread the Dawning spirit among all friends of the Vanguard!"

entries.title: Share the Dawning Spirit
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Look at all the wonderful gifts the people of the Last City have sent you, Guardian!"


Eva stands beaming among the piles of presents. "I knew you would spread hope throughout the system, but this is amazing, even for you!"


"I have always been proud of you. When things looked their worst, I knew you were out there fighting to make it right. When the Pyramids came, when the Darkness took…"


Eva falls silent for a long moment, then smiles.


"I have always been proud of you, Guardian," she says. "Let's leave it at that."

entries.title: Share the Dawning Spirit
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva smiles as she shows you the Dawning gifts sent from the grateful people of the Last City.


"You're doing so well out there," she says. "Keep lifting their spirits and there will be more to come!"

entries.title: Solstice of Heroes 2020
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Your voice is unleashed.

entries.title: Sophisticated Sculpting
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Guardian! I'm so glad you've been able to 'carve' some time out for the festival," Eva says and laughs.


"But you should know that stories have begun to surface of Haunted Sectors with even more formidable adversaries. Be wary, as they likely will not be easily defeated. I leave it to you to determine what challenges you wish to pursue this festival. But as I always say, overcoming greater challenges always leads to greater rewards!"


She smiles at you encouragingly. "And if anyone can overcome, I know it is you! Show the whole City how to triumph with bravery and skill."

entries.title: Sophisticated Sculpting
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva rushes forward to greet you. "My dear, what marvelous things you have accomplished so far this festival! I have been telling everyone about your adventures because I am so impressed."


She presses a reward into your hands. "You deserve this for everything you have done. Thank you for continuing to be the inspiration this City needs. May you continue to light the way for the rest of us!"

entries.title: Sweetness and Light
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "What a bounty! I hope you didn't play too many tricks to earn these treats!" -Eva Levante

entries.title: The Dawning
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Did Zavala like his gift?" Eva asks, and then laughs. "Whether he said so or not, I assure you he did."


She smiles. "Go on, then. Spread some cheer. You'll discover even more ingredients and recipes on your travels. I'm sure you'll find what you need to make gifts for everyone on your list."

entries.title: The Dawning
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Welcome to the Dawning, Guardian," Eva says. "At this time of year, the City joins together to celebrate and give thanks for all we have."


She smiles. "Last year, I asked Guardians to bake gifts for their friends using my Holiday Oven. I've improved the oven since then, and I would love to lend it to you again. I think you should begin by baking a gift for our dear Commander Zavala."

entries.title: The Dawning
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Welcome to the Dawning, Guardian," Eva says. "At this time of year, the City joins together to celebrate and give thanks for all we have."


She smiles. "And what's a celebration without some fresh-baked treats? Now, I can't do it all myself, so I'm going to lend you my Holiday Oven."


She clasps her hands in excitement. "Oh, I can't wait to see what you come up with! I think you should begin by baking a gift for our dear Commander Zavala."

entries.title: The Dawning
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Did Zavala like his gift?" Eva asks, and then laughs. "Whether he said so or not, I assure you, he did."


She smiles. "Go on, then. Spread some cheer. You'll discover even more ingredients and recipes on your travels. I'm sure you'll find what you need to make gifts for everyone on your list."


"Before you go, Guardian, I have a small gift for you. With this Dawning Spirit, I can give you a bit of an upgrade!"

entries.title: The Dawning
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva claps her hands together as you approach, causing a cloud of cinnamon-scented flour to puff into the air. "How wonderful, Guardian!" she says. "I can use the Dawning Spirit you collect to help spread holiday cheer much more efficiently."


She nudges you. "What, you didn't think old Eva cared about things like maximizing productivity? Trust me, if I could spread Dawning cheer by baking one enormous cookie for the whole Tower instead of a hundred little ones, I would!"


The old woman sighs wistfully. "Maybe someday…"


"Anyway," she says and pats your Holiday Oven, "peek in there to see how much Dawning Spirit you've gathered, and let me know how you're coming along! Let's make this a Dawning to remember!"

entries.title: The Dawning Begins
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Welcome to the Dawning, Guardian," Eva says. "At this time of year, the City joins together to celebrate and give thanks for all we have."


She smiles. "Last year, I asked Guardians to bake gifts for their friends using my Holiday Oven. I've improved the oven since then, and I would love to lend it to you again. I think you should begin by baking a gift for our dear Commander Zavala."

entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Did Zavala like his gift?" Eva asks, and then laughs. "Whether he said so or not, I assure you he did."


She smiles. "Go on, then. Spread some cheer. You'll discover even more ingredients and recipes on your travels. I'm sure you'll find what you need to make gifts for everyone on your list."

entries.title: The Dawning: Eva's Return
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Eva congratulates you on brightening Zavala's day, encourages you to discover new recipes, and rewards you with a gift from Amanda Holliday.

entries.title: The Dawning: Eva's Return
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Eva Levante has returned to the Tower and welcomes you to this year's Dawning. She entrusts you with a treasured family heirloom, and she suggests you put it to good use.

entries.title: The End Is Nigh
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Speak to Eva Levante in the Tower.



        The Festival of the Lost is nearing its end. Be sure to collect any remaining masks and participate in all associated activities this week!


Happy Festival of the Lost!

entries.title: The Games Begin
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "Before you can participate in the Games, every Guardian must first pledge their support for a class. You can only pick one, and your accomplishments will be credited to that class, so choose wisely! Just follow your heart; you can't go wrong."

entries.title: The Games Begin
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Represent your class, earn some Laurels, and pick up a Contender Card!

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Eva encourages you to speak to Zavala about the Guardian Games. He can help get you started.

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Eva Levante has transformed the Tower once again. She invites you to take part in a new City tradition: the Guardian Games.

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"You're ready to start the Games, Guardian," Eva says. "I will have medal challenges for you every day. These challenges will allow you to support your class in the Games. Every medal you deposit at the Guardian Games podium will improve your class's daily standing."


She smiles. "Good luck, Guardian. Make your class proud. And have fun."

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "Isn't the Guardian Games podium lovely? That's where we'll honor the accomplishments of our amazing Guardians. The rising or falling banners will track the progress of your class across the event. Your individual accomplishments will be tracked in your very own medal case!"

entries.title: The Holiday Begins
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Eva is glad to see you. She congratulates your contributions to the defense of the City, then tells you that this year's Solstice is special-Ikora, along with a small group of Warlocks, have come up with an unusual surprise… but she's not spilling the secret. You'll have to go see for yourself.

entries.title: The Mystery of the Missing Bags
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Guardian," Eva intones, face backlit with the flickering light of holiday candles. "Listen now to my tale of vengeance and woe!"


She waggles her outspread fingers, making the shadows around her dance. But her tone is serious.


"I arranged Mystery Grab Bags to give everyone an exciting and meaningful Festival of the Lost. And now some of them have gone missing! I suspect someone hungry, lurking around in a basement… if you catch my DRIFT."


"I see you're ready for the Festival with a very official mask of your own. In the spirit of the season, I'd appreciate if you found the culprit and gave them a good scare."


Eva leans in to whisper conspiratorially to you. "Don't tell the other Guardians, but if you help me out, you can keep one of the bags for yourself."

entries.title: The Pigeon Provides
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
You tell Eva about Saint and the Eliksni.


"I told you he was kind, didn't I?" she asks. "Though I'm sure you weren't surprised. Anyone who knows him can see it."


She pauses to watch an Eliksni hatchling run past on its way to the Hangar. A caregiver follows behind, a cloth belt of infants bound tightly across their chest. The caregiver notices Eva and raises a tentative claw in greeting.


Eva waves back warmly, then breaks into a grin as a half-dozen tiny hands reach from the swaddling to return the wave. The Eliksni chirps with laughter and runs off after the hatchling.


"You know, Guardian," Eva says happily, "I think this may be the best Dawning yet."

entries.title: The Pigeon Provides
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva Levante turns to greet you when you arrive, but her eyes do not have their usual twinkle. "Hello, Guardian," she says. "If you came here looking for someone to fill you with Dawning cheer…"


She sighs. "…you've come to the wrong place."


"Because, my dear, old Eva is no longer the kindest person in the Tower. I believe that title now belongs to Saint-14."


"Listen," she insists. "He told me what he plans to do this Dawning, and when he did, my heart melted. Please, go to him. Have him tell you what he intends to do and then, I beg you, help him achieve it."


She pulls at the edge of her scarf. "This last year was difficult for all of us, but especially Saint. With Osiris being… with what happened with Osiris and all."


"That is the kind of thing that could break a man, you know," she says softly. "But Saint… that man's heart is so big…"


Eva covers her eyes with her hand. You give her a reassuring touch on the arm and leave her to herself.

entries.title: The Power of Friendship
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
Eva smiles warmly as you approach. She already holds a small parcel in her hands, as though she had been anticipating your arrival.


"One of my favorite parts of the Dawning is that I get to see my favorite people every day," she says as she hands you the parcel.


"Thank you for taking the time to visit me. Now, go spread this good cheer with the rest of your friends!"

entries.title: The Revelry Begins
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "Make your way to the Verdant Forest! The Vanguard and Osiris have prepared a celebration just for you." -Eva Levante

entries.title: The Revelry Begins
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "The Revelry honors you and everything you do, Guardian. Celebrate it however you want. The Vanguard has helped me put together a festival across the solar system." -Eva Levante

entries.title: The Revelry Begins
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Welcome to the Revelry, Guardian. Here's a little pick-me-up to help your celebration along.

entries.title: The Season of Giving
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Eva's welcoming smile is even warmer than usual. She offers you a reward to celebrate your Dawning spirit.

entries.title: The Solstice Begins
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Isn't it a marvelous idea!" Eva exclaims as you approach. "An island in the sky. My goodness. When I was a little girl, I read stories about such things, but you Guardians can actually make them real."


She sighs, sobering as she offers you a gift: a set of ruined armor from the Red War. "But of course, the Solstice is more than just floating islands. Take this armor to the Statue of Heroes, dear. Try to think about everyone who came before you, everyone who made it possible to stand here in this Tower today…"

entries.title: The Solstice Begins
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: You tell Eva about your meditation. She nods. "The greatest thing we can do to honor those we've lost is to live well and be our best selves. Take that armor. Go out into the world. Reforge it. Make it into a symbol of something strong and proud and beautiful."

entries.title: The Solstice Begins
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
You tell Eva about your meditation. She nods. "The greatest thing we can do to honor those we've lost is to live well and be our best selves. The same is true of your armor. Make it as strong and proud as you are."


She extends another gift. "Take this to protect and guide you on your quest."

entries.title: The Solstice Begins
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Eva is glad to see you. She lauds your incursions into the Vex network and your alliance with Mithrax. In gratitude, she gifts you a beautiful, but tarnished, helmet.

entries.title: The Solstice Begins
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "Isn't it a marvelous idea!" Eva exclaims as you approach. "An island in the sky. My goodness. When I was a little girl, I read stories about such things, but you Guardians can actually make them real."

entries.title: The Treasure Hunt
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Eva beams with pride. "Well done, my dear. That kind of work ethic will carry you through your whole life… let alone the summer! Ha!"

entries.title: Top 10% Scorer
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "A truly impressive showing! You've proved yourself to be one of the top Guardians of any class. I hope you'll wear this emblem with the pride it deserves." -Eva Levante

entries.title: Top of Class
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Put your best Light forward in pursuit of a world-class weapon!

entries.title: Unnamed Interaction
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "The Revelry honors you and everything you do, Guardian. Celebrate it however you want. The Vanguard has helped me put together a festival across the solar system." -Eva Levante

entries.title: Unnamed Interaction
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: "Make your way to the Verdant Forest! The Vanguard and Osiris have prepared a celebration just for you." -Eva Levante

entries.title: Unnamed Interaction
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Welcome to the Revelry, Guardian. Here's a little pick-me-up to help your celebration along.

entries.title: Wearing Masks
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote:
"Ominous tidings for the festival this year, aren't they?" Eva asks with subtle tension. She smiles through it, wearing a mask of quiet confidence.


"Why don't you try on a mask, join in the festivities? We can all find a little strength in them.


"And… normally I'd leave it at that, but we received a rather generous shipment of essential supplies for the festival from-of all people-the Spider, that scoundrel baron of the Tangled Shore. Keeping in line with his reputation, he called it an investment rather than a gift.


"The Spider's asked for a favor in return, but he said he'd only relay it to his… favorite associate. Would you be a dear and see what it is he wants? I think it's best for everyone if we stay on his good side."

entries.title: Winter Night
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: There's a shine in Eva's eyes as bright as freshly fallen snow when she hands you your reward. "I get older and older, and you always look the same," she says, smiling. "Don't waste the time that you have. You never do, but I'll say it anyway."

entries.title: Winter Night
entries.speaker: Eva Levante
entries.quote: Eva smiles at you as you approach. "I've got something you might like. But you know how I feel about rewards: they're best when earned. Let's see you bring some Dawning cheer to the enemies of humanity." Her eyes narrow. "Find them. Hit them with snowballs."

entries.title: Hard Evidence
entries.speaker: Evidence Board
entries.quote:
The Osmic Fragment gleams in the center of the board. Ghost's scan established that this is made of Fundamental Osmium, a super-dense transition metal found in the Throne World. 


However, it did not originate there. You spot a Hidden analysis on the material: "This particular variant sources from the planet Fundament; aka the origin world of the proto-Hive, who lived on floating elemental continents. See: the Osmium Court, birthplace of the Hive gods." 


So, Savathûn imbued her throne world with a little slice of home. But that still doesn't explain the paracausal trace lingering on these specific fragments. Nor does it account for the Lucent Brood's reaction. They definitely seemed more hostile than nostalgic… 


You consider all this as you cast your eyes over the other Hidden reports, looking for more connections.


So far, nothing else stands out. Report back later for further developments.

entries.title: Hard Evidence
entries.speaker: Evidence Board
entries.quote:
This is the Evidence Board, the main hub of intel for the Hidden's investigations into Mars and Savathûn's throne world. 


You scan the few reports posted around the edges of the board. Clearly, Ikora's agents have been working hard, but they haven't had much luck finding concrete evidence. 


Fynch's mysterious fragment gleams darkly in your inventory. He was convinced it was linked to something shady with the Lucent Hive. And Ikora did say to log "anything of relevance" here… 


But first, you should confirm just what this fragment is. 


You've seen metallic ore similar to this in the Throne World. You should find a sample for comparison. Maybe there are others with the same paracausal resonance. 


Search the Quagmire for a sample to match the Osmic Fragment.

entries.title: Report: ALTAR-REFLECT
entries.speaker: Evidence Board
entries.quote:
A new report awaits you on the Evidence Board. The Hidden have all but confirmed the emergence of a new access point to the Altar of Reflection.  


With Savathûn out of commission, this chance to delve into another of her memories is too good to pass up. 


Ikora wants you to bring the Enigma to the Altar and see if you can uncover any remaining psychic traces. The Glaive is the investigation's strongest link between the Relic and the Witch Queen.


In fact, it's the only link you have. If you're looking for answers to Ikora's lingering questions-why Savathûn chose to reappear over Mars, what her Ghost is up to, what they know about the Witness and what's to come-then the Altar is your best shot.


Bring the Enigma to the new Altar access point in the Temple of the Wrathful and see what you can uncover.

entries.title: Report: ALTAR-REFLECT
entries.speaker: Evidence Board
entries.quote:
"I make the weapon mine. But I do not keep it… I use it as a lure." 


Savathûn was talking about the Enigma. Which you shaped with the Relic, thanks to the fragment you found on her ship.


Your mind whirrs through the logic of Savathûn's plan. By converting to the Light, she lost her memories and her Darkness-borne magic. Thus, she needed a Guardian who could harness the power of Deepsight via the Relic. 


And what better way to lure a Guardian than with the promise of a powerful weapon? 


There's an addendum to the original report: "Continued monitoring of emergent threshold (aka the Altar of Reflection) revealed previously unreported paracausal mutability, in external locational point, and presumably, internal context."


In other words, you can expect that the access point of the Altar will change-as will the tales you hear within. Still, if the Hive God of Cunning has more to say, it would be worth it to listen. 


Visit the Altar of Reflection regularly. See if you can glean the truth from Savathûn's lies.

entries.title: Report: PYRAMID-INSPECT
entries.speaker: Evidence Board
entries.quote:
You walk up to the Evidence Board and select a file. It contains a message, not from Ikora or the Hidden… but Mara Sov.


"While investigating the Sunken Pyramid, I encountered Scorn amassing in large numbers within. Regardless of how many of the wretches I slaughtered, more flooded in to take their place.


With Rhulk dead, we naturally assumed they would abandon the Pyramid, but clearly they have other plans. Furthermore, they appeared to be co-opting Hive magics for reasons I was unable to decipher. Perhaps this has something to do with your ongoing investigation.


I have not the time to stay and fight; more urgent matters call my attention away. This situation, however, should be attended to promptly, as the Scorn show no signs of slowing their advance."


The Scorn using Hive magic, huh? That is curious. A lead from the Awoken Queen is certainly worth checking out.


Investigate the Sunken Pyramid in the Throne World to learn why the Scorn are rising up and how to put a stop to it.

entries.title: Report: PYRAMID-INSPECT
entries.speaker: Evidence Board
entries.quote:
In your explorations of the Pyramid, you've learned that the Scorn were attempting to increase their power by using resonant runes stolen from the Lucent Brood in combination with worm larvae. 


Based on the reports from those who first entered to defeat Rhulk, it seems these ritualistic experiments were a holdover from the plans of the disciple himself. 


One Hidden agent goes so far as to speculate that the Scorn Caretaker was itself the result of a successful worm-fusion.


Whatever the Scorn know of Immaru's plans, it's enough to motivate them to enhance their power further in order to counter his moves. 


The Pyramid should be continuously monitored, as the Scorn show no signs of slowing down. Visit the Pyramid regularly to clear the area.

entries.title: Report: RELIC-DATA
entries.speaker: Evidence Board
entries.quote:
New intel awaits you on the Evidence Board:


"Paracausal energy signatures detected in Evidence A (aka Osmic Fragment) share indeterminate link with temporal 'patterns' consumed by Artifact X (aka the Relic). So far, Evidence A elicits no response from Artifact X, but more investigation is needed."


In other words, the Darkness energy infused in the Osmic Fragments from Fynch is compatible with the Relic. Those energy readings are strikingly similar to the Weapon Patterns used to operate the Relic. The Hidden think the fragments are essentially weak, incomplete Weapon Patterns, but they need more data to be certain.


Shape more weapons using the Relic to confirm this connection. By analyzing complete Patterns, you might be able to determine whether the Osmic Fragments are truly compatible with the Relic.

entries.title: Report: RELIC-DATA
entries.speaker: Evidence Board
entries.quote:
You confirmed that the Relic, when paired with Weapon Patterns, allows the user to reach through time, rearranging memories into weaponry. There's no telling what else it can do in the hands of a powerful entity like the Witness.


Ikora posited before that the Relic caused the temporal wounds on Mars's surface. You believe she's right, and that the Witness used the device to learn about the planet's Golden Age and Collapse, leaving Mars irreversibly damaged.


Your report states that the Weapon Patterns you used are essentially Darkness-infused "memory road maps" to the weapons the Relic creates. The Osmic Fragments are a weaker, incomplete road map-but with enough fragments, someone could build the equivalent of a Weapon Pattern.


The Relic is clearly capable of anything from creating weapons to tearing the fabric of reality. If Immaru gathers enough Osmic Fragments and finds a way to approximate the functions of the Relic-perhaps by using the runes you discovered in the Throne World-there's no telling what he might create.


In the meantime, there are other angles of investigation to consider. Check the other Hidden reports for more leads.

entries.title: Report: RESONANCE-COMP
entries.speaker: Evidence Board
entries.quote:
The complementary resonance led you to three resonant Hive runes, fiercely protected by the Lucent Brood. From there, Ghost was able to lock onto the signal of a nearby Osmic Fragment, which led directly to your prime suspect: Immaru, Savathûn's Ghost. 


What could he be planning with these Osmic Fragments? How do the resonant Hive runes fit in? Is this where the connection to the Relic lies? 


You step back and stare at the empty space on the board. Soon, it'll be filled with evidence. 


Report back later for further developments.

entries.title: Report: RESONANCE-COMP
entries.speaker: Evidence Board
entries.quote:
A Hidden report awaits you on the Evidence Board.


"New paracausal resonance detected in three key locations. Preliminary analysis suggests complementary match for Evidence A (aka Osmic Fragment). Telemetry linked for further analysis."


You examine the resonance comparison. The wavelengths complement each other perfectly. Where one signal dips into a valley, the other peaks, and vice versa. 


Clearly, there's something (multiple somethings) out there meant to correspond with the Osmic Fragments. Puzzle pieces meant to fit together. More proof that the Lucent Brood are planning some kind of ritual. 


Search all three areas in the Throne World for the sources of the resonance.
