entries.title: Report: REVERSE-LURE
entries.speaker: Evidence Board
entries.quote:
Thanks to the data you generated, the Hidden have found that resonant runes are essentially a Hive-magic imitation of the Relic. Which means the compatible resonance of the Osmic Fragments are actually an indication of a Weapon Pattern stored.


Or rather, a piece of one. Hence, Immaru's determination to collect all the fragments. 


Then, as soon as he'd make the pattern whole, he could use the runes to shape as many specialized weapons the Lucent Brood could ever ask for. 


If only you hadn't gotten your hands on the fragments first. Without those, Immaru will have to improvise.


And he undoubtedly will. So, Ikora proposes a turning of the tables. According to the Hidden, the shaping ritual is meant to take place in Queen's Bailey. 


Take the Osmic Fragment and use it to lure in Immaru. If you play this right, you can grab your culprit and his remaining supplies in one fell swoop.

entries.title: Report: REVERSE-LURE
entries.speaker: Evidence Board
entries.quote:
While some questions still linger, Ikora and her Hidden are now armed with far more answers than when they first stepped foot on the returned Mars. 


Thanks to you, the purpose of the Relic has been revealed and put to good use, Savathûn's throne world has been thoroughly investigated, and the schemes of the Lucent Brood have been officially foiled. 


And though Immaru may have escaped justice once again, the Lucent Brood won't be getting their claws on advanced weapons anytime soon. 


Speaking of, there is one more mystery you can solve. You still don't know what weapon Immaru was so desperate for. What pattern lurks within the Osmic Fragments?


Go to the Relic to shape your reward.

entries.title: Report: SCORN-ORDER
entries.speaker: Evidence Board
entries.quote:
The Osmic Fragment from the Wellspring seems to have a stronger pulse than the others. 


Did the Scorn's temporary possession have an effect? Or is the resonance amplified by the nearby presence of the other fragments?


More importantly, do the Scorn know what Immaru intends to do with the Osmic Fragments? They must. If they know the runes are for some kind of Lucent Brood defense, then the Osmic Fragments are undeniably part of that.


It would help if you knew the runes' specific purpose. You glance at the Hidden's open query. No progress yet. 


In the meantime, there are other angles of this case to consider. Check the other Hidden reports for more leads.

entries.title: Report: SCORN-ORDER
entries.speaker: Evidence Board
entries.quote:
As you stand before the Evidence Board, a file catches your eye. It's an assessment of the Scorn presence in the Throne World, with a particularly intriguing coda:


"Our undead friends have grown smarter under their new (or rather, very old) management. One troubling example: marching orders, exhumed from an ex-Major."


You peer at the burnt page. The Eliksni-adjacent scrawl is too charred to read, but at the bottom, you spot a crude, but unmistakable drawing of… the resonant Hive rune.  


Now, why are the Scorn hunting down Hive runes? And why the specific kind that Savathûn's Ghost cares so much about?


You need to see the marching orders in full. Target Scorn elites in the Throne World to intercept their orders.

entries.title: Report: STEPS-RETRACED
entries.speaker: Evidence Board
entries.quote:
One of the files seems much denser than the others. A closer look reveals it's an abstract on Deepsight, written by Eris Morn.


"The nature of this power supports our hypothesis that Darkness is specially bound to the consciousness that stretches in webs across space and time. This makes it uniquely useful for an investigatory process. However, we have not yet fully explored its utility for reflection. 


Savathûn's Altar is one example of Deepsight's potency in this regard. The wounds spanning the desert suggest the Witness engaged in a similar process with Mars; retreading old ground to forge new paths in the future.


Of course, as Ikora is quick to note, this is a logic well-known to Guardians already, thanks to the guided battle-meditations she put into practice after the Red War. 


But now, with Deepsight… what might that practice become? What kind of insights could be mined from retracing our steps?"


You look up from the file. If Deepsight can help you glean new clues from old cases, it would be worth it to put Eris's theory to the test.


Discover new Insights by retracing your steps in weekly missions.

entries.title: Report: STEPS-RETRACED
entries.speaker: Evidence Board
entries.quote:
By retracing your steps through the Throne World, you've picked up enough clues to form a theory about Immaru's motives, if not his entire plan. 


From the beginning, it was clear that the Throne World had-and still has-fierce protectors in the Lucent Brood. Their antagonism was an effective smokescreen for the fact that, behind the scenes, Savathûn actually wanted you there… 


Unlike the Scorn. You recall Immaru's voice, after you swiped the resonant runes from his squads: "We got interlopers in the area…" 


Interlopers. Not just Guardians, but any who trespass into the Throne World are the threat. 


And the defense against them lies in the Dark-tinged Osmic Fragments and the runes imbued with Hive magic. 


Just when you thought you had seen enough contradictions-in-terms in this investigation, up pops a Hive Ghost using tools of Darkness to protect a realm filled with Light. 


In the meantime, there are other angles of the investigation to consider. Check the other Hidden reports for more leads.

entries.title: Report: TRANSCRIPT-WOUND
entries.speaker: Evidence Board
entries.quote:
New intel awaits you on the Evidence Board. The report includes a note to Ikora:


"To IKO-006: Here's the AI-COM/RSPN protocol transcript we picked up from the wounds. According to this, before initiating YUGA SUNDOWN, Rasputin killed all protective measures in place for Human colonies and settlements. There's a big list of codenames for the Moon, Mars, Earth, the Exodus ships, et cetera… but Rasputin also refers to a place called NEFELE STRONGHOLD. No record of that in any of our databases. Forwarding to A.B. for a cross-ref."


A follow-up message from Ana Bray brings up more questions than it answers:


"To CHA-319: No hit on 'NEFELE STRONGHOLD' in any of Rasputin's records. Can't even find the original transcript you're quoting. If it's real, someone removed all traces of it. And if they did, they did it so cleanly that I'd suspect Rasputin himself."


No action items on this case; just an unsatisfying label of "UNSOLVED."

entries.title: Ascendant Lens
entries.speaker: Executor Hideo
entries.quote:
Queen Mara's eyebrows lift as you hand her the Ascendant Lens. "This is an exceedingly rare trinket," she says, peering at you through the lens.


"It may not look like much to a common Guardian, but in the hands of our Techeuns, it will be a valuable research tool. You were right to bring it to me."


"Allow me to repay your generosity," she says, handing you a handsome reward.


You start to thank her, but she's already walking away. You've been dismissed.

entries.title: Celebrate with New Monarchy
entries.speaker: Executor Hideo
entries.quote: As we've proven, unity and integrity will triumph in the end. This is a joyful day, Guardian.

entries.title: Faction Rallies
entries.speaker: Executor Hideo
entries.quote: New Monarchy is committed to unity through leadership and honor. Earth is our home, and together we can rebuild it to its former splendor.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Executor Hideo
entries.quote: Your reputation in New Monarchy precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Executor Hideo
entries.quote: To earn tokens for Level 20 rewards, destroy supplies in Lost Sectors and do Public Events, Crucible matches, strikes, and the “Leviathan” Raid while pledged to New Monarchy.

entries.quote: To earn tokens for Level 20 rewards, destroy supplies in Lost Sectors and do public events, Crucible matches, strikes, and the "Leviathan" raid while pledged to New Monarchy.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Executor Hideo
entries.quote: To earn tokens for Level 20 rewards, loot caches in Lost Sectors and do public events, Crucible matches, strikes, and the "Leviathan" raid while pledged to New Monarchy.

entries.title: Increase Reputation
entries.speaker: Executor Hideo
entries.quote: Show Executor Hideo proof of your support for New Monarchy.

entries.title: Reach Level 20
entries.speaker: Executor Hideo
entries.quote: Increase your level to claim these rewards.

entries.title: Extraction Protocol
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
Clovis, now uploaded into the Exo Frame by Ana Bray, reiterates the importance of restoring Rasputin.


"We must secure the Warsat network ourselves before it's too late. Rebuilding the Warmind is now humanity's top priority."


To do so, he tasks you with retrieving data from Rasputin's subminds, scattered across the solar system and held behind enemy lines.


Additionally, you will need to find a way aboard the orbital station that serves as the hub of the Warsat network. Only then can the rebuilt Rasputin reclaim control of his weaponry.

entries.title: Final Dawn
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
"Guardian. If you are listening to this, then the deed is done. I trust my sacrifice was not in vain."


Rasputin speaks from beyond the grave in a pre-recorded message, delivering a final warning:


"The Neptunian city in Osiris's visions is real. I do not know its exact location, but it is home to 'the Veil,' an object of immense paracausal power. One that is linked to the Traveler."


He imparts this knowledge to use against the Witness in the hopes it may prevent the second Collapse.


In closing, Rasputin wishes you well and imparts one final truth:


"Humanity has no more need of a Warmind. Not when you have each other."

entries.title: Final Dawn
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
"We have no time to waste," Rasputin says with urgency. Eramis is planning on using the Warsats to fire upon the Traveler.


If Eramis succeeds in her plan, it will not only cause a catastrophe, but the act of war also will be tributed to Xivu Arath and her worm.


Despite his remote access being disabled, Rasputin informs you that in his completed state, he can be uploaded onsite through the backdoor that you set up. 


There is no time to waste.

entries.title: Frequencies Detected
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
A ripple of Arc energy, accompanied by a wave of static, crests over the Exo Frame. Its eyes flicker in response. Clovis seems none too happy about it.


"Agh! What is that infernal racket? It sounds like… music?"


The Exo Frame shakes its head, as if trying to break itself out of a trance.


"The source frequencies are corrupted and scattered across the system," Clovis complains. "Given the Warmind's obsession with this sort of thing, it might be an attempt at communicating with us."


Clovis refocuses his attention on you.


"Use this Resonance Amp to compile and repair those frequencies. Perhaps then I can get some peace and quiet."

entries.title: Infiltrator Gear Unlocked
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
Rasputin's eyes flicker as the server blades throughout the room whirr in computation.


"Clovis previously granted you access to BrayTech covert operation equipment, which he attempted to revoke before being once again confined to Europa. He was unsuccessful."


The Exo Frame nods to itself.


"Furthermore, I have partially bypassed his authorization protocols, allowing you to utilize more of his arsenal."


Rasputin tilts his head toward you.


"In time, I will bring down his final firewall. For now, add another instrument to your repertoire."

entries.title: Infiltrator Gear Unlocked
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
"Victory is within our grasp. The most effective tactic at this juncture is the continuation of offensive efforts."


Rasputin's eyes shine brightly, as if with excitement.


"I have secured access to the last of BrayTech's covert ops implements. They will further enhance your ability to infiltrate the facilities across Sol and retrieve the submind data therein."


Rasputin raises his head slightly, looking off into the distance.


"Clovis developed these tools for nefarious purposes. But in your hands, they will save humanity."

entries.title: Infiltrator Gear Unlocked
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
The Exo Frame's head turns toward you, its eyes seeming somehow colder than usual.


"Let me be blunt, Guardian. Our current rate of progress is unacceptable. We still require a massive amount of submind data to complete Rasputin's reconstruction algorithm."


The Exo Frame's head shakes with Clovis's disappointment before he returns his attention to you.


"Once again, the Traveler's gifts prove insufficient on their own. I am granting you access to BrayTech's suite of specialized covert ops gear. Perhaps using them will accelerate your efforts."


The Exo Frame lowers its crane, as if Clovis were leaning closer to you in a menacing manner.


"And remember that they are BrayTech property. Handle them with care."

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
As Rasputin's reconstruction progresses, he reflects on how the reintegration of the subminds has altered his own personality. 


He now sees himself as humanity once saw him: an all-seeing savior in the sky, a mechanical war god of their own making.


"Perhaps I am not unlike Xivu Arath in that regard," he muses.


Rasputin assures you, however, that he wields his power to protect humanity. Once he is fully restored, he will ensure that the Wrathborn threat is eliminated.

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
Brushing aside Ana and Elsie's criticisms, Clovis immediately shifts his focus to the task at hand.


"I have found a solution to our submind problem," he declares.


Clovis informs you that Rasputin's Mindlab is situated in one of the "time wounds" on Mars, and that it contains Charlemagne's submind core from a past time period.


He tasks you with retrieving the submind data so that it can be reintegrated into the engram.

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
Clovis is growing impatient, impressing upon you the importance of seizing control of the Warsats before your enemies do.


He mentions that Ana has come up with an idea to accelerate Rasputin's restoration, but is not convinced that it will prove successful. 


Clovis tasks you with retrieving more submind data. He is willing to humor Ana, but not at the cost of the mission.


"Perhaps by the time you're done," he says arrogantly, "Anastasia will be ready to share her side project."

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
Pleased at the progress of his reconstruction, Rasputin reflects on the numerous times the Hive attempted to gain control of his weaponry. He thanks you and the Vanguard for repeatedly thwarting them.


"This time will prove no different," he declares.


Rasputin informs you that his restoration is nearly complete. He urges you to collect more submind data so that he can show the Hive the full power of a Warmind.

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
Despite running combat simulations around the clock, Rasputin has yet to devise a method of using the Warsats that does not empower Xivu Arath.


Nevertheless, he reiterates that allowing the Wrathborn to seize control of the Warsats is not an option either. He tasks you with the collection of additional submind data in order to oppose their efforts.


"I also have a… special request," Rasputin confides in you.


He reveals to you the existence of highly classified files firewalled in a bunker beneath the Cosmodrome. Once you have secured the submind data, you are to report to the bunker and retrieve the files.

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
After a moment of thought, Clovis turns his attention to you once again.


"During the Golden Age, Rasputin partitioned a submind for operation in the Cosmodrome on Earth. Malahayati was its name. Unfortunately, the Fallen have either ransacked or destroyed all of the installations that would have housed any of its data."


A glint of excitement flashes within Clovis's Exo eyes.


"However, Malahayati was created to guide colonization efforts. I suspect that an off-world backup exists within the Seraph bunker on the Moon. You will test that hypothesis."


The Exo Frame's crane raises Clovis high above you, like a king sitting upon a throne.


"Now, go. It seems that you have an incoming transmission from a like-minded party. See if they have anything useful to say, and then carry on with your mission."

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
Clovis reacts with fury upon learning that Fallen Splicers are aboard Seraph Station.


"Who knows what kind of havoc they might wreak?" he fumes.


Though he vows to eradicate them once the Warsats are under our control, he admits that Rasputin is currently in no condition to be uploaded to the network. 


He tasks you with the retrieval of more submind data while he searches for a way to expedite the process.

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
Despite his irritation at Rasputin's encryption of the launch codes, Clovis can't help but be impressed.


"One can never be too cautious when keeping secrets," he comments with a begrudging respect for the Warmind.


He reiterates the need for the continued reintegration of submind data. In the meantime, he sets his mind to the decryption of the codes, confident that Rasputin can be brought to heel.

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
Clovis's synthesized voice seethes with frustration, unsympathetic to Ana's efforts to teach Rasputin independent thought. He blames her for the obstacles that now stand in your path.


"No matter. I will find the new launch codes eventually," Clovis declares. "But the station will prove useless if we do not rebuild Rasputin first."


Clovis explains that Rasputin's AI core remains incomplete. He tasks you with the continued infiltration of the vaults while he searches for another source of submind data.

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
Rasputin reels under the revelation that using the Warsats as he had planned will vastly empower Xivu Arath. He is unsure that he can develop a winning strategy without the use of force.


"This is a calculation I have never had to make," he laments, his voice beset with doubt. "It will take time to run the necessary combat simulations."


Rasputin asks that you follow the Vanguard's instructions while he attempts to determine your next objective.

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
Rasputin thanks you for retrieving the files and apologizes for not disclosing their existence earlier.


"To do so required a level of trust I have not held for a considerable time," he explains.


He goes on to liken you to his Seraphs, special Human agents he entrusted with advanced armor and weaponry. Though he admits to making many mistakes in the past, he considers you proof that trusting humanity was not one of them.


Rasputin vows that no matter what the future brings, you and he will face it together.

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
Now installed into the Exo Frame, Rasputin reflects on how he has changed as a result of the reintegration of Felwinter's memories.


"I see myself as he saw me," Rasputin remarks, "A tyrant who squandered a power that could have saved the world."


Rasputin vows to be a new kind of Warmind, and that he will do everything in his power to save humanity from the Wrathborn.


In the meantime, he asks that you continue retrieving submind data to aid his reconstruction.

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
Clovis smugly informs you that Elsie has decided to join the cause. She is to assist your infiltration of the orbital station, now that Clovis has decrypted the launch codes you retrieved.


Despite the reintegration of Malahayati and Charlemagne, Rasputin requires more submind data in order to be fully reconstructed. Clovis tasks you with retrieving more of it.


"Do not tarry," he warns. "You can be assured that our enemies won't."

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
Rasputin has informed you that key elements of his code remain missing or incomplete. Without them, he cannot take control of the Warsats.


In order to continue his restoration process, he needs you to continue reintegrating submind data into the engram and delivering it to him in the H.E.L.M.


"We must stay the course," he summarizes. 


Despite the lack of additional submind cores, Rasputin is confident that the Warsats will soon belong to humanity once again.

entries.title: Reintegration Protocol
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote: "Rasputin's our one shot at regaining control of the Warsats." -Ana Bray

entries.title: Reputation Reward
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote: Complete Heist Battlegrounds in the playlist to increase your Exo Frame reputation.

entries.title: Seasonal Focusing
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
As you approach the Star Chart, you see an Umbral Engram sitting off to the side with a note nearby:


"Guardian, take this Umbral Engram and focus it at the Star Chart using one of the focused decoding options.
-Master Rahool"

entries.title: Should You Choose to Accept It, Part I
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
A series of automated beeps emit from the dormant Exo frame. On a nearby screen, a small prompt appears:


//REMOTE DOWNLOAD INITIATED


A data uplink notification flashes in Ghost's eye. It's a message:


"Hello, mate. Our paths cross again. I've liberated some high-priority BrayTech data from House Salvation-data pertaining to Revision Zero-and well, it appears I've tumbled into a spot of trouble.


The Fallen caught wind of my expedition and are hunting for the data I stole. I'm trying to lure them away, give a tail for them to chase, but the Hidden need you to recover the data from the dead drops I stashed them in.


First thing's first, you'll need to retrieve an index cipher to help unlock the dead drops. I will provide more details as they are needed.


-FEN-092"

entries.title: Should You Choose to Accept It, Part II
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
A series of automated beeps emit from the dormant Exo frame. On a nearby screen, a small prompt appears:


//REMOTE DOWNLOAD INITIATED


A data uplink notification flashes in Ghost's eye. It's a message:


"Welcome back, mate. House Salvation is still hot on the tail of these caches I stole, and I think we have a window to retrieve another.


I've spent some time investigating the schematics you retrieved. The weapon these modules are for was a joint creation of BrayTech and a Golden Age corporation that may sound familiar: Häkke Heavy Industries.


That's right. It looks like our post-collapse Häkke foundry was born from the remnants of a Golden Age industrial weapons manufacturer that had dealings with BrayTech. Curious, isn't it?


Well, enough with story time. You have a mission to accomplish!


-FEN-092"

entries.title: Should You Choose to Accept It, Part III
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
A series of automated beeps emit from the dormant Exo frame. On a nearby screen, a small prompt appears:


//REMOTE DOWNLOAD INITIATED


A data uplink notification flashes in Ghost's eye. It's a message:


"We meet again! We have another opportunity to recover one of the weapon components from a dead drop while House Salvation's attention is elsewhere.


In the meanwhile, I've been doing some research on Häkke Heavy Industries with the Cryptarchs. It turns out this corporation was heavily invested in the Golden Age pursuit of xenoarchaeology; the concept that the Sol system had been visited by aliens and left evidence behind. 


Now, I've heard tell of some xenoarchaeologists operating on Mars, and that Ana Bray had even been researching one, once upon a time. I don't know what this has to do with this weapon, but I'm going to keep looking.


Meanwhile, your mission is to recover the next schematic. Instructions to follow.


-FEN-092"

entries.title: Should You Choose to Accept It, Part IV
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
A series of automated beeps emit from the dormant Exo frame. On a nearby screen, a small prompt appears:


//REMOTE DOWNLOAD INITIATED


A data uplink notification flashes in Ghost's eye. It's a message:


"We meet at the end of the road, Guardian. One dead drop left and the perfect opportunity to snatch it out from under House Salvation's nose.


Since we last spoke, I did some more digging and discovered that our current-age Häkke was responsible for stealing and attempting to reverse-engineer the Cage created by Dominus Ghaul all those years ago to imprison the Traveler.


The technology they had harnessed was in turn stolen by Psions loyal to Calus, who used it to create Light suppressor munitions used during an assassination attempt on Zavala. It's an interesting tangle of threads, but I can't see quite where it leads.


And like all real mysteries, we might never.


All that aside, you have a mission to accomplish! Details forthcoming.


-FEN-092"

entries.title: The Hidden Shape
entries.speaker: Exo Frame
entries.quote:
A series of automated beeps emit from the dormant Exo frame. On a nearby screen, a small prompt appears:


//REMOTE DOWNLOAD INITIATED


A data uplink notification flashes in Ghost's eye. It's a message:


"Sorry for the bait and switch, mate. Needed to secure-deliver this data. House Salvation is monitoring my long-range communications.


I am agent FEN-092 of the Hidden, contacting you regarding your recent discovery aboard Seraph Station.


I've reviewed our records, and it would appear that there was a weapon BrayTech was developing in conjunction with another contemporary corporation of the time. One of an unusual, adaptive design.


Now, the weapon you retrieved from the station is hundreds of years old and barely held together. That said, the Hidden have access to an artifact that may be able to draw out the secrets of the past within it.


Would you kindly bring this weapon to Mars?"

entries.title: A Hard Rain Falls
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
"I knew House Salvation would fight back, but not with such force.


"They fight with the support of Darkness watching over them. There is a dangerous strength they continue to wield, but we are stronger.


"Wreckage will continue to fall, and House Salvation will most assuredly be there anytime it does.


"As will we."

entries.title: A Hard Rain Falls
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
"We owe much to those who fought to save Europa from the Morning Star's attempted nuclear collision.


"Some of it lies in wreckage on top of the Crypt, but not all. Much remains in the atmosphere, and falls now to Europa's surface. With the careening wreckage comes value we cannot overlook, as House Salvation has discovered.


"We must continue the fight against them and prevent them from acquiring anything that aids their continued violence.


"Look for the falling debris; there, you will find House Salvation. They must be stopped."

entries.title: Aspect of Influence
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The Stranger sighs with relief upon your approach. "It appears, as usual, that when it comes to the secrets of Clovis, there are always more hidden away.


"The old man was… is, rather, nothing if not insanely overprotective. As such, we cannot access it without a potency of Darkness energy.


"Fortunately for us, there's been a surge of just such an energy within the twisted caverns of the Vex here on Europa.


"Take the Skeleton Key and investigate the surge. If I'm right, it should give us what we need to unlock a further understanding of Stasis."

entries.title: Aspect of Interference
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
"Darkness energy radiates from Kell's Rising, and that can only mean one thing: Stasis.


It seems our journey to unlock the remaining secrets of Stasis continues."

entries.title: Beyond Light
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The time has come for the Exo Stranger to reveal to you her secret.


In another timeline, her original timeline, she failed to stop the Darkness from manipulating Guardians and bringing about a second Collapse. Since then, she has been carried through time, trying again and again to prevent that dark future.


Looking at you now, she finally sees a future in which she might succeed. She thanks you, then reminds you that the fight has only just begun. More Guardians must take this path towards Stasis. She'll be here to guide those that do.


Keep up the fight against House Salvation and all the other enemies of the Traveler. And don't forget: you have an ally in the Exo Stranger. Return here to learn more about her past and any other secrets that may help you on your journey.

entries.title: Beyond Light
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The Exo Stranger is thrilled. Your progress with Stasis marks a new milestone for her.


In order to understand why, you must know what happened in her original timeline, one in which the Darkness corrupted all but a few Guardians. When this ushered in a second Collapse, the Exo Stranger thought all hope was lost. But looking at you now, she finds hope once again. Hope in a future in which the Darkness within us all can be accepted, controlled, and embraced. A future in which balance and truth can prevail for the good of humanity.


To take one more step towards this future, the Stranger asks you to approach the Ziggurat once more and embrace the Darkness within.

entries.title: Beyond Light
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The Exo Stranger has returned, just as the Darkness was inviting you in. Instead of warning you to turn back, she says it's time to accept what it offers. The Light is not enough to face Eramis and her dark council. If you want to defeat them, you must embrace the power of Darkness as they have.


She hands you a "Splinter of Darkness." This will allow you to wield Stasis. There are others like it, all in the hands of House Salvation. Yours is weak now, but it will strengthen as your proficiency grows.


Lastly, the Exo Stranger offers you her campsite. As you collect lessons and keepsakes, return here to reflect on your experiences.


But first, you must accept the path before you. Begin by attuning your Splinter in the monolithic Ziggurat on the icy flats ahead.

entries.title: Beyond Light
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The Exo Stranger is thrilled. Not only did you accept the power of Stasis, you put it to use by taking down Phylaks and retrieving her Splinter of Darkness.


Continue working with Variks to track down the next member of Eramis's dark council. Once you get a hold of their Splinter, the Exo Stranger can use it to enhance your own, which will in turn strengthen your proficiency with Stasis.


But don't get carried away. You have a way go before you can face Eramis. Now that you've accepted Stasis, you must learn to resist the temptations of the Darkness and use it solely for the good of humanity.


With that, she hands you back your Splinter, now infused with Phylaks's, readying you for the next stage of Stasis.


Attune your enhanced Splinter of Darkness at the Ziggurat in Beyond.

entries.title: Beyond Light
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The Stranger seems pleased as you hand her the Splinter you retrieved from Praksis. You've made progress in dismantling Eramis's dark council and shown that, so far, you have a good handle on resisting the temptations of the Darkness.


But the journey's not over yet. In order to wield Stasis against the Kell of Darkness, you must achieve perfect control of the power flowing within you. The Exo Stranger has seen what happens to Guardians who lack this discipline, but refuses to explain herself just yet.


She hands you back your Splinter, now enhanced by Praksis's. You're ready for the next stage of Stasis.


Attune your enhanced Splinter of Darkness at the Ziggurat in Beyond.

entries.title: Beyond Light
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The Exo Stranger is thrilled. Not only did you accept the power of Stasis, you put it to use by taking down Phylaks and retrieving her Splinter of Darkness.


Continue working with Variks to track down the next member of Eramis's dark council. Once you get a hold of their Splinter, the Exo Stranger can use it to enhance your own, which will in turn strengthen your proficiency with Stasis.


But don't get carried away. You have a ways to go before you can face Eramis. Now that you've accepted Stasis, you must learn to resist the temptations of the Darkness and use it solely for the good of humanity.


With that, she hands you back your Splinter, now infused with Phylaks's, readying you for the next stage of Stasis.


Attune your enhanced Splinter of Darkness at the Ziggurat in Beyond.

entries.title: Born in Darkness
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The Exo Stranger is pleased with your progress acquiring and learning to use Stasis, but explains it can still be further enhanced.


She reveals herself to be Elisabeth "Elsie" Bray, granddaughter of Clovis Bray I. His experiments on Europa were filled with deceptions and secrets-the most important of which may have involved Exos, Darkness, and by association, Stasis.


Acquire his digital journal, and you're bound to discover further truths about Stasis. But the journal is currently locked.


The Exo Stranger removes a symbol from her own body and hands it to you, calling it a Skeleton Key. In order to access the journal, you must first empower the Skeleton Key with Stasis energy.


Follow the Exo Stranger's guidance to empower the Skeleton Key.

entries.title: Born in Darkness
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The Exo Stranger imagines a world where Light and Dark fight side by side. She believes your help in getting there has been instrumental, but reminds that your work together has only just begun.


If you're to see her vision through to a better world, there is much work left to do, and many potential allies yet to convince of the importance in using Darkness for good.


Until then, your continued usage of Stasis in the fight against evil should help further the cause.

entries.title: Born in Darkness
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The Exo Stranger uncrosses her arms as you approach, happy to see you again so soon.


"This journal of Clovis's is more of a boon for us than I previously realized. In my original timeline, there was a hard copy, though it was incomplete. You've finally helped me access its digital form, and with it, we've been rewarded."


The Exo Stranger hands you what she found.


"Our first step in enhancing your Darkness abilities begins with this. I'm looking forward to seeing what you make of it."

entries.title: Born in Darkness Part 1
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger

entries.title: Born in Darkness Part 2
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The Exo Stranger seems lost in thought when you approach, but your presence quickly snaps her out of it.


"I've sent a message to Ana. I can only hope she receives it well. Assuming she has any desire to speak to me, we will hopefully be seeing her soon."


The Exo Stranger's demeanor shifts-excitement is on the horizon.


"In more hopeful news, decrypting Clovis's journal has yielded another opportunity to enhance your Stasis powers. I can't wait to see what you do with it."

entries.title: Born in Darkness Part 2
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The Exo Stranger has poured over Clovis's digital journal and discovered that despite learning more about Stasis from the available pages, much of it is still encrypted. Turns out, Clovis didn't trust many, including his family.


Though this is not the Exo Stranger's first time seeing it, she has never been able to fully decrypt it to further understand its secrets. But with you at her side, decrypting the journal finally feels like a reality.


In order to decrypt and explore it further, the Exo Stranger once again asks you to empower the Skeleton Key with Stasis energy, believing that Clovis installed it in her hoping she would use it to one day continue his work and further his legacy.


Follow the Exo Stranger's guidance to empower the Skeleton Key.

entries.title: Born in Darkness Part 3
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
Decrypting a portion of the journal has yielded more Stasis knowledge. It's only a matter of time before you know all of what Clovis knew.


There is work yet to be done and pages still to decrypt to further understand and acquire all that Clovis knew about Stasis.


In order to further decrypt the journal, you'll need to empower the Skeleton Key with Stasis energy.


Follow the Exo Stranger's guidance to empower the Skeleton Key.

entries.title: Born in Darkness Part 3
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The Exo Stranger seems troubled as you approach.


"Perhaps I shouldn't have dropped so much on Ana at once. In my past attempts to befriend her-across other timelines-I always tried to ease her in to these revelations."


She shifts uncomfortably.


"But we no longer have time for ease. I just hope that by creating a different world-one where the Darkness can't get its filthy claws into our heads-that Ana will come around. If she doesn't… then this whole thing may be a wash once again."


The Exo Stranger shakes it off.


"No, it can't be. This time, things truly are different. You're walking proof of that: you and your resilience to the manipulations of Darkness. So let's keep up the good fight by continuing to use Clovis's research for good. Speaking of, here's what I found this time. It's yours to do with as you please."

entries.title: Born in Darkness Part 4
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The Exo Stranger stands confidently as you approach.


"My friend, you have no idea how grateful I am for you and all that we have done together. This is only just the beginning."


The Exo Stranger pauses and takes a cathartic moment to herself before continuing.


"I've lived in a loop for so long, to be able to see this as a new beginning is… I don't even know. Something I began to think wasn't achievable. But now with you, Eris, Drifter, and Ana by my side, it's all becoming so clear." The Exo Stranger holds out a hand.


"This should help provide us even more clarity. And you, even more Stasis power. Once you're through attuning to it, return to me. I feel as though I owe you a million more thank yous."

entries.title: Born in Darkness Part 4
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
With Clovis's journal fully decrypted, The Exo Stranger has tracked your final Stasis learnings to the Giant Exo Head within Creation inside Bray Exoscience.


It appears that to unlock it, you'll need to empower the Skeleton Key with Stasis one final time, before bringing it to the Giant Exo Head.


Follow the Exo Stranger's guidance to empower the Skeleton Key.

entries.title: Crystalline Developments
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The Exo Stranger beckons you closer. "Time and again, Stasis has changed itself. New forms arisen in the formations of crystal; new order given to chaotic molecules." 


She demonstrates for you. A pattern of crystals spin out from her fingertips, latticing into a new and stable construct. 


"Let me teach you this one," she says then. "I think you will find it… enriching."


A new grenade is available for purchase from The Exo Stranger.

entries.title: Dawning Delivery
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The Exo Stranger takes the bundle of brittle cookies from you with gratitude.
"Happy Dawning, Guardian," she says, and bows her head in thanks. 


"I think you should know," she begins, then clears her throat with a soft mechanical trill.


"This is something I'll never forget."

entries.title: Exo Stranger Challenge
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The Exo Stranger welcomes you back. She's impressed by your dedication to wielding Stasis with care and focus.


"Mastering Stasis is the first step towards understanding the Darkness," she says. "It's Guardians like you that will help us escape a dark future for humanity. Thank you."

entries.title: Fragment Quests
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
The Exo Stranger inclines her head as you approach. "Your skill with Stasis is impressive," she says. "But there's still much to learn about the Darkness: how to wield it, how to shape it. I can offer guidance, but the path is yours to walk."


Each week, the Exo Stranger will provide two new quests to unlock Stasis Fragments. Fragments are coalesced Darkness energy that can be used to modify your subclass abilities and stats. They are equipped in Fragment Slots provided by Aspects.


Return each week to receive the Stranger's guidance on how to acquire these Fragments.

entries.title: Old Secrets, New Challenges
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
"Exo training protocols, huh?


"It seems we were right to investigate. Engage with them whenever you'd like, but keep their existence safe from House Salvation.


"We must not give them even a single ledge from which to pull themselves up."

entries.title: Soon
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
"The BT-7707 was prototyped as a weapon to combat the Vex; a portable mass driver capable of firing rounds that moved beyond relativistic speeds."


"I don't know if it was ever completed in this timeline, but a version of it was pulled from another by Clovis during experiments with Vex technology. But it was never completed."


"The plans exist here, now, and I intend to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands. I'll need your help to do it."⁠

entries.title: Soon
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
"And there it is. Clovis Bray's arrogance detailed in line graphs and metrics. Unbelievable. In the height of his hubris, he sought to build a weapon capable of bending time itself…


"Even with this calibration data, I'm not sure what the full realization of Clovis's design would be like. A faster-than-light cannon capable of shooting across star systems? I have no intention of ever allowing anyone to find out.


"We have what we need to complete this weapon refit to suit our purposes. As for Clovis's intentions…


"They can die in obscurity with him."

entries.title: Soon
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
"I can only begin to imagine what this weapon was being designed for. Even on a small scale, its potential for harm is disastrous. I suppose that's very much like Clovis, isn't it?"


"We can't begin the manufacture of these components until after some rigorous testing. I won't throw caution to the wind… like he would."

entries.title: Timewarped Relics
entries.speaker: Exo Stranger
entries.quote:
"This might look familiar, I know. But it is, in fact, not one you've seen before."


"During the Golden Age, Clovis performed many experiments. When it came to experimenting with the Vex, it seemed endless."


"Time travel became possible, but only for short bursts of time, and with few options. It needed an anchor. Something already unstuck from time."


"This… was that anchor. And it wasn't the only one of its kind."


"For now, it's yours. And in time, all will be explained."

entries.title: Anomalous Object
entries.speaker: Failsafe
entries.quote:
"Accessing 'Friendly Greeting Protocol 6661E'… Corrupted."


"I apologize for the error, Guardian, and would like to assure you your efforts on this stellar entity are appreciated."


"According to calculations, your actions have increased the chance of my continued existence by 0.17%."


Failsafe's machinery jerks and jitters.


"Woohoo…" she says in her alternative voice, thick with sarcasm. Her vocal processing returns to a cheerful form.


"I hope you continue to conduct operations on Nessus!"


Destinations offer a variety of activities and rewards. Keep exploring to discover them!

entries.title: Anomalous Object
entries.speaker: Failsafe
entries.quote:
The entire room hums with electrical current and ventilation fans as you approach the console. A cheery voice echoes from loudspeakers.


"Hello, Guardian. I am Failsafe, the operational AI of the colony ship known as the Exodus Black. On behalf of our crew, I would like to welcome you!"


"I am certain they would have liked to meet you. Unfortunately, that won't be possible, as they are all dead!"


Failsafe's cylindrical spine jerks erratically for a moment. When her voice returns, it is different; deeper and somber.


"Yeah, it's been real fun sitting here alone for hundreds of years…"


The cylinder spasms again, and the cheery voice returns.


"What I mean is, I am happy to have your company! Are you here to aid with the problem of encroaching Fallen and Vex? That would be very much appreciated!"


Complete public events, Lost Sectors, and bounties acquired from Failsafe.

entries.speaker: Failsafe

Cayde was the first sentient being Failsafe met since being marooned on Nessus. Check in on her to see how she's processing his death.



        The AI of the Exodus Black was not designed to experience complex emotions. However, centuries of isolation and self-repair turned a relatively simple program into a complex neural web. In a way, Failsafe's grief, simply because it exists, is beautiful. 


It just doesn't feel that way to Failsafe.

entries.quote:
"Welcome, Captain," Failsafe says, cheerful. "I am pleased to see you again. I have been so lonely!" Her tone darkens. "But I'm kinda used to it by now."


She brightens again. "Although talking about my crew brings up many painful memories, I would love to help you find ways to honor them. Perhaps you can help drive back the hostile alien forces that wish to expel us from this planetoid!" The tone of her voice drops again, dull and dry. "What better way to honor the dead than by shooting stuff, right?"

entries.title: Touched by the Light
entries.speaker: Failsafe
entries.quote:
"Thank you for your help, Captain! Once again, your dedicated support has made my unending isolation on this planetoid more bearable." An engram-shaped candy materializes in front of you. "Please accept this strange food for your annual death celebration! I hope the contemplation of mortality and loss does not incapacitate you!"


Her voice drops to a dull mutter. "Not that I'd know anything about that."

entries.title: Touched by the Light
entries.speaker: Failsafe
entries.quote:
"Wow," says Failsafe coolly. "A weird pile of inedible candies. How did you know?"


Her tone and her mainframe brighten. "If I had a mouth, taste buds, esophagus, and a stomach, I would eat these immediately! Thank you for including me in your celebration of the impermanence of human life!"

entries.title: Captain's Log
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
As you upload your most recently gathered data into Failsafe's system, she activates her remote uplink and her H.E.L.M. holoprojection blinks to life.


"I have something for you, Captain!" she says excitedly. Her systems whirr as she initiates a transmat. "It took me a while to replicate, but you've been helping me so much, and I wanted to return the favor!"


There's a cheerful chime and a panel on the console in front of you hisses open, revealing a shimmering engram. It's slightly warm to the touch.


"I hope that this will enable you to collect data more efficiently!" she says courteously, then her voice drops to a conspiratorial stage whisper.


"Through, y'know. Violence."


Her lights wink out as you claim your reward.

entries.quote:
A recorded message from Master Rahool plays when you pick up the engram tracker: 


"Guardian! This is a new device of my own manufacture. It will allow you to monitor the number of engrams available at each of the vendors in the Tower."


"If you ever lose it, you can pick up a new one from any of those vendors. I look forward to seeing you deploy this device."
