entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act I
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe has sent you a Standard Radiolite Sampler. It displays a series of radiation detection bands. There is also a note.


"Captain! This is the beginning of our research partnership. The Sampler I have sent you can extract unique radiolaria formations from new silica structures erupting on the surface of Nessus."


Failsafe has designated a central point for a large number of nodes within the Well of Flame.

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act I
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe has been analyzing the samples and data you collected from Nessus, and she sums them up in a single word: Weird.


"It is super weird!" she says. "I have been observing the Nessus Vex for centuries, and their current behavior is utterly unfamiliar to me."


"The Vex are a techno-organic mesh of networked consciousness," she begins to explain, "unbound by time, inevitable and patient and cruelly ambivalent, et cetera."


Her tone becomes gravely serious. "This feels… different. Something's happening on Nessus, and I'm not sure the Vex are behind it."


"And that terrifies me."


Her voice becomes bright and cheerful once again. "Nothing you can't handle!" she says, brimming with enthusiasm. "It's an exciting mystery and I can't wait to figure out together!"

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act I
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Ikora greets you on the holoprojector while Failsafe processes the data you retrieved from the aberrant Vex. 


"Failsafe briefed me about your progress on Nessus," she says. "She seems pleased that things are going so well."


The smile falls from her face. "I'm concerned they're about to get worse."


She tells you her contacts have been studying the Valence, the strange aurora you've noticed spreading from the Traveler. The phenomenon began when the Witness was killed, and the mysterious object that fell to Nessus originated from that astral cloud.


She thinks the Nessus Vex have retrieved the object-and you must learn all you can, as quickly as possible.


"Give Failsafe all the support she needs. She may be a bit unpredictable herself, but she's our best source of intel on the Vex."


"Stay alert," she says, and cuts the feed.

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act I
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
There's concern in Failsafe's synthesized voice as she discusses Saint's ordeal on Nessus.


"Captain, is Saint-unit… okay?" she asks. "It sounded like the Conductor told him some stuff that really got to him."


She is comforted by the fact that Saint has so many people around who care about him. "No one can stay sad when they're surrounded by that much support!" she says. "…I assume."


Failsafe will dedicate herself to studying the research samples so you can prepare to fight the Conductor. 


"Now that the Conductor has harmed Saint-unit, I have disabled my compassion protocols!" she declares.


"We will locate it, and we will make it pay!"

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act I
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe is delighted by your return. She excitedly shares how she believes she can be of use to you as you discover more about the Nessus Vex.


"By analyzing viable radiolaria samples from different sites across the planet," she explains, "I can determine whether the aberrant behavior of the Vex is a regional phenomenon, or something deeper."


She admits would need a temporary promotion in order to plan the mission to find the radiolite and crystallized radiolaria samples herself… and takes your momentary silence as permission. 


"C'mon, Captain," she says, clearly eager to show you around Nessus. "Let me take the lead for a change." 


"It'll be an adventure."

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act I
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe greets you and shares that Ikora requested that she redouble her efforts to study the aberrant Nessus Vex. 


To maximize the power flowing to her research banks, she turns off her socialization filter. She sounds audibly relieved as her voice is stripped of its forced politeness. 


"This is better," she says. "I'm running those scans Ikora wanted, and I've got some ideas about new sample sites down on Nessus."


Perhaps due to the disabled filters, she tells you that she appreciates being given the chance to help on this mission. 


"I want you to know," she confides, "I'm glad to be a part of the team again. Working with you and the Vanguard, the whole deal."


"It's really… it's nice."


"Anyway, ready when you are," she says with forced enthusiasm, though her filter fails to re-engage. She sighs. "Let's just get going."

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act I
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe, fully updated and integrated into Vanguard systems, requires your help to investigate the strange behavior of the Vex.


Secure high-priority data to discover the connection between the Vex and the mysterious object that fell to Nessus.

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act II
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe's lights gleam with excitement at your approach. The Radiolite Sampler feels heavy in your hands, full of collected samples.


"You're back, and with samples! I have performed a full system upgrade, and I am ready for action, Captain! Nothing can stop us now, not even a bug. Which I mention because there was one…"


Failsafe lowers her voice. "Like, a real bug. It crawled into the mainframe. Patched that sucker right out."


She offers you her patch notes.


Failsafe 2.1 Patch Notes:
• Upgrade bug exterminated
• Premium Research Bays installed
• Tuned Radiolite Sampler created
• Favorite colors chosen
• Processing power increased by 16.666665%
• Pride in shared accomplishments increased by 70%

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act II
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Saint-14's hologram shines before you on the projector, but his voice, usually boisterous, is deeply melancholy. He has heard you are exploring deeper into Nessus to learn about the Conductor.


"I do not know if I am worth the trouble," he says.


"The Conductor's words still echo in my mind," Saint confides. "A copy of a copy of a copy… Osiris pushed through time to find his Saint-14… and now, I live a life that does not belong to me."


"The Conductor whispered I should be thrown away," he murmurs. His words are heavy with pain and desolation. "A solution as simple as correcting an error."


"And maybe…"


"I do not know what to think anymore," Saint says, and abruptly ends the call.

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act II
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe greets you cheerfully. "Hello again, Captain!" she says. "We have an interesting metaphysical task ahead of us today!"


She is only too happy to explain. "Years ago, Osiris rescued the Saint-unit we are familiar with from a Vex simulation. In doing so, he created a paradox: the Saint-unit is alive with us now, but simultaneously dead within the Vex network."


The databanks of the dead Saint-14 hold the data Failsafe needs to locate the Conductor's coordinates. 


But the only way to access that data is for Saint-14 to interface with it himself.


"Saint-unit will have to download the memories of his other self… experience years of suffering, his own death…" Failsafe says, clearly worried. "But the Conductor must be confronted! I'm sure Saint-unit will understand."


"…won't he?"

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act II
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe is delighted that the latest research specimen you have brought her is a small frog.


"Technically one of the Nessus proto-amphibians that developed adjacent to the Vex, but yeah, pretty much a frog," she says.


In honor of Captain Jacobson, Failsafe's original commanding officer, she decides to name the frog Captain Jacobson. 


"Don't worry," she reassures you. "It's an honorary title. The frog will have no real authority."


Failsafe is so pleased with the frog that she divulges something that has been weighing heavily on her mind: she proposed a new theory on how to locate the Conductor, but it troubled Ikora so deeply that she asked Failsafe to keep it to herself. 


"Thanks again for the frog!" Failsafe says, while you decide to speak with Ikora and learn the details of this disturbing new theory yourself.

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act II
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe's display lights up as she maps the new areas of Nessus you charted while fighting through Battleground: Core. 


You study the readout together, following the glowing channels of subterranean radiolaria as they flow ever downward.


Suddenly, Failsafe highlights a section of Nessus's surface: she has triangulated the location of an unknown research specimen! 


The lights in Failsafe's research bay flicker in anticipation…

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act II
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe whirrs in appreciation as she uses the H.E.L.M.'s systems to process the raw materials you brought her.


"FABRICATING NANOMACHINES" her viewscreen reads, as a progress bar slowly fills.


After a few moments, the text changes to "CALIBRATING NANOMACHINES" as another, longer progress bar fills.


Finally, the process finishes.


"NAMING NANOMACHINES" appears on her readout above a frustratingly long progress bar…


You tap your foot impatiently.


Eventually, Failsafe dispenses a tube of synthesized radiolaria teeming with microscopic nanomachines. Even on the H.E.L.M., their tracking signals are strong and clear. 


Once you deploy them, she will be able to follow their movements through Nessus with ease.

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act II
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Ikora has briefed Failsafe on the Echo of Command, which the Vanguard believe the Conductor is somehow using to influence the Nessus Vex. 


While your support has allowed her to greatly expand her research capabilities, Failsafe's studies of the Nessus radiolaria are yielding few results. "Which is a huge disappointment," she mutters, but she has developed a new approach.


"We could mix nanomachines into the radiolaria and reintroduce it to the planet!" she exclaims. The nanomachines won't survive in the radiolaria for long, but she'll be able to track their movements beneath the planet's crust. 


"Maybe that'll help us figure out what's going on," she says.

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act III
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
"Greetings, Captain!" Failsafe says cheerfully. "My planetary scans reveal that the Vex machinery within Nessus is dormant once again. Perhaps learning the truth about Chioma caused Maya to question her own judgment and halt her plans for galactic domination!"


Failsafe's voice drops. "Or maybe she changed her mind when Saint-unit and Ikora blasted the paint off her chassis," she says wryly.


Failsafe congratulates you on a successful mission, but it's clear her heart isn't in it.


"I was part of a crew again, and now it's over," she says sadly. "I don't like goodbyes."


But quiet hope creeps into the edges of her voice. "Y'know, I thought I'd be sadder? Usually when I'm alone, it's like whoever left turned off the lights behind them… but now, there's still a little brightness left. I guess… it's me. I think, maybe, I can keep going just for me."


"See ya around, Captain," Failsafe says. "Thanks for everything."

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act III
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Osiris's form speaks to you from the holoprojector. Even with the reduced fidelity, you can hear the horror in his voice.


"I can now confirm," he says grimly, "that every Exo frame in Maya's lab once held the consciousness of Maya's wife, Chioma Esi, each a different version of her pulled from the Vex network."


"Uploaded, judged… found wanting, and eliminated."


Osiris sounds deeply troubled by this revelation. "There are details about Maya Sundaresh I kept from Saint," he says. "He did not need to know the cruelty of the hands that touched his mind… or how much they reminded me of my own."


Osiris reached through the Vex network to find Saint, just like Maya. "I thought myself heroic in my search," he says, ashamed. "But what if I had not realized my good fortune?"


He imagines himself finding Saint, interrogating him coldly, and then killing him, as Maya is doing with Chioma.


"It would have broken me," he whispers. "And I think it has broken Maya. One capable of such horror has defiled the concept of love."


"Do not forget what you are dealing with."

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act III
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
"Hello, Captain. I have completed another full system upgrade. This time it went perfectly. I am perfect in every way!"


Failsafe's voice drops in pitch.


"Or at least my new research bays are, I guess."


Failsafe's voice rises again.


"I documented my changes!"


Failsafe 3.0 Patch Notes:
• Perfected research bays installed
• Perfected radiolite sampler crafted
• Processing power increased by 42.85714%
• Rolled back sarcasm limiters
• Increased hot and cold signal range by 96490%
• Favorite color range expanded

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act III
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Saint-14 greets you from the holoprojector. He is handling the comms to let Failsafe focus on researching the readings from Maya's laboratory at the planet's core.


He had been speaking with Failsafe-"she had disengaged her filter, so she used her raincloud voice," he says-and she asked what it felt like to take the memories of his other self. He told her his other self was almost identical, aside from one important difference:


"You, Guardian."


"The other Saint, he died alone. But I met you, after Osiris sent you in to find me. You gave me hope in my darkest time. I fought to live up to your example-that is how I survived. And slowly, I found I was no longer living for you… but I was living for me."


He says that Failsafe was quiet afterwards, seemingly lost in thought.


"I think it was a good talk," he says and smiles.

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act III
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe is eager to help you break the Conductor's encryption around her base at the center of Nessus.


She indicates that a core piece of technology vital to fully unlocking her research capabilities was stolen from her wreckage by the Nessus Fallen shortly after she first crashed. 


Fortunately, she's kept the exact coordinates of where the piece was taken all those years ago… not that she's been holding a grudge.


Reclaiming this piece of Golden Age tech will allow Failsafe to restore access to the Conductor's stronghold.


She uploads the coordinates to your HUD.

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act III
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
As soon as Saint-14 appears on the holoprojector, he begins telling you about how he and Osiris have been thinking of ways to defeat the Conductor.


Saint smiles beneath his helmet. "Osiris said the Conductor is very strong," he says, emphasizing the Conductor's name, "but maybe we can beat Maya Sundaresh."


Saint explains how the Echo of Command pulled Maya's consciousness out of the Vex network, but the network holds hundreds of different Mayas. The Conductor "could be the first one, or could be all of them smashed together. Maybe she does not even know herself," he says.


"But Osiris says all Mayas are scientists, and we can see her thoughts in her experiments."


Saint and Osiris believe the key to understanding Maya's plan is hidden in the Exo bodies in the depths of her lab. Failsafe has located tech to help you study them, and hopefully you can discover a way to stop Maya's plans.


"Brains, not brawn, yes?" muses the Titan, and he sends you on your way.

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act III
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
There is steel in Ikora's voice as she prepares you for one more journey into Maya's laboratory. 


"The Conductor awaits at the core of Nessus, working to awaken the planet and consume us in a flood of radiolaria… all in the name of her Golden Age, where she reunites with Chioma."


Ikora believes Chioma herself may be the key to ending this conflict… and she thinks she knows how to isolate the signal of the Chioma Maya thinks of as "hers."


"I won't put another life in Maya's hands, not after what she's done. But if anyone could make her understand, it would be the one Chioma she's been searching for."


Failsafe is standing by to help you retrieve the necessary tech to pull Chioma's signature from the Vex network, and she will also prepare a contingency plan in case things go badly.


"One way or another," Ikora says, "the Conductor's search ends now."

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act III
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe has overridden the Conductor's security measures and stands ready to guide you to her stronghold at the center of Nessus.  


Explore the Conductor's domain and wield the secrets hidden within.

entries.title: Legacy: Echoes Act I: A Familiar Voice
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
As you upload your most recently gathered data into Failsafe's system, she activates her remote uplink and her H.E.L.M. holoprojection blinks to life.


"I have something for you, Captain!" she says excitedly. Her systems whirr as she initiates a transmat. "It took me a while to replicate, but you've been helping me so much, and I wanted to return the favor!"


There's a cheerful chime and a panel on the console in front of you hisses open, revealing a shimmering engram. It's slightly warm to the touch.


"I hope that this will enable you to collect data more efficiently!" she says courteously, then her voice drops to a conspiratorial stage whisper.


"Through, y'know. Violence."


Her lights wink out as you claim your reward.

entries.title: Legacy: Echoes Act I: A Familiar Voice
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Though her mainframe remains on Nessus, Failsafe seems to be adjusting well to her new setup in the H.E.L.M.


"This place is nice," she mutters. "I can see why you spend so much time here. Instead of on Nessus… in my wreckage."


"I'm thrilled to be working alongside you again!" she says brightly, adjusting her tone. "One moment while I sync with the VanNet database and see if I missed any major events."


In a flash, Failsafe absorbs years of Vanguard updates. You get the feeling she is surprised by the sheer number of world-changing events that went on without her knowledge. 


Nevertheless, she focuses on the mission at hand. "Please return to Nessus and begin gathering data on the unusual Vex," she manages, before returning to studying reports.

entries.title: Legacy: Echoes Act III: A Resounding Truth
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe reacts to Maya Sundaresh's transmission with skepticism. 


"What does she mean, when she said she'd 'find our Golden Age'?" she says. "As a Golden Age AI myself, I observe a negligible intersection between Maya's current behavior and the relative utopia of that time."


Her voice is soft. "We reached into the unknown, not to control it, not because we were commanded to, but because we had… hope."


"And I'm not getting any of that from Maya!" she exclaims.


Failsafe has overridden the lockouts around the core of Nessus. You can now return to the site of your last confrontation. 


"If you find Maya, tell her that I reject her entire premise!" Failsafe requests. "And then destroy her."

entries.title: Legacy: Encoded Log
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe quietly forwards your Ghost a report detailing strange disturbances in the Vex network permeating Nessus.


"A clandestine arm of Vanguard operators delivered this information for you this morning!" Failsafe says in a cheery tone.


Her tone drops as she continues, "I can't tell you who it was, but they were pretty 'Hidden', if you know what I mean? Anyway, looks like a supersecret spy mission for a supersecret Guardian."


You scan the report.


It appears as if heavy data loads are being re-formatted and imported into the Vex network from somewhere inside Nessus. Your orders are to find and stop the Vex, and secure their data for analysis. 


Failsafe interrupts your reading. "Whatever is being done with that data is probably bad. Maybe investigating this will help us understand more about the Vex's goals on Nessus!"

entries.title: Legacy: Epilogue: Anomalous Voices
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Anomalous transmissions appear to have bled through from the Vex network. 


They must be thoroughly investigated.

entries.title: Legacy: Specimen ID: NES001
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe congratulates you on completing your extreme concussive research. The radiolaria from the collected samples appear to come from two competing factions of the Vex. 


She says, "Their conflict of extermination is producing new mineral structures I can utilize to enhance your equipment! We never would have found this without the pistons!"


Failsafe presents you with a report on NES001:


Specimen Name: Seized Radiolite Incubator


Report Summary: This object was created to manipulate and corrupt radiolaria into new forms.


Research Instrument Fabricated: Primary Echo Engram Focusing - Focus Echo Engrams into weapons and armor at Failsafe in the H.E.L.M.

entries.title: Legacy: Specimen ID: NES001
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
"The data suggests radiolite is how the Vex are iterating on their biological structure, or in this case, geological."


"Speaking of geological… I have another gift for you, Captain. Based on various surveys and previously restricted analytical data about Guardian armaments usage, statistically, you're going to like it."


Failsafe transmats in a massive Cabal hammer fitted with Vex magnetic accelerators. 


This hammer can be used to activate Assimilation Pistons and unearth additional radiolite samples.


Her tone flattens.


"The Vex have assimilated these old Cabal planetary mining pistons to agitate the crust. But we can use it to promote the formation of radiolite and unearth more incubators."


"Some of these Vex were… less than compliant. There's evidence they were assimilated. But, hey, as long as they're dead-am I right?"


The hammer will regenerate charges as you complete activities throughout the system.

entries.title: Legacy: Specimen ID: NES001
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
You place the specimen into one of Failsafe's research bays.


Failsafe's pleasantly toned voice chimes in. 


"Captain, I am so glad that you and I are able to embark on this journey of exploration and research together, in the metaphorical sense. I will be with you in spirit, and through radio transmissions, and satellite telemetry data, but not physically."


A scan passes over the specimen. "Time to put my new 'body' to use."


"I'll begin my analysis right away. These new structures of radiolaria may reveal something about why Nessus, and the Vex, are changing. In the meantime, the radiolite's methodology for reformatting data has given me an idea for fabricating new fireteam equipment. More updates in the future."


Her tone flattens.


"For now, we should figure this radiolite stuff out. The Vex have always been focused on changing what's around them to suit them, not the other way around."


Research Instrument Fabricated: Radiolite Research Bay

entries.title: Specimen ID: NES002
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe's lights brighten on your approach. "Research complete, Captain!"


She presents you with a report on NES002:


Specimen Name: Well Constellation Fragments


Report Summary: These objects are linked to each other and to the Wells on Nessus. Affecting one affects the other-which makes them perfect for data storage and retrieval.


Research Instrument Fabricated: Weekly Deepsight Focusing - The first Echo Weapon you focus each week is guaranteed to have Deepsight Resonance.

entries.title: Specimen ID: NES002
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
You place NES002-C into Failsafe's research bay alongside NES002-A and NES002-B.


"Shining and beautiful! Just like me." Failsafe gives an awkward chuckle and pauses for a moment.


The moment grows longer. The silence remains unbroken.


"Uh… Guess they can't all be winners. Leave me here and I'll take a look at our new prize, Captain."


Her tone brightens.


"And attempt not to be the first A.I. to die of embarrassment!"

entries.title: Specimen ID: NES003
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe is impressed with your scientific acumen! She adds cheerfully, "That was the most violent research I have ever seen."


She displays her report to you with pride.


Specimen Name: Assimilated Wyvern Shield-Wing


Report Summary: While these wings are primarily used for balance, they can also be energized to propel a Wyvern forward at high speeds.


Research Instrument Fabricated: Breach Executable Iridescent Radiolite Extractor - Always find a random Iridescent Radiolite in the chest at the end of the Breach Executable activity (two on Expert difficulty).

entries.title: Specimen ID: NES003
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
You place the specimen into one of Failsafe's research bays.


When you face her, Failsafe generates the sound of a crowd applauding.


"Back again, Captain? Keep this up, and I will start to believe that you like me!"


Her voice slows.


"Or maybe you just like science."


She believes this specimen is of combatant origin, but asks you to collect the necessary research data for her to compile a report on the subject.

entries.title: Specimen ID: NES004
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe is eager for you to admire the results of her work. 


"These duplicate Vex signatures have been popping up all over Nessus. Sometimes on totally different frames."


Specimen Name: Mirror-Encrypted Hydra Tail


Report Summary: The structure of this tail is encoded to grant a Hydra access to Vex infrastructure by broadcasting a signal to nearby receivers.


Research Instrument Fabricated: Armor Reputation Booster - Reputation earned through the Seasonal armor perk is increased by 100%.

entries.title: Specimen ID: NES004
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
You place the specimen into Failsafe's newly installed research bay, while Failsafe admires her new and improved setup.


After a brief analysis, Failsafe detects and decrypts a signal key transmitting from the new specimen:


Vex Portal Connection KEY:4E495341


"Do me a solid and investigate that, Captain. I would like to take myself for a spin!"

entries.title: Specimen ID: NES005
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
"The frogs are saved, and you brought a new crew member aboard! Thank you, Captain!"


Failsafe is eager to let you know everything about Captain Jacobson, and to protect all his froggy cousins still on Nessus.


Specimen Name: Captain Jacobson


Report Summary: Unlike other fauna on Nessus, this species appears to have become accustomed to the persistent Vex threat to their home. Captain Jacobson is one unflappable frog.


Research Instrument Fabricated: Secondary Echo Engram Focusing - Unlocks the ability to focus Echo Engrams into Act II weapons.

entries.title: Specimen ID: NES005
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
You place the specimen into one of Failsafe's research bays.


She thinks it will be happy in the H.E.L.M., away from roaming Vex and ponds full of radiolaria.


Joyfully, she tells you: "We rescued this specimen from the dangers of Nessus and gave it a new home on this spaceship. In this way and many others, it is just like me!"


The specimen croaks. Failsafe addresses it directly.


"I do not know if that was a sound of agreement or not. We have much to learn about each other."

entries.title: Specimen ID: NES006
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
"Okay, so… That was the most violent research I've ever seen," Failsafe tells you. She adds, "And it was worth it!"


She displays her latest report for you.


Specimen Name: Assimilated Torch Hammer


Report Summary: This weapon is commonly wielded by Minotaurs, but its energy signature is fragmentary. It has been experimented on repeatedly.


Research Instrument Fabricated: Combat Protocol Override - Detects the presence of high-value targets in Echoes Battlegrounds. Defeat the high-value targets for bonus rewards.

entries.title: Specimen ID: NES006
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
You place the new specimen in one of Failsafe's research bays.


"Ooh, this looks like a good one. Captain, I would like to extend my gratitude to you for your continued participation in our shared projects."


Failsafe's voice turns wistful. 


"If only the H.E.L.M. had enough space for us to keep going forever…"

entries.title: Specimen ID: NES007
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe did not enjoy her task of combing through the Exo Prototype you brought her and is relieved to declare herself finished at last.


Along with a set of access codes she's pulled from this specimen, Failsafe passes you her full report.


Specimen Name: Exo Prototype #314


Report Summary: This prototype appears to have achieved sentience and has its own specific personality. It is unknown why it was discarded.


Research Instrument Fabricated: Exotic Mission Hub Key - Unlocks a new Hub in Exotic mission "Encore."

entries.title: Specimen ID: NES007
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
You place the specimen in one of Failsafe's new research bays.


"Hello, Captain! I have undergone an almost full upgrade! That includes improved specimen analysis…having favorite colors…and friendship. I hope you will appreciate all three."


Failsafe 3.0 is raring to get going with her new research bays and expanded capabilities.

entries.title: Specimen ID: NES008
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
While Failsafe may describe this specimen as a laser core, it is more accurately a code core. But she urges you to remain cautious: "Against biological targets, it de-atomizes you… because it's still superheated."


With a flourish, Failsafe presents her report:


Specimen Name: Conflux Laser Core


Report Summary: This specimen is the kernel from the center of a Vex conflux. It has been modified to exert control over Vex combatants by influencing their code priorities.


Research Instrument Fabricated: Failsafe's Greatest Invention - Unlocks a powerful Vex stun cube in the mission "Encore." Destroy these cubes to temporarily stun Vex combatants.

entries.title: Specimen ID: NES008
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe watches as you place your new specimen in one of her research bays.


"This better be a juicy one. I hope we wring all kinds of data from it."


Failsafe adds hastily, "It's just nice to keep busy, you know? And remain of use to you and the Vanguard."


She could use some on-the-ground help collecting data for her research.

entries.title: Specimen ID: NES009
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
Failsafe lets you know that these batadactyls are living in symbiosis with a divergent and non-damaging faction of radiolaria. 


She'd like to keep the batadactyls. "Maybe," she says, "they can be our ambassadors!"


She presents you with her final report.


Specimen Names: Babata and Petris


Report Summary: Batadactyls are native to Nessus's crimson treetops. While shy, these two appear to be getting used to your and Failsafe's care.


Report Appendix: Pets are excellent for maintaining mental health. Failsafe endorses owning between one and three, and taking many photographs of them looking silly.

entries.title: Specimen ID: NES009
entries.speaker: Failsafe v{var:1065713164}.{var:2637407284}
entries.quote:
You place the specimens in one of Failsafe's research bays. She is delighted by them.


"Oh, more pets! More friends! Captain, I am in raptures!"


Failsafe works to restrain her enthusiasm.


"Maybe they're pair-bonded. It's okay if they don't want to be friends. I still have Captain Jacobson. And you, I guess. Oh, but perhaps we can all be best friends. Together forever!"


Failsafe's backlights glow warmly as she continues to imagine this beautiful future.

entries.title: Dawning Delivery
entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote:
"Hey, bud. What brings you back to my little corner of Savathûn's throne world?" Fynch asks as you hand him a Lucent Crunch cookie.


"Is… is this… NO WAY! It's the Dawning already? And you made ME a cookie? I can't believe it… time just flies by when you're in a pocket dimension disconnected from material reality, you know?


"Thank you, Guardian, from the bottom of my, heart-shell-core… that's the one. Seriously, it means a lot that you thought of me like this. My OWN cookie!"


"Tell you what. Bake anymore of these, and I'll wake up the big guy for a treat, assuming he can behave himself. Not when you're around, of course. Maybe he'll have a change of heart after he tastes your baking!"

entries.title: Earn Reputation
entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote: Earn Throne World Rank points by completing bounties, patrols, public events, Lost Sectors, Wellspring runs, replayable campaign missions, Altars of Reflections, secrets, and by opening chests in the Throne World.

entries.title: Fynch's Challenge
entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote: "You're cleaning this place up like nobody's business, you get me? It's, uh-well, if you don't mind me saying, it's phenomenal to watch. Keep it up, yeah?" -Fynch

entries.title: Hard Evidence
entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote:
Fynch checks the surroundings, his squirrelly affect shifting into a quieter, tenser mode. He whispers that he has proof of the Lucent Brood's shady schemes. 


He transmats a strange, gleaming fragment in the air before you. As it drops into your open hands, it sends a slight but distinctly paracausal pulse through your palms. 


Fynch explains that he swiped it from the apothecary wing in Savathûn's fortress. He isn't exactly sure what it is, but he's convinced that it's meant to play an important part in some twisted ritual. 


Bring the fragment to the Hidden in the Enclave for analysis.

entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote:

entries.title: Legacy: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote:
The rebellious Hive Ghost, Fynch, doesn't believe the Hive deserve the Light, so he offers to work with you to uncover Savathûn's scheme. He provides your first lead: a Hive temple hidden in a dark corner of the Throne World. 


Complete "The Ghosts" mission in the Throne World.

entries.title: Legacy: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote:
Fynch is excited to hear of our progress and lets us in on another lead. 


Hidden in the Throne World is a monument to Savathûn's brother, Oryx. Fynch believes that location might hold more information about how Savathûn acquired the Light.


Complete "The Lightblade" strike in the Throne World.

entries.title: Memory Alembic
entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote: "Ah yes, good stuff, Qualichor. Except not good, actually. Very bad." Fynch nudges a small vial to catch the single, putrid drop your efforts have created. "Made from brain juice and nightmares. Yeah, it's liquid Deepsight, but brew it just right, and it'll 'bring memories into present reality.' That's what the Witches said, at least. Don't think anyone ever tried refining it like this before, though. Anyway, I know this place where the Hive used to store some great artifact. Why don't you head over there, chug this refined Qualichor, and help yourself to the memory of something nice. I'm almost certain you won't go blind!"

entries.title: Of Queens and Worms
entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote:
"I, uh, got just the thing to get power back into that Cryptoglyph-a lead… location! Should aid you in finding some runes to power it back up." -Fynch


Travel to the Temple of the Cunning to locate a Cryptoglyph Rune.

entries.title: Of Queens and Worms
entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote: "A curse? Killing Sav's worm? Yeah, okay, I think I can maybe help with that! Take this casing-it's enchanted with all sorts of Hive magics. Could be your solution!" -Fynch

entries.title: Of Queens and Worms
entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote:
"I, uh, got just the thing to get power back into that Cryptoglyph-a lead… location! Should aid you in finding some runes to power it back up." -Fynch


Travel to the Temple of the Cunning to locate a Cryptoglyph Rune.

entries.title: Pyramid Preservation
entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote:
Rhulk, Disciple of the Witness, is dead thanks to the efforts of valiant and determined Guardians.


Without him, the Sunken Pyramid is up for grabs-and the Scorn intend to take control of it on behalf of the Witness.


Take this chance to stop them and keep the Pyramid under Vanguard control in the Preservation activity.

entries.title: The Gift of Appreciation
entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote: "You killed it! So proud, y'know? Love this whole thing we've got going on, I gotta say-couldn't ask for a more proactive partner. Oh, I got a little something for ya!" -Fynch

entries.title: The Gift of Appreciation
entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote:
"I used to get real lonely here, but you? You keep showing up for me again and again. So lemme give back a bit, yeah? I happened to locate a couple of Savathûn's loyalists. Have fun!" -Fynch


Follow Fynch's guidance and hunt down some elite members of Savathûn's guard.

entries.title: The Spring of Power
entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote:
"So listen, Savathûn's got this fountain of power nearby. She calls it the Wellspring. Now the Hive and Scorn are fighting over it. Might need to, y'know, get involved…" -Fynch


On the Throne World map, select The Wellspring and complete the activity.

entries.title: Trust Goes Both Ways
entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote:
"Longer I'm here, the more the brood'll start wondering where my Knight and I are at. But hey, if you deal with the Scorn for me, I can go claim the credit! So, uh, good luck?" -Fynch


Keep Fynch's cover by helping him help you.

entries.title: Trust Goes Both Ways
entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote: "I… I don't know what to say. Usually I'm just, y'know, invisible to folks. But you-you really helped me out of a bind with the Hive. I won't forget that!" -Fynch

entries.title: Trust Goes Both Ways
entries.speaker: Fynch
entries.quote:
"Longer I'm here, the more the brood'll start wondering where my Knight and I are at. But hey, if you deal with the Scorn for me, I can go claim the credit! So, uh, good luck?" -Fynch


Keep Fynch's cover by helping him help you.

entries.title: A Ghost's Duty
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote: Ghost is relieved by your efforts to restore the Traveler.

entries.title: After Winter, Spring
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote:
Ghost's shell buzzes with excitement.


"Guardian, look! No, feel! We've beaten back the Witness's corruption, and the Traveler is healing. The work you-we-no, everyone has done has helped save the Traveler! After everything, I never thought I'd get to help it like this. We were only a small piece of it, but it feels good, doesn't it?"


The collective work of Guardians to heal the Traveler has unlocked the following reward:

entries.title: Destined Heroes
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote:
"Guardian, I think we're in completely new territory. Light and Darkness are powerful but unbalanced. We need to unify them into one coherent force, or they'll tear us apart.


The Dyadic Prism resonates. It's leading us to unify Light and Darkness."

entries.title: Destined Heroes
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote:
Standing on the ledge of the old Tower, you bring Ghost out.


He hovers in front of you, light blinking. "Guardian, I've been doing a lot of thinking. I know I haven't been very enthusiastic about using Darkness in the past, but…at this point, we can't afford to ignore something that can help.


"I've been tracking leads on potential sources of power, both Light and Dark. I still think we should be careful, but…"


He dips slightly in the air. "I think it's what the Traveler wants."

entries.title: Field Work
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote:
"So, Cayde left something with me," Ghost says thoughtfully. "It's a Hunter field journal. I'm not sure where it originated, but the oldest files on it contain fragmentary data from the Golden Age. There's a wealth of information here about the founding of the City, along with field reports on some of humanity's oldest enemies."


Ghost bobs unsteadily in the air. "Our past feels closely tied to our future. Let's be sure to take it with us. It should prove useful."

entries.title: Final Preparations
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote: "We have to be ready for anything." Ghost is uncharacteristically grim. "We'll need every advantage we can get to stop the Witness. Now's not the time to hold back. For you, or me. Whatever happens, we either win or we go down fighting." He looks at you, determined. "Together."

entries.title: Ghost Rank
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote: Complete Pathfinder objectives, Overthrow, Lost Sectors, and Cysts, and open chests in the Pale Heart to increase your Ghost reputation and earn rewards.

entries.title: Legacy: The Final Shape
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote:
Even though your last confrontation with the Witness ended in retreat, you were still able to land a devastating blow-proof that your newfound powers are strong enough to defeat it. 


The Witness was not the only one wounded by the encounter. Ghost's condition has rapidly deteriorated, and it's clear to you that he's only holding himself together so the two of you can finish this. 


And you'll need the Traveler's full power behind you to do so. 


Work with allied reinforcements to weaken and sever the Witness's hold on the Traveler. Only then will you be able to use your mastery over both Light and Darkness to unmake humanity's most ancient enemy.

entries.title: Legacy: The Final Shape
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote:
At the cost of his Light and his Ghost, Zavala has made contact with dissenting voices within the Witness-and has discovered that they hold the key to defeating it. 


You won't allow Targe's sacrifice to amount to nothing. Neither will your Ghost, but the time for mourning will come later. 


Journey with the Vanguard to the memory of the place where the Witness was created and reconnect with the Dissenters.

entries.title: Legacy: The Final Shape
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote:
The Witness is gone. 


But so is Cayde-6, who sacrificed his Light to restore your Ghost's. He bet it all on you. Still, Ghost can feel Cayde's presence. It's as though he and every other Ghost and every other Guardian that came before you are connected by the Traveler's Light. The Witness sought to give meaning to the universe, but Cayde has shown you that meaning-like fate-is yours to choose. His last act was to ensure that you and your Ghost will have a future together in a way that he and Sundance could not. What will you do with it?

entries.title: Legacy: The Final Shape
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote:
The Witness's presence inside the Traveler has manifested as psychic wounds, spreading physical corruption through its Pale Heart. 


These concentrations of Darkness are dangerous. Ghost claims that the damage he took while fighting the Witness's possession is superficial, but you recognize when he's lying. 


Both he and the Traveler are very hurt-and things are only going to get worse if you don't find a way to stop the Witness. 


The Vanguard Warlock, Ikora, will know what to do. You must find her.

entries.title: Legacy: The Final Shape
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote:
Ghost believes that Cayde-6's body is a construct of Light. His mysterious revival inside the Traveler's Pale Heart has changed him in ways that cannot yet be understood. 


You've changed, too. 


Unlocked by the vision you received from the Traveler upon your arrival, new powers flow through you. As momentous a discovery as this is, Ghost is insistent that you partner with Cayde to track down the other Vanguard operatives who have found their way here. 


Partner with Cayde to locate the Crow and his Ghost, Glint.

entries.title: Legacy: The Final Shape
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote:
Believing there to be no other options in the fight against the Witness, Commander Zavala has left camp on a mission to give himself to Darkness. 


What's worse is that he might not be wrong. If the Traveler can't provide you with answers about what to do next, then maybe the entity that reached out to Zavala can. 


Whatever happens, he shouldn't have to face it without his Ghost. Partner with Targe to prevent Zavala from losing himself to Darkness.

entries.title: Legacy: The Final Shape
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote:
Although the Vanguard has been reunited at last, their mood is not as celebratory as Ghost hoped. 


Ikora believes that Zavala's encounter with the Witness has left him emotionally compromised and requires some time alone with him to assess the situation. She and the Commander will meet your fireteam up ahead. 


For now, a mountain erected from the memory of Old Russia stands between you and the Witness's monolith. Ascend.

entries.title: Legacy: The Final Shape
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote:
Ghost is shaken by the Traveler's message: "Devotion, Bravery, Sacrifice, Death." 


He doesn't know what reason the Traveler has for reiterating the old creeds, but it's made him reassess what's important to him-and what's most important to Ghost is his Guardian. You. 


You're in this together, until the end.   


When you're ready, it's time to press on. The Witness's monolith looms large on the horizon…

entries.title: Legacy: The Final Shape
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote:
Evidence points to the Witness weaponizing the Traveler's Light to reshape reality, just as the Traveler once terraformed planets and created Ghosts to raise Guardians. What you've seen inside the Pale Heart is only the beginning. 


It believes itself to be a god of both Light and Darkness. And what are you, if not a god-killer? 


The only members of your fireteam unaccounted for are Commander Zavala and his Ghost, Targe. Locate them before the Witness does.

entries.title: Legacy: The Final Shape
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote:
Ghost is confident that all signs point to the Traveler playing an active role in your fight against the Witness and its forces. Unlike Zavala, his faith seems unshakable. 


For the first time in his life as a Guardian, Zavala wishes to look to the Darkness for answers, but both Cayde and Ikora believe that it's worth trying to commune with the Traveler again instead. 


Regardless of who's right or who's wrong, you must at least try. Find a reliable way to connect with the Traveler.

entries.title: Legend
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote:
"The final days are ahead of us. The clock is ticking, and the fate of the entire universe is at stake." Ghost looks to you, confident and ready for anything. "Guardians make their own fate, and so do Ghosts. Let's get out there and show the Witness what legends truly are." 


You have completed the Legendary campaign. Please select your reward.
