entries.title: The Final Shape + Annual Pass Catalyst
entries.speaker: Ghost
entries.quote: Apply this catalyst to the Exotic Fusion Rifle Tessellation.

entries.title: Any Data Port in a Storm
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
A pre-recorded message from Banshee-44 starts playing at your approach.


"Hey, Guardian. I'm sending you something. Took me a while to figure out what that rifle of yours was doing. You know, the… strange one. Quicksilver something. It's the nanite colony in it. They're working to calibrate to your combat style, but you and the weapon aren't what their base programming expects, so it's taking a while. I wrote up a little code to start the handshake off on the right foot. You'll want to take it through its paces where you are in Neomuna first. Let me know when you've matched the metrics."


He's included a quick summary of numerical objectives. And also a note to himself, for when you bring it back to him.

entries.title: Final Dawn
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
"Guardian… ever think about the things we pick up? People we latch onto, as if something outside of us could tell us who we are?"


Ana is devastated by the loss of Rasputin, by the loss of someone who helped define her identity and self-worth. 


"Rasputin was family to me. A connection to whom I used to be. Now that's gone. He's gone."


Ana recognizes that Rasputin sacrificed himself to save humanity, defining himself not by what others demanded of him, but of what he demanded for himself: to be more than a weapon.


Ana comes away from this with a renewed sense of purpose, and a new outlook on the future.

entries.title: Legacy: Awaken, Queensguard
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Devrim Kay, the Vanguard's stalwart scout in the EDZ, briefs you on the upcoming operation.


Many of the Vanguard's pilots-including Amanda Holliday-went down during the Witness's attack on the Traveler. The Calus-loyal Shadow Legion have started rounding up survivors and taking them to their Pyramid ships. 


You, Devrim, Crow, and Mithrax will be attempting a rescue mission.


The Pyramids themselves are impenetrable, but the ritual Mara is engaging in should help with that.


"Mara is imbuing you with otherworldly power," Devrim says. "Awoken magics and all that… I'm not sure how it works myself, but if she believes you can make it through, I'm not about to disagree."

entries.title: Legacy: Awaken, Queensguard
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
The Vanguard holoprojector, which apparently arrived alongside the Ascendant Scepter, bursts to life with a fuzzy image of Mara Sov, transmitting from the EDZ.


She tells you that she answered the Vanguard's calls for aid in the aftermath of the Witness's attack, and says the battle against the Witness is now being fought on two fronts: one on Neptune, and one on Earth. 


She is relieved the Scepter rests in your hands. "Continue your fight against the Voice in the Darkness," she says. "I will assist as best I can in your absence."


There is concern in her voice. "Return when you are able," she adds. "Your people need their heroes."

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
"My patience has its limits," Caiatl declares. She has waited long enough, and-ritual be damned-she is going to board the Leviathan and destroy Calus's last connection to the lunar Pyramid her way.


There is no guarantee that she will be able to safely survive the incursion without the protection of Eris's ritual magic. 


Hurry to the Leviathan and find Caiatl before it's too late.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Victory! Caiatl has conquered the Nightmare of Ghaul, changing it into a benign Memory. She reflects on this success with pride.


"Most of all, Cabal wish to be seen, our conquests recognized and ratified by the shockwaves they send through the empire. The impact they leave," she says. "But an endless war in pursuit of glory leaves only ashes."
With firm conviction in her voice, Caiatl adds, "When I am gone, it won't be the impact of my conquests that shape the empire. Instead, it will be the quiet of peace, in the company of allies."


In her victory, Caiatl has found peace and purpose. It is time to debrief on the larger situation with Eris.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
"After everything we faced aboard the Leviathan, I'm left to wonder…" Zavala says with a heavy heart, "Have I made the right choices?"


In spite of finding some measure of personal forgiveness, Zavala is still weighed down by uncertainty and doubt. His faith in the Traveler and his choices that led him to where he is now is broken.


"Our minds weren't meant for this many years. Like so many other things, we have a word for eternity, without the capacity to comprehend what it actually means," he says, looking out at the Traveler.


"When is enough… enough?"


Return to the H.E.L.M. and debrief with Eris.

entries.title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer I
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Lakshmi-2, leader of the Future War Cult, tells you that she looked into the future with the FWC's mind-forking machine and saw Mithrax standing in the City amidst gunfire and smoke.


She gave her report to Ikora and the rest of the Vanguard, but she feels her warnings were not taken seriously. She tells you she will do whatever she can to stop that future from taking place.


"When I foresaw the Red War, they laughed… until Ghaul bound the Traveler," she says. "This time, I will not whisper my warnings. I will not be polite."

entries.title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer IV
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Lakshmi-2 expresses regret at her terse words toward Mithrax, but she seems more apologetic about her own behavior than the attack on the Eliksni.


She tells you such an action was natural: "The City is a living thing, and it is rejecting the Fallen like a fever burning out an infection."


"I will speak to the Fallen leader," she says. "Tell it that the Future War Cult will personally replenish their supplies when they are ready to move on."


"I do not wish them to think badly of us."

entries.title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer VIII
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Lakshmi-2 seems pleased with your victory over Quria. She tells you she admires you and hopes you will accept her praise, even though you have had your differences.


"The City deserves someone who acts," she tells you. "Someone who does what is right, even if it is unpopular."


"We will speak more when this ugliness is behind us," she says, "after the Fallen have returned to space and this Endless Night is a memory."

entries.title: Legacy: Retribution
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
"Thanks for taking us along for the ride," Crow says. "You make one hell of a Queensguard."


There's satisfaction in Crow's voice-for the successful attack on the Shadow Legion ship, certainly, but beneath his words, you sense something greater unspoken.


"Wish it didn't have to end, but Mara won't be able to channel her energy out forever. Even if the power of the Awoken fades, you'll always have their gratitude. And Mara's… and mine."


He tells you he'll join Devrim and Mithrax in continuing rescue operations for as long as he can. 


"We can't protect everyone, but helping who we can… nothing's more important than that."


"See you 'round, Guardian."

entries.title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Drifter hums a jaunty tune as he greets you from the holoprojector.


He explains he is taking over for Mithrax while he and Eido study the latest relic you retrieved from Eramis's pirates.


"Eido's researching how to tap into their power," he says. "She thinks something's hidden inside 'em. I swear she was about to crack one open before Mithrax stopped her!"


Drifter pauses a moment. "I took one look and knew those things were bad news," he says. "Reminds me of something… from a long time ago."


Lost in thought, Drifter leaves the call, presumably to do some research of his own.

entries.title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
You find Drifter handling communications while Mithrax is busy speaking with Eido.


"I heard he's dealing with some family issues," Drifter shrugs.


Drifter doesn't seem bothered by Mithrax's earlier outburst toward Spider. "No surprise to me Mithrax has got some secrets," he says. 


As for the tension between Mithrax and Eido, Drifter isn't concerned.


"I'm sure they'll work it out," he says. "Folks have a way of puttin' aside their differences when the world's at stake."

entries.title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
There is desperation in Mithrax's voice as he processes what you have learned: you and Eramis are not the only ones looking for the relics.


"I believed we could collect the relics and contain their power," he says. He seems conflicted-you are not used to seeing him this way.


Mithrax pauses for a moment before he speaks again.


"Guardian, there… are details I have kept from you," he says. "From everyone."


His discomfort is apparent.


"I must ask for the gift of your patience," he implores.


"Trust me for a moment longer, I beg you."

entries.title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Eido's disappointment is evident in her voice. 


"My father," she says. "A murderer, and a liar." She is still coming to terms with what Eramis revealed to you both about Mithrax's past.


"Learning the truth is difficult, but the sharpest pain comes from the fact he did not tell me earlier… I can take only one lesson from this: My own father does not want me to know him."


Eido pledges to continue with the mission, despite her feelings of betrayal.


"I will not become the hypocrite that my father is," she says bitterly, and cuts the holofeed.

entries.title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Mithrax is curt when you speak to him. He is reluctant to discuss his past as a pirate.


"I will not apologize, as I believe the secrets of my old life were mine to keep."


But his voice cracks with deep emotion when he speaks of Eido.


"I am ashamed of my cruelty. Of the things I did, the people I hurt. I thought I left it behind me… but the old Misraaks is still within me, and now he has hurt my daughter-"


He corrects himself. "I have hurt my daughter."


"I was a killer, but I am a Kell," he says. "I will prove to you which title I deserve."

entries.title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
"Mithrax has Eramis at the end of his sword, and then… nothing?"


The hologram of Drifter squints as you tell him of Mithrax's battle against Eramis.


"I thought that guy still had some mean in him," he puzzles. "Guess I was wrong."


Drifter says he has to give you credit; "You did a hell of a job out there."


"Drove Eramis off, stopped whatever plan the Witness had, and brought home all the pieces of Nezarec."


He grins. "Not bad at all."


He seems confident Mithrax and Eido can figure out some way to harness the power of the relics of Nezarec, but until they do, there's nothing to do but enjoy your well-earned riches.


"And don't worry about giving me my cut, Captain," he winks. "It just felt nice to be a good guy again. Trust."

entries.title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Despite the casual atmosphere in The Ether Tank, you receive a Vanguard-secured communication from Eido, dedicated Scribe of House Light.


Eido is already busy studying the relic you reclaimed from Eramis's pirates.


"I am eager to learn the nature of the strange energies that seep from within," she says with unfettered curiosity.


She thanks you for including her as part of your budding pirate crew, and then excuses herself to further study the relic with her father.

entries.title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Eris contacts you in her familiar Human form and reflects on her bond with Ahsa. She appears resolute, but troubled.


"I knew there would be torment in embracing the Hive and the poisonous squall of their violence," she admits. Although Ahsa was a willing and vital component of her transformation, she feels conflicted about involving the gentle creature in her ritual.


"My aim in this grotesque conversion was to shoulder the risk myself," she explains. "But feeding from Ahsa's suffering… that is a line I did not think I would cross."


Her voice is soft and steadfast.


"I refuse to become something I am not."

entries.title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
"I'm gonna give it to you straight, Sunbeam," Immaru says. "I've run the numbers, and your gal Eris doesn't have what it takes… she's nowhere near strong enough to deal with Xivu. You Guardians came up short."


He tells you that he'll go along with the plan for now, but when things start looking dangerous, he's going to leave.


"Savathûn can stay dead for all I care," he says, shrugging his shell in indifference. "Ah, don't look so surprised. Sure, your Ghost would never abandon you, but there's one important difference between him and me: he's an idiot."


He sounds utterly unbothered by his own disloyalty.


"There's no way this ends in anything but a bloodbath," he says simply, "and I don't plan on getting caught in it."

entries.title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Ikora has little time for niceties. This is it, she tells you. The final tithe.


"She asked me to ready something for transmat from the Tower security vault," Ikora tells you, but does not elaborate. Eris awaits, and time is of the essence.


"Empower her, Guardian," Ikora says. "Give Eris the strength she needs to reshape the entire Hive pantheon."


"And then, all we need to do is get out of her way."

entries.title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Immaru hacks into the holoprojector in the H.E.L.M. to deliver something interesting: an excerpt of a prediction from Savathûn.


"The Witness will force the Vanguard's hand eventually," Savathûn says in the recording, "and they'll realize they need information only I possess. One of them will be open to a bargain… not Mara again, poor dear. More likely Ikora, or her gloomy little hanger-on, Eris. Give them any help they ask for-it'll all be worth it in the end."


Immaru stops the audio. "You get all that, Guardian?" he sneers. "Go ahead, bust up the Throne World. Get as strong as you like, tithe to Eris until she's fat as a tick. It's all part of Savathûn's plan."


"You need any help digging your own grave, just let me know," he says, and cuts the feed.

entries.title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Immaru breaks into the holoprojector with distressing news: Xivu Arath's forces have entered Savathûn's throne world and are attacking the Altars of Summoning. 


"This wasn't part of the plan," he warns, "and it's bad news for everybody."


"Savathûn's been hoarding powerful creatures in those summoning pits for a long time," he says, his voice tinged with panic. "If Xivu is able to take that extra power for herself? Forget it, we're all dead."


"You need to claim those tithes for yourself," he says urgently. "Time to get to work, 'hero.'"

entries.title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
You can see Ikora shake her head as she summarizes the reports she's been writing: "Vanguard forces pursuing tithes to Hive-communed Eris Morn have engaged Xivu Arath's forces in Savathûn's throne world."


"We are caught between the sister gods of combat and lies," she says. "We accepted an impossible bargain. Savathûn knew we couldn't defeat Xivu Arath. No one can win a battle against war itself."


You can hear her faith in Eris in her voice, but her concern is clear. "Eris understands this better than any of us," she says, "but I must still prepare for unexpected outcomes. What could I even do to keep her safe?"


"Guardian… be careful. We've lost so much to the Hive already. We can't let them take any more."

entries.title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Immaru hacks the holoprojector with a spiteful screed. 


"I don't think you realize how lost you'd be without Savathûn's plan," he says. "Even dead, she's smarter than you."


"She had it all figured out years ago," he explains. "Take the Traveler, seal it away, keep it hidden from the Witness…. But you stormed the gates. Liberated your darling Traveler, and put it exactly where the Witness knew you would."


Immaru speaks with utter conviction. You can hear the disdain in his voice.


"The Traveler didn't make a mistake when it chose the Hive," he snarls. "It was fixing the mistake it made when it chose you."

entries.title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Ikora admits she feels responsible for Eris's risky transformation.


"While we in the Tower gathered intel and debated over what action to take next, Eris threw herself into a dangerous ritual of her own devising," she says. "She was audacious, and she was right."


Ikora reiterates following the Witness is worth any cost, but she has her reservations. "We had to accept Savathûn's bargain," she says, "but I didn't imagine we would risk Eris in the exchange."


She tells you to tithe to Eris and send her as much power as you can… but Ikora cannot hide her unease. 


"I believe it is in everyone's best interests to keep Eris's metamorphosis as brief as possible," she says diplomatically before signing off.

entries.title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Ikora seems distracted by the reports she has been delivering about Eris's communion with Ahsa.


"There are concerns I cannot dismiss, because I carry them as well," she admits. 


She considers the possible high price of Eris's actions. "The actions of the Witness will have far-reaching and dire consequences, but so would allowing Eris to be consumed by the Hive."


Though Ikora has confidence in the abilities of her old friend, a terrible doubt tinges the edge of her words.


"Eris has always been determined," Ikora says. "Now she has incredible power to match. I trust her to guide us through this… but I fear she may not know when to stop-or even want to."


"The only thing we can offer her now is support," she says firmly. "That is why I need you at her side."

entries.title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Immaru appears on the holoprojector again, this time with a singularly unusual recording to share.


"Savathûn said if you ever got this far, I should play back one of her predictions," he says, and you could swear his voice is soured by envy. "She's almost… rooting for you."


The recording has Savathûn predicting that the Guardians will use Light and Dark to peel back the illusions in her throne world and discover the deep truths hiding beneath.


"That's when things really start to get weird," she says with a grin. "I can't wait to see what they're capable of."


Immaru stops the recording. 


"There you go, a little pat on the head from Savathûn," he spits. "I know you Vanguard types thrive on positive reinforcement."


He grumbles about Eris's inevitable failure and then ends the transmission.

entries.title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
You can tell Eris is exhausted even through the disruption of the holoprojector. 


"It is good to see you," she says. "I was taking a moment to prepare for the ritual."


She takes a breath, and then, as if divulging a secret, tell you that she is anticipating a moment in the midst of her transformation. "A moment born of ugliness and violence, truly earned," she says.


"It is justice."


"So I will step again into the ritual space," she continues, "and as the vile power fills me to bursting, my thoughts will be only of the Hive sisters. Savathûn. Xivu Arath. Of my plans for them."


Her voice drops, as if describing something truly beautiful.


"It is then I find that sweet moment. And deep beneath my hideous mask… I smile."

entries.title: Legacy: We Stand Unbroken
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Devrim hails you as a fellow Queensguard. 


He explains that, even though Mara's ritual does not grant the Lightless the extra abilities that those with the Light enjoy, the title itself is not without meaning.


"It's nice to be included," he says. "'Sir Devrim Kay, Queensguard.' Quite like the sound of that."


He speaks briefly about his theory that the Witness sought to destroy our hope by attacking the Traveler, but that it failed as we united in the aftermath of the attack.


"Humans and Eliksni, officers and civilians-we banded together, stronger than before," he says.


"That's what our enemies don't understand: when things are at their worst, that's when we're at our best."

entries.title: Legacy: We Stand Unbroken
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Amanda is clearly pleased with the recent attack on the Shadow Legion ship. "That's the kinda thing I joined the Vanguard for," she says.


She talks about how much she enjoys working with Mithrax, as if to explain why she shared her story with both him and you.


"He's always so gentle around the Tower. I forget he's an Eliksni war captain," she says. "But I learned quick when we started tackling those prison transports. Once, he got jumped by two Legionaries, and when I turned to help, he just shouted, 'You need not waste your shells!'"


"He's a tough old bastard, and I absolutely love it," she grins.


She tells you she's looking forward to continuing her patrols, then signs off.

entries.title: Legacy: We Stand Unbroken
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Devrim is glad to have caught you. He relays that Mithrax and Amanda were on patrol and followed a distress signal back to a particularly well-defended outpost.


"I was surprised they called it in," Devrim says. "Makes me think the odds are worse than they're letting on. Usually, those two can take care of themselves."


On your map, a waypoint appears in the EDZ.


"I'm sending you their signal now. Head over and back them up, won't you?"

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Still shaking with adrenaline from her confrontation with Clovis, Ana dreads to think what would have happened if his schemes had come to pass.


Though she questions if trusting him was the right decision, she is elated that Rasputin's restoration has come so far as a result.


"It's all I ever wanted for him,," she says, "to be able to communicate, to be able to share his thoughts, his ideas."


Ana warns you to be careful the next time you're on Europa. Clovis's AI still exists within the halls of BrayTech Exoscience, and he will be none too pleased the next time he encounters you.

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Ana puts on a brave face despite the setbacks the mission has incurred. Though the orbital station is still out of reach, Rasputin's reintegration process appears to be working.


"We're making progress. Just keep saying it," she tells herself.


The Vanguard has placed Ana in charge of the operation, with Osiris serving in an advisory role. 


Ana shudders to think what might have happened if you had not touched down on Europa when you did. If Xivu Arath gains control of the Warsats, it could spell doom for humanity.

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Ana acknowledges that trusting Clovis is a risky endeavor, but also admits that his plan appears to be working.


She reflects on a simpler time in her life, when risks were easier to weigh against their rewards.


"Now it's less defined," she laments, "and risk is measured in the inches before Clovis's knife finds my back."


Still, to Ana it's all worth it if it means restoring Rasputin.

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
After reviewing all available intel, Elsie has devised an infiltration plan. She and Ana will help you bypass Seraph Station's security protocols so you can upload a virus that will grant Rasputin access to the network once he's fully restored.


Elsie warns you that there's no telling what your enemies have been doing aboard the station, so you might have to improvise once you're up there.


"But," she says confidently, "that's what you're best at."

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Ana has an idea that's just unconventional enough to work. She recounts how the Iron Lord known as Felwinter was actually an AI developed by Rasputin and installed into an Exo frame.


Her plan is to download latent data from the shards of Felwinter's Ghost and reintegrate them as if he were a submind himself.


"Missing pieces of Rasputin's code, linguistic data, pieces of Felwinter's personality engram… We can use it all!" she exclaims.


Saladin has granted you access to the Ghost's shards at the Iron Temple. This could prove to be the breakthrough you need.

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Mara's Corsairs have informed her of your encounter with the Wrathborn on Europa. As she herself has been monitoring Xivu Arath's movements within the Ascendant Plane, she's reached out to share what she knows.


"While I've yet to discern an exact stratagem," she tells you, "they may be trying to wrest control of the Warmind's destructive power on the Witness's behalf."


She then directs you to the Seraph bunker on the Moon, where her scouts report that the Hive are preparing an assault.

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Osiris is cautiously optimistic that awakened Rasputin will be able answer the lingering questions about his visions.


The term "Nefele Stronghold" has appeared in numerous files recovered from the submind caches. Osiris is certain that following the thread will lead to greater revelations.


"Each time I read it, I hear it whispered in Savathûn's voice," he says.


Still, he knows that time is not on his side. Xivu Arath is on the move, and Osiris vows not to underestimate her again.

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Elsie worries about the similarities she sees between Ana and Clovis: both are driven to achieve their goals, skirting the edge of obsession in the process.


"I've seen where that path can lead," she says ominously.


Thinking back on her decision to trust you on Europa, Elsie wonders if it's time she afforded Ana the same leap of faith.


She reminds herself that for all their similarities, in some respects, Ana is nothing like Clovis at all.

entries.title: More Than a Weapon
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Ana wonders aloud if she made the right decision by teaching Rasputin independent thought and giving him the capacity to simulate Human consciousness.


"Rasputin suffers because I made him capable of suffering," she says.


Calling all of her past actions regarding Rasputin into question, she abruptly closes the channel before she can descend further into despair.

entries.title: Path of the Splicer I
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Lakshmi-2, leader of the Future War Cult, tells you that she looked into the future with the FWC's mind-forking machine and saw Mithrax standing in the City amidst gunfire and smoke.


She gave her report to Ikora and the rest of the Vanguard, but she feels her warnings were not taken seriously. She tells you she will do whatever she can to stop that future from taking place.


"When I foresaw the Red War, they laughed… until Ghaul bound the Traveler," she says. "This time, I will not whisper my warnings. I will not be polite."

entries.title: Path of the Splicer IV
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Lakshmi-2 expresses regret at her terse words toward Mithrax, but she seems more apologetic about her own behavior than the attack on the Eliksni.


She tells you such an action was natural: "The City is a living thing, and it is rejecting the Fallen like a fever burning out an infection."


"I will speak to the Fallen leader," she says. "Tell it that the Future War Cult will personally replenish their supplies when they are ready to move on."


"I do not wish them to think badly of us."

entries.title: Path of the Splicer VIII
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Lakshmi-2 seems pleased with your victory over Quria. She tells you she admires you and hopes you will accept her praise, even though you have had your differences.


"The City deserves someone who acts," she tells you. "Someone who does what is right, even if it is unpopular."


"We will speak more when this ugliness is behind us," she says, "after the Fallen have returned to space and this Endless Night is a memory."

entries.title: The Hidden Shape
entries.speaker: Holoprojector
entries.quote:
Ana crosses her arms and seems thoughtful. "I've been looking over the records we have of Seraph Station, and I've found several references to something called Revision Zero."


"I think it's some kind of weapon, but the references to it were highly redacted in the BrayTech archives and the unredacted copies were deleted," Ana says with a sigh. "But from what I could determine, it looks like a weapon. An old one."


Ana squares her shoulders. "Whatever it is, you should make sure you get it while you're up there; otherwise, it'll fall into House Salvation's hands."

entries.title: A Guardian Rises
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Welcome home, Guardian. I heard your journey to the Last City was an eventful one," Ikora says as she gazes at the Traveler. "It may not feel like it now, but the tribulations you faced were a blessing." She turns to address you; her stare is piercing.


"A Guardian's path is one of hardship and peril. The Traveler's gifts pave the way, but the road is still a hard one to walk."


"But you need not walk it alone. The Vanguard is here for you, as are your fellow Guardians in the Last City."


She hands you a small lacquered box.


"Accept help where you can find it, Guardian. Our Light shines brighter when we're together."

entries.title: A Legendary Hero
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"The Light alone does not make one a Guardian," Ikora says warmly as you approach. "Dedication, bravery, the will to protect those who can't protect themselves… they are what define us. And you are a shining example of them all. Thank you."


You have completed the Legendary campaign. Please select your reward.

entries.title: A Legendary Hero
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"The Light alone does not make one a Guardian," Ikora says warmly as you approach. "Dedication, bravery, the will to protect those who can't protect themselves… they are what define us. And you are a shining example of them all. Thank you."


You have completed the Legendary campaign. Please select your reward.

entries.title: A Spark of Hope
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"There is a record of a powerful weapon listed in our archives: an Arc-powered Submachine Gun lost during the Collapse.


"We recovered the frame of this weapon during a Vanguard operation, but it was incomplete, lacking the necessary power source to operate it.


"Thanks to you and Shaw, we believe we have such a power source in the superconductor.


"The inoperable frame was hidden somewhere in the EDZ by a former Hunter Vanguard. We have a scout there, Devrim Kay. He can help you find it again."

entries.title: A Spark of Hope
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Your timing is fortuitous. There is a record of a powerful weapon in the archives: an Arc-powered Submachine Gun lost in the Collapse. We recovered the frame, but it was incomplete, lacking the Arc power source."


"That changes today, with your discovery of the superconductor." Ikora clasps her hands together, as though slotting a key into a lock. "Find Devrim Kay, our scout in the EDZ. He can direct you to the inoperable frame."


"One final consideration." Ikora smiles grimly. "You will need all the tools at your disposal to succeed in this task. The Light has many possibilities for you to explore. Expand your mind, deepen your experience, and learn to harness the Light in new ways."


You can now acquire additional Light subclasses from Ikora Rey.

entries.title: Ares Desperado
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora nods as your approach. "Osiris tells me you foiled quite the scheme: an indirect attack to rip Rasputin out from under our feet. Devious," Ikora says, eyes drawn down in contemplation.


"I was wondering when we'd see the Sol Divisive again. After the destruction of their Undying Mind, I'd hoped they'd slink back into the Black Garden forever… but the Witness has other plans for them."


Ikora straightens and looks you in the face.


"I think Osiris might be right. The Sol Divisive, the Witness… they weren't just trying to lock away Rasputin's subminds. They were looking for something," Ikora says. 


"The Seraph complex you cleared wasn't just a prison, it was a treasure trove of Golden Age data, weapon schematics, navigational charts, and I'm sure much more." She chuckles to herself. "I'm sure our Foundries will be tripping over themselves to claim and print Seraph weapon schematics."


"Ana's pulling together a fireteam as we speak to recover and transfer it all to the Tower's archives. Whatever it was the Vex were looking for, we'll find it."


Ikora takes a breath. "Thank you, Guardian, for not letting Osiris go alone. And good work."

entries.title: Ares Desperado
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Guardian." Ikora acknowledges you as you approach before producing a holo-tab report from her robes.


"My Hidden have been tracking a series of temporal distortions moving across Mars. Everything seemed benign until they stopped near an old Seraph complex in the northern wastes."


Ikora waits a moment for you to finish reading the holo-tab brief.


"As you can see, that Seraph complex then sprang back to life, for the first time since the Collapse, no less." Ikora looks stern. "We'd be fools not to take that as an ill omen."


Ikora shifts before speaking again. "Osiris already wants to run headlong into an investigation, but I don't want him chasing leads onto unsteady ground."


Ikora's face softens as she sees your reaction.


"I worry about him hurting himself. I would have denied his request to be involved at all if Ana wasn't sure this was important."


Ikora takes the holo-tab as you return it to her. "That's why I want you to go in his stead. He trusts you, and that was the only way he'd stay out of the field…"

entries.title: As a Friend
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Speak to Ikora about what you did to help Eris with the phantoms that haunted her.



        Ikora believes Eris is more than just an ally. She's a friend. One you've stood by through thick and thin. 


Ikora thanks you. She feels nothing but admiration and appreciation for you and your efforts in helping Eris Morn on the Moon.

entries.title: As Prophesied
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Though the attack to the City was thwarted, Ikora was solemn.


She told you that Lakshmi-2's body was recovered from the City-she was one of the first to fall to the Vex. "In the end, she was right about the tragedy looming on our horizon," she said. "If only she could have foreseen that it was of her own making."


The Future War Cult, New Monarchy, and Dead Orbit have fled the City, and she has been unable to locate Osiris. She seems to be taking the losses hard, and she places some of the blame on herself.


"I saw the blight that was forming in our own citizens," she told you, "but I never thought it would lead us here."


She cautioned you to stay wary of what tomorrow may bring. "Eris once said we will only know our enemy's next move if we are wise enough to recognize it," she said.


"My eyes are wide open now. Stay ready."

entries.title: Challenges
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Hey Guardian.



        Though your connection to the Light has been restored, you are far from realizing your true potential. Ikora is here to help-but only if you commit to challenging yourself at every turn.  


Each day, new challenges await. Complete them to earn bonus rewards.

entries.title: Challenges
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: You've risen to the challenge and emerged stronger for it.

entries.title: Challenges
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Though your connection to the Light has been restored, you are far from realizing your true potential. Ikora is here to help-but only if you commit to challenging yourself at every turn.  


Each day, new challenges await. Complete them to earn bonus rewards.

entries.title: Clarion Call: Warlocks
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Hey Guardian,



        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

entries.title: Clarion Call: Warlocks
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

entries.title: Curse of Osiris
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
To find Panoptes, you'll need a map of the Infinite Forest. Ikora believes you can find one in the Pyramidion on Io.


Retrieve the map by completing mission "Deep Storage" on Io.

entries.title: Curse of Osiris
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: Complete mission "Omega" on Mercury.

entries.title: Dawning Delivery
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: Ikora gives a small smile at the familiar-looking confection. Perhaps her connection to the Traveler runs deeper than you thought.

entries.title: Dawning's Gift: Ikora
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: As you gave her the book you could swear you saw a hint of a smile on Ikora's face, but it's already gone.

entries.title: End of the Light & Dark Saga
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
After your adventures in the Pale Heart, Ikora seems nostalgic to be back at her post. 


"It feels strange to come back to the Tower," she says. Her tone is bittersweet. "I look over at the ramen counter and half-expect to see Cayde."


"I almost got used to having him back."


She shakes her head to clear her thoughts.


"I want to say that things will be different now… but it seems the only constant in our world is conflict. The next threat to the Vanguard could take any form, and strike at any time."


She catches herself and laughs softly. 


"Listen to me… I sound like Zavala," she says. "Time spent with old friends will do that to you."


She smiles. "When the Vanguard needs you, we know you'll be there."


"Until then."

entries.title: Exalting the Flame
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Imagine the gentle warmth of dawn, escalating to the blazing fury of the midday sun." Ikora extends her hands, as if catching sunlight in her open palms. "That is the essence of Solar Light: a balm to your friends, and a scourge to your foes."


"For now, focus on using Solar to Scorch your targets. Those you Scorch will burn over time and can even ignite with repeated applications of Scorch."


Ikora folds her hands once more. "There is no substitute for practice, and Solar Light may take some time to learn. Return when you have mastered Scorch, and I will guide you down the path of greater power."

entries.title: Exalting the Flame
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora looks pleasantly surprised by the strange object you unearthed in the EDZ. "How did you discover this? It appears to be a relic of the Golden Age, and it resonates with Solar power." Sure enough, the emitter glows and dims in time with your breathing when you hand it over. 


She makes a thoughtful sound, looking you over. "It would spell trouble for the Vanguard if other relics like this fell into the wrong hands. Guardian, there is an arms dealer operating out of the EDZ. We believe he is supplying weapons to the Shadow Legion, so I'm sending you to shut down his operations."


Ikora gives you a small but genuine smile. "Here. This will empower your Solar abilities further." She presents you with a piece of armor; it's soothingly warm to the touch. "I have every confidence in your victory and high hopes for your potential. When you return, seek out Banshee-44. He'll have something for your efforts."

entries.title: Exalting the Flame
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora extends her hands, as if catching sunlight in her open palms. "You have already felt the blazing power of Solar Light. It is only the start to a deeper understanding."


"For now, focus on using Solar to Scorch your targets. Those you Scorch will burn over time and can even ignite with repeated applications of Scorch."


Ikora folds her hands once more. "It may take some time to fully master Scorch. Be patient, and when you return, I will guide you down the path of greater power."

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: Complete Meditations to obtain Vanguard Research Tokens and earn Level 20 rewards from Ikora Rey.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: Your reputation with Vanguard Research precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: Your reputation in the Crucible precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: Complete Meditations to obtain Vanguard Research tokens and earn Level 20 rewards from Ikora Rey.

entries.title: Final Dawn
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora is silent. She stands facing the empty space in the sky that once held the Traveler and says nothing. A cool breeze blows across the plaza, picking up dried leaves and scraps of paper from the Bazaar.


The silence that has fallen over the Tower is haunting.


Ikora turns and exhales a long-held breath. "If you've come to me for guidance, I have none." The words fall heavy out of her mouth. "Nothing could have prepared me for this." She looks away for a moment, not ready to cross this conversational line. But then she finds her strength again.


"Guardian." Ikora's voice has an adamancy to it. "Whatever comes next, I want you to know it has been an honor fighting alongside you. Through loss, through victory, through the haze of war between. I don't know if this is humanity's final hour…" she says, looking up to the sky. "But if it is, then we will face the end together."


Ikora looks at you, and for the first time, you see something new in her eyes: fear.


"Go… spend time with the people you love," Ikora says in quiet certainty. "It may be your last chance to."

entries.title: Forsaken
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: You've rid the system of Cayde's killers, and Ikora sleeps easier at night because of it. But she still worries about the future of the Vanguard. The Hunters are without a leader. Zavala is more withdrawn than ever. And Ikora wonders if the worst is yet to come.

entries.title: Forsaken
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Zavala has forbidden Guardians from traveling to the Reef for fear of starting a war with Uldren. So, officially, Ikora can't help you.


But unofficially, Ikora tips you off that Uldren and his Fallen Barons have gathered on a stretch of the Reef known as the Tangled Shore. If you want revenge, there's the place to start.


Take a hint from Ikora and investigate the Tangled Shore in mission "High Plains Blues."

entries.title: Gazing Into The Abyss
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"The pull of the Void has attracted many Guardians with… unorthodox world views. It remains a uniquely perplexing manifestation of the Light," Ikora says, gazing at a swirl of violet particles rising from the palm of her hand.


"Perhaps this mystery is what enamors so many Lightbearers. Perhaps it is the unquenchable thirst with which the Void consumes our enemies."


She snaps her fingers, and the particles coalesce into a singularity that blinks out of existence.


"To seek the truth of the matter is to join venerated orders of Void-wielders: Nightstalkers; Voidwalkers; Sentinels. If this is your path, Guardian, walk it carefully."

entries.title: Guardian of All
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: Ikora is impressed by your dedication to accepting and completing bounties. She offers a reward to commemorate your efforts.

entries.title: Ikora Flay
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"The Festival of the Lost honors those who have passed on," Ikora says. "Sad, yes, but also happy-we are still here to preserve their memories."


She smiles. "That's something to celebrate. So go on, lead the celebration. Eva has some very clever masks this year."

entries.title: Ikora Flay
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"The Festival of the Lost honors those who have passed on," Ikora says. "Sad, yes, but also happy-we are still here to preserve their memories."


She smiles. "That's something to celebrate. So go on, lead the celebration. And please, accept a few extra sweets from me. Zavala and I are still very grateful for your loyalty."

entries.title: Ikora ponders the Tenets.
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora seems to be in a contemplative mood. "Much ink has been spilled about the Tenets. Can't devotion be blind, and bravery foolish? Why must we sacrifice? And why speak of death at all?"


She shakes her head slightly. "But they are not virtues, or aspirations. They are a reminder of why we are here. In the early days of the Dark Ages, there were tales of Lightbearers who turned away from the battle altogether. They reasoned that the problems of humanity did not concern them. They would endure regardless, so there was no need to form attachments to this transient world."


Then she turns to you, the corners of her mouth curving up. "So, what makes us different? It must be our devotion to others. Our compassion, justice, and love. I think the Guardians who first gave voice to the Tenets must have come to the same conclusion."

entries.title: Ikora Rey
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
With renewed purpose, Ikora has resumed her role as head of Vanguard Research. Find her in the Bazaar and see how she's doing.



        You changed the future-and in doing so, helped Ikora, Osiris, and Sagira change their present.


With a true friend by your side, the possibilities are infinite.

entries.title: Ikora Rey
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Your bravery inspires, Guardian."


As you continue to explore destinations, more world quests will become available to you.


Check in with faction vendors across the solar system regularly to acquire new quests and rewards.

entries.title: Ikora Rey
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora realized that the more we learn, the less we know. She now reflects on past events and meditates on the bright future promised by a reborn and living Traveler. She has also found in you a friend, someone she can trust. For her, that can be rare. 


Return to Ikora Rey to relive past Red War activities.

entries.title: Ikora Rey
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora Rey has heard of your success in saving Saint-14 from the Infinite Forest and wishes to thank you. Visit her in the Tower Annex.



        Ikora gives you her heartfelt thanks for rescuing Saint-14. It's not often that a tragic loss can be undone. She cautions you against making a habit of experimenting with other timelines, though.


She tells you her Hidden will monitor the Sundial, and asks for your help in continuing to thwart the Red Legion's efforts on Mercury.

entries.title: Ikora Rey
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora Rey has heard of your victory over the Undying Mind and wishes to congratulate you. Visit her in the Tower Annex.



        Ikora congratulates you on your victory over the Undying Mind. As always, she is impressed by your dedication to protecting the City from the enemies of humanity, and she thanks you for your bravery.

entries.title: Ikora's Challenge
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Well done, Guardian.



        Each day you renew your commitment to challenge yourself, your Light shines a little brighter.

entries.title: Ikora's Challenge
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: Each day you renew your commitment to challenge yourself, your Light shines a little brighter.

entries.title: In the Shadow of the Mountain
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"I wonder how many other long-buried bones still hold fast to their last living desires," Ikora says, as you approach. "Anger can keep that fire burning for a long time."


Ikora sighs, "Hopefully revenge was enough."


"Now these Scorn, from House of Kings… I had assumed they belonged to the Witness, or were connected to the Pyramid incursion into the EDZ months ago. I was not expecting… this."


Ikora's head droops as she considers the situation.


"I'll assign a watcher to the area to make sure they stay buried this time. Hopefully this is the last we hear of Scorn on Earth."

entries.title: In the Shadow of the Mountain
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora acknowledges your approach with a short bow before handing you a datapad. 


"Guardian, I've received a number of alarming sightings from Hidden patrolling the EDZ. Scorn, on Earth."


Ikora watches your reaction before continuing.


"Crow already confirmed trails of Dark Ether leading into the mountains of the EDZ. I'd like you to lead a team off his intel and figure out where they're coming from."


Ikora steps forward, "And, once you do, put a stop to it."

entries.title: Increase Reputation
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: Show Ikora proof of your work supporting Vanguard Research.

entries.title: Into the Abyss
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Ah, a fellow practitioner of Void Light. I hope that in time, you come to regard the cosmic abyss with as much fascination and awe as I do." A warm, almost wistful smile flickers across Ikora's face.


"Mastery will come with time and practice. For the moment, focus on Void's ability to weaken your targets. Weakened foes have a harder time fighting back, giving you an immediate advantage. " 


Ikora gives you a piercing look, suddenly stern. "A word of caution, Guardian. Do not emulate me when I was younger: brash, proud, and impatient. Void Light is as subtle as it is potent, and it will take time to master Weaken. Return when you have done so, and I will guide you down the path of greater power."

entries.title: Into the Abyss
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Ah, a fellow Voidwalker. The cosmic abyss feels terrifying at first, but soon you will come to know it as well as I do." A warm, almost wistful smile flickers across Ikora's face.


"Mastery will come with time and practice. For the moment, focus on Void's ability to weaken your targets. Weakened foes have a harder time fighting back, giving you an immediate advantage. " 


Ikora gives you a piercing look, suddenly stern. "A word of caution, Guardian. Do not emulate me when I was younger: brash, proud, and impatient. Void Light is as subtle as it is potent, and it will take time to master Weaken. Return when you have done so, and I will guide you down the path of greater power."

entries.title: Into the Abyss
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora holds the strange object you found on Nessus. "Does it also whisper to you?" She gives you a faint, knowing smile. "Fear is a natural response to the unknown. But in time, the Void's voice will become familiar to you."


"As for the Vex, the surge in their activity is troubling. I'm sorry to send you back to Nessus so soon, Guardian. But if the Vex were in possession of a Void artifact like this one, we need to be proactive and disrupt their operations."


She presents you with a piece of armor. It's strangely cold to the touch. "This should help you unlock the full potential of Void. When you return from Nessus, find Banshee-44. He'll have something to reward you for your efforts."


"And Guardian…" She does not hide the excitement in her voice. "If you wish to continue uncovering the Void's deepest mysteries, you need but ask."

entries.title: Introduction: Quests
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"The more you explore, the closer we come to reclaiming our lost worlds, and the countless treasures they hide."


Each Destination holds its own mysteries, adventures and rewards. The Faction Vendors on each world will provide guidance.


Don't be a stranger! Visit the Faction Vendors on each Destination. Complete the World Quests they offer to gain XP and rewards, including powerful new weapons.

entries.title: Introduction: Quests
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"The more you explore, the closer we come to reclaiming our lost worlds and the countless treasures they hide."


Each destination holds its own mysteries, adventures, and rewards. Visit the faction vendors on each destination. Complete the world quests they offer to gain XP and rewards, including powerful new weapons.

entries.title: Ironclad Faith
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
You find Ikora reviewing a holographic map of the Last City's defenses, featuring highlighted icons at the sites of your recent victories. She minimizes the map and addresses you.


"Thank you for working with Shaxx to break the Witness's siege. Every inch of ground we gain now will be invaluable to our civilians once we're through the portal."


"Make no mistake: these attacks may look like unchecked aggression, but the Witness's forces have a strategic goal. They're hoping a pressure campaign will keep our Lightbearers pinned in the Last City, and out of the portal." 


Ikora's eyes narrow, and for a moment her impatience shines through. "They're playing for time. Time we can't afford to lose."


"Keep working to stabilize our defenses. The more you accomplish before Mara and Osiris reopen the portal, the more of our forces will be available for a counterattack."


Her tone grows flinty with determination. "And then we'll finally show the Witness the power of humanity's resolve."

entries.title: Know Thy Enemy
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: So many Vex, so many parts. It seems like it will never be enough, but we must keep building. This portal is our only hope.

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act II
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora seems troubled as she lays out the details of Failsafe's plan. 


Thanks to the amount of data you've claimed from the Vex, finding the Conductor's coordinates is technically possible, but would require a vast amount of control data gathered from Vex isolated from Nessus's network. This data would have to have been collected over centuries, recorded with perfect clarity, and preserved in the Vex network itself.


"There is only one accessible database with that kind of fidelity," she says grimly. 


The mind of Saint-14-the Saint-14 who died in the Infinite Forest and whose body is still held deep in a Vex simulation.


Claiming this data will involve incredible risk, both to yourself and the despondent Saint.


Nevertheless, Ikora says, "Our future may depend on Saint… again."

entries.title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act II
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora dispatches you to Nessus to investigate the redirected flows of radiolaria beneath its surface.


Unravel the secrets left behind in the wake of the Echo and discover the truth about the Conductor.

entries.title: Legacy: As Prophesied
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Though the attack to the City was thwarted, Ikora was solemn.


She told you that Lakshmi-2's body was recovered from the City-she was one of the first to fall to the Vex. "In the end, she was right about the tragedy looming on our horizon," she said. "If only she could have foreseen that it was of her own making."


The Future War Cult, New Monarchy, and Dead Orbit have fled the City, and she has been unable to locate Osiris. She seems to be taking the losses hard, and she places some of the blame on herself.


"I saw the blight that was forming in our own citizens," she told you, "but I never thought it would lead us here."


She cautioned you to stay wary of what tomorrow may bring. "Eris once said we will only know our enemy's next move if we are wise enough to recognize it," she said.


"My eyes are wide open now. Stay ready."

entries.title: Legacy: Echoes Act II: A Distant Reply
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora has given you a full briefing about the object that fell to Nessus. The Vanguard has taken to calling it the Echo.


"Thousands of civilizations across the universe, all visited by the Black Fleet," Ikora says gravely. "Memories from the victims of the Pyramids, held by the Darkness, then coalesced by the Light into artifacts as sharp and fatal as their pain."


"That's where this Echo came from," she says. "At least, that's our theory."


"My Hidden will keep searching for whatever answers the Witness's death can give us," Ikora assures you. "Hopefully they number more than the questions it left behind."


As Ikora searches for clues to the Echo's purpose, you must explore the depths of Nessus. "Massive amounts of radiolaria have been diverted beneath the planet's crust," Ikora warns. 


"We need to find out what the Vex are building there."

entries.title: Legacy: Forsaken
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: You've rid the system of Cayde's killers, and Ikora sleeps easier at night because of it. But she still worries about the future of the Vanguard. The Hunters are without a leader. Zavala is more withdrawn than ever. And Ikora wonders if the worst is yet to come.

entries.title: Legacy: Forsaken
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Zavala has forbidden Guardians from traveling to the Reef for fear of starting a war with Uldren. So, officially, Ikora can't help you.


But unofficially, Ikora tips you off that Uldren and his Fallen Barons have gathered on a stretch of the Reef known as the Tangled Shore. If you want revenge, there's the place to start.


Take a hint from Ikora and investigate the Tangled Shore in mission "High Plains Blues."

entries.title: Legacy: Lightfall
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora stresses the importance of continuing on, despite that the situation seems dire. There is much we don't understand still-what the Witness has done to the Traveler, or where the Witness has gone. The Ghosts have been clear: they no longer feel the Traveler's presence as they once did, though the Light still remains in them.


In Ikora's breath, there is the gravity of worry. Preliminary scans say no technology at our disposal can survive entry to the portal created in the Traveler. That rules out even Guardians. The conclusion after speaking with Osiris is that the Veil must somehow be key to this mystery, even if it's not yet clear how. The connection that was made, the properties for which the Witness required it-somewhere in these things is an answer. It only needs to be found.


Return to Neomuna. Aid our new allies there; learn what you can of the Veil and of Strand. Anything you find, no matter how small, may help turn the tide.

entries.title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer I
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora welcomes you back and tells you she's pleased you'll be working together.


Mithrax and the House of Light Splicers are working tirelessly to decode the data you retrieve from the Vex network.


Ikora has ordered Saint-14 to oversee the humanitarian operations in the Eliksni Quarter. "If we can turn the Kell-breaker into an advocate for House Light, then others will follow," she says.


"Where the Darkness seeks to divide us, we need only offer out a hand."

entries.title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer IV
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora reports that someone sabotaged the House of Light camp in the Eliksni Quarter.


"This wasn't just an attack on their Ether stores," she says. "Someone wanted to send a message."


She suspects that Lakshmi-2's radio messages triggered the unrest.


"The Vanguard has tolerated her broadcasts, as Zavala doesn't believe it's our place to interfere in civilian politics," she says. "I see now that was a mistake."


She sent Saint-14 down to the Eliksni Quarter to keep the peace and asks you to join him.


"Be the calm the City needs," she says.

entries.title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer VI
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora's voice is grim as she explains that Quria's presence in the Vex network means that Savathûn, the Witch Queen, is behind the Endless Night.


"When the time comes, I'll put a spear of Light through the Witch Queen's heart myself," she tells you. "For now, I'm turning over all Hidden records and full archival access to Osiris… but no one else."


"Continue your Splicer training with Mithrax," she says. "Use it to root Savathûn's minions out. We'll reassess the situation when we've located our target."

entries.title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer VIII
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Quria has been defeated, but there is no relief in Ikora's voice.


"The Dreaming Mind's defeat, as with so many things Vex, is a process," she says. "It will take time for Mithrax and his Splicers to finish untangling our reality from the Vex network."


She is now concerned with helping Osiris reach Lakshmi-2, who still believes the Eliksni will cause the dark future she saw.


But above all, Ikora is watching for Savathûn's next move.


"Everything she does is for a reason, even if it seems beyond our comprehension," she says. "I want to know what she hoped to gain."

entries.title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Your discoveries within the Pyramid are key to the future and survival of all-but the Nightmares continue their attack across the entire system, beyond our Moon. They must not be allowed to spread any further.


Stay vigilant. Keep Nightmares at bay on every planet.


Our fight has only just begun.

entries.title: Legacy: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora believes the worm statue you found before may not be a statue at all, but instead the calcified corpse of the worm itself. The memory locked within is ancient - too ancient to reveal by normal means. But Ikora has a plan, and it involves the Relic.


Meet Ikora on Mars.

entries.title: Legacy: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora reckons with the revelation that she may be partly responsible for Savathûn's theft of the Light. But with the news that Savathûn also intends to pull the Traveler into her throne world and seal it away, there is no time to lose. She sends you to Fynch to follow up on another lead.


Complete "The Cunning" mission in the Throne World.

entries.title: Legacy: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora believes that when you picked up Sagira's shell, you heard a fragment of a memory belonging to Savathûn. Your interaction with the Relic unlocked a new ability in you, one related to Darkness. She believes you can strengthen this ability at the Europan Pyramid, and in doing so, gain access to the full memory linked to Sagira's shell.


Complete "The Communion" mission at the Europan Pyramid.

entries.title: Legacy: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
With Savathûn dead, Ikora wants your help answering some lingering questions about the Witness. Queen Mara Sov has requested your presence, and Ikora believes she has vital information to share.


Meet Mara Sov, Queen of the Awoken, near the Relic.

entries.title: Legacy: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora is daunted by the news of the Lucent Hive. She wants answers, but first, she asks you to visit the Pyramid Relic. She believes the fragment you found on Savathûn's ship might be a related artifact.


Visit the Relic in the Enclave on Mars, then report back to Ikora.

entries.title: Legacy: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora is intrigued by your discovery: the Relic is capable of shaping objects based on memories. She believes there is more to learn from this device, but the threat of Savathûn must take precedence. Ikora asks you to search for answers in the Witch Queen's throne world.


Complete "The Investigation" mission in the Throne World.

entries.title: Legacy: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora believes the secret we learned from the worm familiar is the key to stopping Savathûn's ritual to pull the Traveler into her throne world. This information could be enough to destabilize her. But you'll need to reveal the memory to Savathûn herself…


As you speak, the ritual is already beginning. Complete "The Ritual" mission in the Throne World.

entries.title: Legacy: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora explains that there's a final step to accessing the memory linked to Sagira's shell. You need to locate a concentration of psychic energy that will help manifest the memory. The Hidden have identified such a location in Savathûn's throne world.


Complete "The Mirror" mission in the Throne World.

entries.title: Lightfall
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora stresses the importance of continuing on, despite that the situation seems dire. There is much we don't understand still-what the Witness has done to the Traveler, or where the Witness has gone. The Ghosts have been clear: they no longer feel the Traveler's presence as they once did, though the Light still remains in them.


In Ikora's breath, there is the gravity of worry. Preliminary scans say no technology at our disposal can survive entry to the portal created in the Traveler. That rules out even Guardians. The conclusion after speaking with Osiris is that the Veil must somehow be key to this mystery, even if it's not yet clear how. The connection that was made, the properties for which the Witness required it-somewhere in these things is an answer. It only needs to be found.


Return to Neomuna. Aid our new allies there; learn what you can of the Veil and of Strand. Anything you find, no matter how small, may help turn the tide.

entries.title: Meditation
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"I was out for a walk this morning when I heard two children laughing. I didn't think much of it. I kept on my way. What was so funny? I don't know; I'll never know.


"Yet as I've continued to reflect on that moment, I realized… I don't remember the last time I laughed. Truly, uncontrollably laughed.


"The weight of our responsibilities can sap the joy out of the mundane, yet some of the deepest insights one can have come packaged in jokes.


"Don't lose your sense of humor, Guardian. Meditate on something that makes you smile today."

entries.title: Meditation
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"You and I have seen our share. We have our stories, our successes, our regrets. A tapestry of beautiful experience.


"We are united by strange forces which we barely understand, and they afford us a life we could never have dreamed of.


"Through the challenge, through the pain, through the worry for tomorrow, we must always recognize this truth:


"It is good to be a Guardian. Don't forget it."

entries.title: Meditation
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Time to meditate once again. It may seem repetitive, but ritual is essential. I learned that when I was studying under Osiris. 


"Osiris has always had his head in the clouds. Cosmic priorities, galactic concerns, universal woes. When he was driven out of the City, one of the major complaints lodged against him was his absence. The people of this City did not see his contribution, didn't think he was worth the trouble of the zealots that gathered round him.


"I like to think I got a glimpse of the real Osiris. The Osiris that could never lead a cult of personality. The Osiris who eats, breathes, and sleeps, however seldom." Ikora cracks a smile.


"There was one thing Osiris never failed to do day in, day out. With careful precision, he prepared himself a cup of tea at exactly the same time, in exactly the same manner. I'm certain that a man who so dutifully observed this tradition could never have lost his head in the clouds.


"Don't lose sight of the here and now, Guardian. The future can't exist without it."

entries.title: Meditation
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"There are few feelings quite like coming back home. What do you feel when you arrive home? Is it happiness, relief, nostalgia for what you left behind?


"I recall one homecoming after a lengthy mission. I stepped into my bedroom and was confronted by, to my surprise, unease. It was so empty. The walls, the floors, my space was simply that… space. Being away for so long gave me new perspective, reminded me of the importance of creating a place where you can truly be comfortable, truly yourself. I resolved never to neglect that need again.


"Close your eyes, envision your home. Whatever peculiar sense comes to you, meditate on that, Guardian."

entries.title: Meditation
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"The Light is a beautiful thing, a privilege. One that so many will never experience the way you and I do.


"Why are we so lucky? Many ask, but there's never an answer. I prefer to think about why so many are unlucky, passed up for the privilege which you and I take for granted.


"How many times have I died? How many second chances at life have I been given? I can scarcely count. Yet so many live with the knowledge that they only get one.


"If you're hoping for a message, a point. I'm afraid I don't have one. It feels wrong, but it is."

entries.title: Meditation
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"It can be difficult to manage the weight of expectations. The expectations placed on us by our roles as Guardians, how we serve those who need us, but also those expectations we foist on ourselves.


"You have taken on even more power, unlocked even more potential. These new abilities may not sit right at first. Don't lose faith if not everything comes naturally.


"We all falter under the weight of expectations. Pick yourself back up, and carry them again tomorrow."

entries.title: Meditation
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Looking into the sky, I can't help but see all we've lost. People, perspectives, whole planets. I began this fight so long ago, I've lost more than I had when I started.


"Yet the fight will continue because it must. We will lose much, much more.


"Prepare yourself for that. Meditate on what you've lost. Feel it in your fingers, then let it go."

entries.title: Meditation
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"You have become a truly formidable force. This power makes it easy to forget our true purpose.


"Our Light is a beacon, and though we may be forced to wield it as a weapon, battle is not its true purpose.


"What is its true purpose? I'm not sure I can say with certainty, but I feel it is far deeper than any single word can contain.


"Meditate on this, Guardian. Sometimes uncertainty yields the greatest insights."

entries.title: Meditation
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"You and I have seen our share. We have our stories, our successes, our regrets. A tapestry of beautiful experience.


"We are united by strange forces which we barely understand, and they afford us a life we could never have dreamed of.


"Through the challenge, through the pain, through the worry for tomorrow, we must always recognize this truth:


"It is good to be a Guardian. Don't forget it."

entries.title: Meditation
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"I once read a poem of a man whose soul was incinerated after staring at the sun for too long. Far from dead, he lived the rest of his days in communion with the universe itself, blessing the people of his small village with wisdom beyond peer.


"A strange tale, but one I find myself relating to after particularly… intense lessons from the Traveler in meditation.


"So, Guardian," Ikora says and smiles, "what wisdom might you share with me?"

entries.title: Meditation
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Hello again, Guardian. The Traveler has many lessons to teach us. If only we were all so receptive to them as you have been.


"In my quieter moments, I begin to think I may understand just what these lessons mean. Yet the moment I concentrate on them, they slip away.


"Though these moments may confuse us, the pursuit is worth the frustration that can follow. Meditate on that today."
