entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"I once read a poem of a man whose soul was incinerated after staring at the sun for too long. Far from dead, he lived the rest of his days in communion with the universe itself, blessing the people of his small village with wisdom beyond peer.


"A strange tale, but one I find myself relating to after particularly… intense lessons from the Traveler in meditation.


"So, Guardian," Ikora says and smiles, "what wisdom might you share with me?"

entries.title: Meditation
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"You have become a truly formidable force. This power makes it easy to forget our true purpose.


"Our Light is a beacon, and though we may be forced to wield it as a weapon, battle is not its true purpose.


"What is its true purpose? I'm not sure I can say with certainty, but I feel it is far deeper than any single word can contain.


"Meditate on this, Guardian. Sometimes uncertainty yields the greatest insights."

entries.title: Meditation
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Looking into the sky, I can't help but see all we've lost. People, perspectives, whole planets. I began this fight so long ago, I've lost more than I had when I started.


"Yet the fight will continue because it must. We will lose much, much more.


"Prepare yourself for that. Meditate on what you've lost. Feel it in your fingers, then let it go."

entries.title: Meet Ikora Rey
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Welcome, Guardian. There are many worlds to explore, and countless treasures to discover."


Ikora Rey offers special rewards to Guardians who explore destinations, alone or with friends.


Hover over the quest icon below, and select it with .


ACQUIRE QUEST

entries.title: New Lessons in Light
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Just who I was hoping to see," says Ikora as you approach. She smiles warmly. 


"You know, of course, that the Light is a living thing. Ever do we find new ways to wield it. I have some suggestions to offer, should you wish to try your hand at a new approach. Come and meditate with me, and then we will speak of the way the Light breathes."


In her hands, the Light is as pliable as clay, as brilliant as sunlight reflected off water. She has much to teach, even now.


New abilities are available for purchase from Ikora.

entries.title: New Light Armor Requisition
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Look at those hands," Ikora says admiringly, "steady as a rock. I knew you were up to the challenge."


"Not every Lightbearer can step into combat right away. But you've proven you're up to the task."


"Take this," she says, handing you a beautiful piece of armor. "Our Light is powerful, but only if we're alive to use it. Armor can often give you the half-second you need to come out on top."


"I'm sure Ghost will appreciate your survival, too," she says with a smile.


"Now get out there and explore your power for yourself. I can't wait to see what you discover."

entries.title: One Last Thing
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora is grateful for your efforts on the Moon. She has a gift for you to express that-something she thinks you might find useful.


"On behalf of the Vanguard," she says, "and…from Eris, as well."

entries.title: Pardon Our Dust
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Speak to Ikora in the Tower about the latest developments in her plan to destroy the newly resurrected Undying Mind.



        Ikora wishes you a happy Festival of the Lost and apprises you of her progress on the Vex portal, where construction is proceeding as planned. But there's more work to be done before the portal can be put to use.


Enjoy the Festival of the Lost while Ikora continues work on the Vex portal.

entries.title: Path of the Splicer I
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora welcomes you back and tells you she's pleased you'll be working together.


Mithrax and the House of Light Splicers are working tirelessly to decode the data you retrieve from the Vex network.


Ikora has ordered Saint-14 to oversee the humanitarian operations in the Eliksni Quarter. "If we can turn the Kell-breaker into an advocate for House Light, then others will follow," she says.


"Where the Darkness seeks to divide us, we need only offer out a hand."

entries.title: Path of the Splicer IV
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora reports that someone sabotaged the House of Light camp in the Eliksni Quarter.


"This wasn't just an attack on their Ether stores," she says. "Someone wanted to send a message."


She suspects that Lakshmi-2's radio messages triggered the unrest.


"The Vanguard has tolerated her broadcasts, as Zavala doesn't believe it's our place to interfere in civilian politics," she says. "I see now that was a mistake."


She sent Saint-14 down to the Eliksni Quarter to keep the peace and asks you to join him.


"Be the calm the City needs," she says.

entries.title: Path of the Splicer VI
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora's voice is grim as she explains that Quria's presence in the Vex network means that Savathûn, the Witch Queen, is behind the Endless Night.


"When the time comes, I'll put a spear of Light through the Witch Queen's heart myself," she tells you. "For now, I'm turning over all Hidden records and full archival access to Osiris… but no one else."


"Continue your Splicer training with Mithrax," she says. "Use it to root Savathûn's minions out. We'll reassess the situation when we've located our target."

entries.title: Path of the Splicer VIII
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Quria has been defeated, but there is no relief in Ikora's voice.


"The Dreaming Mind's defeat, as with so many things Vex, is a process," she says. "It will take time for Mithrax and his Splicers to finish untangling our reality from the Vex network."


She is now concerned with helping Osiris reach Lakshmi-2, who still believes the Eliksni will cause the dark future she saw.


But above all, Ikora is watching for Savathûn's next move.


"Everything she does is for a reason, even if it seems beyond our comprehension," she says. "I want to know what she hoped to gain."

entries.title: Patternbreaking
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Speak to Ikora at the Tower about the data you collected in the Black Garden.



        Ikora has analyzed the data you collected, and it all points to a single conclusion: the Vex have resurrected the Undying Mind, a Hydra built to seize control of the Black Garden. It appears to be hiding itself in multiple co-occurrent timelines. Ikora intends to devise a plan to deal with this new threat but needs time to sort out the details.


Continue your efforts in the Vex Offensive activity while Ikora develops her plan.

entries.title: Prepared for Battle
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"There are still threats on our horizon, Guardian," Ikora says. "But we will face them together. As a team."


As a reward for completing the Legendary Campaign, you have received powerful gear to help in the battles to come.

entries.title: Prepared for Battle
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"There are still threats on our horizon, Guardian," Ikora says. "But we will face them together. As a team."


As a reward for completing the Legendary Campaign, you have received powerful gear to help in the battles to come.

entries.title: Reach Level 20
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: Increase your level to claim these rewards.

entries.title: Riding the Storm
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Arc Light is the most wild and chaotic of the Traveler's gifts," Ikora says. "But its unpredictable nature is a strength, a tool to be used to sow discord in the forces of Darkness."


She holds out a hand and snaps her fingers, casting a crackle of sparks into the air. You feel a faint hum as the energy washes over you.


"Guardians of all orders wield this power: Warlock Stormcallers, Titan Strikers, Hunter Arcstriders. Join them and let our enemies feel the charge of your Light."

entries.title: Rise to the Challenge
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Rise to the Challenge



        Meditation comes in many forms. For some, it's reflection. For others, it's action. All that matters is that you take the time to be intentional about growing in the Light.


Complete daily and weekly challenges to test yourself and grow further in power.

entries.title: Rise to the Challenge
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Rise to the Challenge



        The Hidden already told Ikora all about your recent deeds. Your Light is an example to all.

entries.title: Searching for Clarity
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"It has been some time since we last spoke. I hope you are well-though hope, it seems, has little wake in this turbulent time."


"I find myself trying to resist the urge to theorize or apply motive, though I feel ensnared by the temptation to do so." Ikora expels a deep breath. "There is reason behind all of this. Order… clarity. Somewhere."


Ikora shifts to look at you; tension pinches her face. "Perhaps it is not hope that is needed, but rage."


"Rage for the lives that were plucked from the sky, for the holes left open and undefended, for the shadows allowed to creep into our home in the Pyramid's wake." She looks to the Traveler. "There is much to answer for."

entries.title: Season 6: Clear Conscience
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: With a knowing look, Ikora hands you a package. "Aunor asked me to give this to you," she says, smiling.

entries.title: Season of the Risen
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora has received word from Zavala about a meeting with Empress Caiatl that will take place in the Tower Hangar. An item accompanied the message: a strange spear of Cabal origin.


Ikora gives you the spear but reminds you it is mission-critical to investigate the Throne World before meeting with Zavala.


Complete "The Investigation" mission to continue The Witch Queen campaign.


This item starts the Season of the Risen campaign.

entries.title: Shape of Light
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"You've made good use of the Traveler's gift so far; the Fallen and Hive in the Cosmodrome can attest to that."


"But this is only the beginning, Guardian. Our power manifests in myriad ways… To reach your true potential, you must reach out to the Light and take hold of all the possibilities it offers."


Ikora clenches her hand into a fist.


"This journey takes time, but it's one we must all walk if we are to face the Darkness. Good luck."

entries.title: Shape of Light
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"You've made good use of the Traveler's gift so far; the Fallen and Hive in the Cosmodrome can attest to that."


"But this is only the beginning, Guardian. Our power manifests in myriad ways… To reach your true potential, you must reach out to the Light and take hold of all the possibilities it offers."


Ikora clenches her hand into a fist.


"This journey takes time, but it's one we must all walk if we are to face our enemies. Good luck."

entries.title: Speak to Ikora Rey
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
To find Panoptes, you'll need a map of the Infinite Forest. Ikora believes you can find one in the Pyramidion on Io.


Retrieve the map by completing mission "Deep Storage" on Io.

entries.title: Speak with Ikora Rey
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"It's good to see you, Guardian," Ikora says, inclining her head. "I was hoping I might ask for your help once again."


She folds her arms behind her back. "My Hidden have discovered unusual Red Legion activity on Mercury, but they are unable to locate the source of it." Her brow furrows. "My suspicion is that Osiris is at the center of this, but I've been unable to contact him. I was hoping you might be able to find him. Perhaps he can help us understand what's happened."

entries.title: Spreading Holiday Cheer
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: There's a chill in the air, but Ikora's warm greeting is that of a friend. She rewards you for your performance, and wishes you a happy Dawning.

entries.title: Stoking The Flame
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"I see you've grown accustomed to your new powers. The lingering flame of Solar Light has consumed many of my foes," Ikora says with a smile.


For a moment you think you see a flicker of red and orange in the depths of her gaze, but she blinks and it's gone.


"The nature of Solar Light is to grow," she continues. "It is an ember that must be stoked. Kindle it with your enemies, Guardian, and wielders of the flame will welcome you, be they Titan Sunbreakers, Warlock Dawnblades or Hunter Gunslingers."

entries.title: Strike Joy in Every Heart
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: There's a chill in the air, but Ikora's warm greeting is that of a friend. She rewards you for your performance in strikes, and wishes you a happy Dawning.

entries.title: Strike Out to Celebrate
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: As the Dawning comes to a close, Ikora has one last reward to give to her favorite Guardian -and friend.

entries.title: Talk to Ikora Rey
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: Complete mission "Omega" on Mercury.

entries.title: Taming the Storm
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Have you ever watched a storm rolling in? There is a moment of sublime tension before the deluge, when the air sings with potential energy. Arc Light harnesses this potential in combat."


"There are many applications of Arc, but I want you to focus on the ability to jolt. Jolted targets will chain lightning to others nearby, an excellent way to clear the battlefield quickly."


Ikora gives you an encouraging smile. "Be patient, Guardian. Arc Light can be chaotic and demanding. Return when you have more experience with Jolt, and I will guide you down the path of greater power."

entries.title: Taming the Storm
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora puzzles over the strange object you found in the Cosmodrome. 


"You unearthed this on your own? Fascinating. I suspect that your recent practice with Arc may have drawn you to the Lost Sector. The technology of the Fallen is, in some ways, an attempt to replicate the unbridled power of Arc."


"Indulge my curiosity for a moment, Guardian. Since you subdued the Servitors in the Lost Sector, you should make quick work of Sepiks Prime, the Servitor hiding in the Devils' Lair. Test your Light against the machine's strength."


Ikora gives you a small but genuine smile. "Don't worry, I wouldn't send you without adequate preparation." 


She presents you with a piece of armor. Energy surges through your fingers when you hold it. 


"Use this armor to supplement your own Arc abilities. When you have triumphed-and I have no doubt that you will-speak with Banshee-44. He'll make sure you're rewarded for your efforts."

entries.title: Taming the Storm
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora looks up at your approach. "You have already felt the chaotic surge of Arc Light. It is only the start to a deeper understanding."


"There are many applications of Arc, but I want you to focus on the ability to jolt. Jolted targets will chain lightning to others nearby; an excellent way to clear the battlefield quickly."


Ikora gives you an encouraging smile. "Be patient, Guardian. Arc Light can be chaotic and demanding. Return when you have more experience with Jolt, and I will guide you down the path of greater power."

entries.title: The Drowning Labyrinth
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora, contemplating a report, looks up at the sound of your approach.


"There was an artifact of the Taken King himself at the center of Rhulk's vaults. The tool with which Oryx carved the Tablets of Ruin."


"Containment is key here. We cannot allow anyone into that vault. Not the Hive, not the Dread, and certainly not Savathûn herself."


"As dangerous as it is, there's power in it we may be able to use. Rhulk forged a connection between the Chisel and his own ship. Affecting the one may affect the other-or so my Hidden have suggested."


Ikora hands over the report she was studying. 


"If you can glean anything else from Rhulk's ship, do. And please be assured that nobody unauthorized will be getting in anytime soon: the Hidden are setting up a perimeter as we speak."


"Well done, Guardian. The Vanguard's faith in you has never yet been misplaced. And if I may say… thank you for coming home safe."


Her smile is one of warmth and relief-but most of all, of pride.

entries.title: The Drowning Labyrinth
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora's face is drawn, mouth set in a grim line. She launches into business without any preliminaries.


"I'm hearing reports from Savathûn's throne world that a party of Dread have infiltrated the ruins of Rhulk's Pyramid ship. They appear to be collaborating with Hive within the ship."


Ikora taps through reports on her pad.


"We don't know what they're doing there. We don't know why. And, Guardian, the Vanguard is not pleased that the Dread snuck into a guarded area behind our backs."


"I'm asking you to take in your fireteam. My agents will remain on the scene for backup, but you're the tip of our spear. We need you in there, doing what you do best. Find out what the Dread are doing-and take what countermeasures you find appropriate."


Enter the "Sundered Doctrine" dungeon and uncover the mysteries of Rhulk's ship.

entries.title: The First of Many
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: You've done well, Guardian, but the Vex won't pause their assault on our account. We need your continued assistance to put an end to these incursions.

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Eva has transformed the Tower once more-this time with Zavala's help," Ikora says. "He seems to be enjoying himself.


"A little lighthearted competition is just what we need right now. And the people of the Last City will enjoy the spectacle of it." She smiles. "You'll be a good example for the other Warlocks. We can't let the Titans get too cocky. So don't hold back."

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"Eva has transformed the Tower once more-this time with Zavala's help," Ikora says with a smile. "He seems to be enjoying himself.


"A little lighthearted competition is just what we need right now. And the people of the Last City will enjoy the spectacle of it." She nods. "Have fun. Make your class proud."

entries.title: The Invitation
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora nods when you tell her about the malfunctioning frame. "Interesting timing," she says. "I just received a report from the Hidden that the Leviathan has deployed some kind of barge to the surface of Nessus."


She sizes you up. "If you want to investigate this on your own, I have no issue with that-but you're not going alone. Let me patch you the coordinates of the barge. I'll send other Guardians after you."

entries.title: The Red War
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Hi Guardian



        Ikora realized that the more we learn, the less we know. She now reflects on past events and meditates on the bright future promised by a reborn and living Traveler. She has also found in you a friend, someone she can trust. For her, that can be rare. 


Return to Ikora Rey to relive past Red War activities.

entries.title: The Red War
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora realized that the more we learn, the less we know. She now reflects on past events and meditates on the bright future promised by a reborn and living Traveler. She has also found in you a friend, someone she can trust. For her, that can be rare. 


Return to Ikora Rey to relive past Red War activities.

entries.title: The Tenets
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora gazes serenely out at the Bazaar. As you approach, her focus sharpens on you. She smiles. 


"I still recall the day I first laid eyes on you. A New Light, still learning the powers you wielded and the responsibilities that came with them." She chuckles, perhaps remembering some misadventure. 


"I saw the spark of greatness within you, yet I could not even begin to guess who you would become. In you, the Tenets are not merely abstract ideals. They are etched into your words and deeds." Ikora's eyes glimmer with amusement. "Now, when New Lights need guidance, I am spared from lengthy lectures. I need only point to your example."


You're not entirely sure if they should be following everything you do. Ikora only smiles knowingly. "I am fortunate to know you. As a Guardian who walks with me along this path…" Her voice dips, wistful. "And as a friend."


Once again you remember how long her second life has been; how many friends she has seen come and go. 


But you are not gone. Not yet.

entries.title: The Vanguard's Take
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Your discoveries within the Pyramid are key to the future and survival of all-but the Nightmares continue their attack across the entire system, beyond our Moon. They must not be allowed to spread any further.


Stay vigilant. Keep Nightmares at bay on every planet.


Our fight has only just begun.

entries.title: The Vex Offensive
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora has troubling news: the Black Garden is open, and scores of Vex are spilling out onto the surface of the Moon, with reinforcements following close behind.


In spite of everything else going on, Ikora needs trusted Guardians to investigate the threat. She has asked you to push back the Vex assault on the Moon.

entries.title: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora believes the worm statue you found before may not be a statue at all, but instead the calcified corpse of the worm itself. The memory locked within is ancient - too ancient to reveal by normal means. But Ikora has a plan, and it involves the Relic.


Meet Ikora on Mars.

entries.title: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora is daunted by the news of the Lucent Hive. She wants answers, but first, she asks you to visit the Pyramid Relic. She believes the fragment you found on Savathûn's ship might be a related artifact.


Visit the Relic in the Enclave on Mars, then report back to Ikora.

entries.title: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora is intrigued by your discovery: the Relic is capable of shaping objects based on memories. She believes there is more to learn from this device, but the threat of Savathûn must take precedence. Ikora asks you to search for answers in the Witch Queen's throne world.


Complete "The Investigation" mission in the Throne World.

entries.title: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora believes the secret we learned from the worm familiar is the key to stopping Savathûn's ritual to pull the Traveler into her throne world. This information could be enough to destabilize her. But you'll need to reveal the memory to Savathûn herself…


As you speak, the ritual is already beginning. Complete "The Ritual" mission in the Throne World.

entries.title: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora reckons with the revelation that she may be partly responsible for Savathûn's theft of the Light. But with the news that Savathûn also intends to pull the Traveler into her throne world and seal it away, there is no time to lose. She sends you to Fynch to follow up on another lead.


Complete "The Cunning" mission in the Throne World.

entries.title: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora explains that there's a final step to accessing the memory linked to Sagira's shell. You need to locate a concentration of psychic energy that will help manifest the memory. The Hidden have identified such a location in Savathûn's throne world.


Complete "The Mirror" mission in the Throne World.

entries.title: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora believes that when you picked up Sagira's shell, you heard a fragment of a memory belonging to Savathûn. Your interaction with the Relic unlocked a new ability in you, one related to Darkness. She believes you can strengthen this ability at the Europan Pyramid, and in doing so, gain access to the full memory linked to Sagira's shell.


Complete "The Communion" mission at the Europan Pyramid.

entries.title: The Witch Queen
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
With Savathûn dead, Ikora wants your help answering some lingering questions about the Witness. Queen Mara Sov has requested your presence, and Ikora believes she has vital information to share.


Meet Mara Sov, Queen of the Awoken, near the Relic.

entries.title: Timeline Reflection
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora welcomes you with a mix of warmth and relief. "Guardian. It's good to see you back in the Tower. We'll need everyone for the fight ahead."


Revisit past missions to understand what's at stake for the Guardians-and all of humanity. Complete each mission for rewards to arm yourself for the future.


You can launch missions directly from the Timeline. To access the Timeline, open up the Director and click on the Timeline icon in the upper right corner.

entries.title: Timeline Reflection
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
You've gained a deeper understanding into the recent history of the Guardians. Though the stakes are enormously high, the Vanguard and your fellow Guardians will always be ready to support you.


Ikora leaves you with a final bit of encouragement before sending you on your way. "Together, we can face anything. So remember: eyes up." 


You're ready to join your fellow Guardians in priority missions! Check out your Featured Quests for suggested activities. If you're ever at a loss for what to do next, look at Guardian Ranks for guidance.

entries.title: Timeline Reflection
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora welcomes you with a mix of warmth and relief. "Guardian. It's good to see you back in the Tower. We'll need everyone for the fight ahead."


Revisit past missions to understand what's at stake for the Guardians-and all of humanity. Complete each mission for rewards to arm yourself for the future.


You can launch missions directly from the Timeline. To access the Timeline, open up the World tab and click on the Timeline icon in the upper right corner.

entries.title: To Destroy a Mind
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Speak with Ikora about the latest developments in her plan to slay the Undying Mind.



        The portal is completed. Now, at last, the final phase of Ikora's plan to eliminate the Undying Mind can be put into practice. She and Zavala have tested the hardware extensively, locating and destroying dozens of instantiations of the Undying Mind-but there are hundreds, if not thousands, of copies still lurking in the Garden. This task now falls to you.


Enter the Black Garden to locate and defeat the Undying Mind.

entries.title: Unnamed Interaction
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Hey Guardian,



        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

entries.title: Vanguard
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Zavala has forbidden Guardians from traveling to the Reef for fear of starting a war with Uldren. So, officially, Ikora can't help you.


But unofficially, Ikora tips you off that Uldren and his Fallen Barons have gathered on a stretch of the Reef known as the Tangled Shore. If you want revenge, there's the place to start.


Take a hint from Ikora and investigate the Tangled Shore in mission "High Plains Blues."

entries.title: Vanguard
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: You've rid the system of Cayde's killers, and Ikora sleeps easier at night because of it. But she still worries about the future of the Vanguard. The Hunters are without a leader. Zavala is more withdrawn than ever. And Ikora wonders if the worst is yet to come.

entries.title: Vex Invasion
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
Ikora has troubling news: the Black Garden is open, and scores of Vex are spilling out onto the surface of the Moon, with reinforcements following close behind.


In spite of everything else going on, Ikora needs trusted Guardians to investigate the threat. She has asked you to push back the Vex assault on the Moon.

entries.title: Visions of Light
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: Ikora has received visions from the Traveler. And she's not the only one. She urges you to keep your eyes and mind open as you head to the Tangled Shore.

entries.title: Wayfinder's Voyage
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote:
"We've all been deceived," Ikora says. She shakes her head and laments that she was unable to uncover Savathûn's manipulations before it was too late.


Ikora stiffens her stance and looks you in the eye. She vows that Savathûn will face justice, but admits we must keep to Mara Sov's pact for now if we wish to see Osiris returned to us alive.

entries.title: Welcome to the Dawning
entries.speaker: Ikora Rey
entries.quote: The Dawning is a celebration of renewed hope. In the wake of the Red War, Ikora Rey has been meditating on the many things that all Guardians should be thankful for.

entries.title: Ascendant Lens
entries.speaker: Kadi 55-30
entries.quote:
Queen Mara's eyebrows lift as you hand her the Ascendant Lens. "This is an exceedingly rare trinket," she says, peering at you through the lens.


"It may not look like much to a common Guardian, but in the hands of our Techeuns, it will be a valuable research tool. You were right to bring it to me."


"Allow me to repay your generosity," she says, handing you a handsome reward.


You start to thank her, but she's already walking away. You've been dismissed.

entries.title: Celebrate with Future War Cult
entries.speaker: Lakshmi-2
entries.quote: An utterly unsurprising but satisfying victory. The City will be stronger for it. Future War Cult also.

entries.title: Faction Rallies
entries.speaker: Lakshmi-2
entries.quote: Future War Cult predicts and prepares for war. Constantly. Endlessly. Accurately. Fight for us, and you fight for the City in all its futures.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Lakshmi-2
entries.quote: Your reputation in Future War Cult precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

entries.title: Legacy: Ascension
entries.speaker: Lectern of Divination
entries.quote:
This Major Arcana card has been added to your Deck of Whispers and its secrets lie open to you.


When you hold at least 5 cards, one will be selected at random before each encounter in Savathûn's Spire and the Altars of Summoning. There, you may use its power to your advantage.


You can remove this card from your deck at any time by interacting with it in the Athenaeum. Removing a card means that it cannot be drawn in an activity, but it can be added again when you return to the Athenaeum.

entries.title: Legacy: Toil and Trouble
entries.speaker: Lectern of Divination
entries.quote:
The Lectern of Divination will collect cards from the Deck of Whispers, a powerful form of Hive magic manifested through your tithes to Eris Morn. Here, you may contemplate and interpret your Opaque Cards to unlock their power. This process requires gathering Insight throughout the system.


Once acquired, Major Arcana cards will be displayed in the Athenaeum. When 5 Major Arcana cards have been acquired, 1 will be selected at random before each encounter in Savathûn's Spire and the Altars of Summoning. Adding a card to your deck will allow that card to be randomly drawn.


Each Major Arcana card bestows unique benefits. Major Arcana cards may be added or removed from your deck by interacting with them in the Athenaeum. You must have at least 5 cards in your deck to draw upon their power in Season of the Witch activities.


Minor Arcana cards can be found in Season of the Witch activities or granted as rewards in ritual activities. When interpreted, they bestow perks, items, and upgrades.


The Lectern of Divination wavers with the heavy, coiling smoke of incense and glint of candlelight. From their place on the table, the cards whisper sweetly, promising secrets, truths, and lies.

entries.title: Nightmare Slayer
entries.speaker: Lectern of Enchantment
entries.quote:
The Lectern of Enchantment draws into its undulating depths all of the torment of the Nightmares you've recently banished.


The Nightmare energy slowly coalesces into a recognizable shape.

entries.title: Distortions
entries.speaker: Lodi
entries.quote:
Lodi greets you with warmth and a little twirl as you admire his scarf, "Hey, what do you think of the new look? Took some doing to find a local tailor who did more than robes, but I finally feel dressed for the job." 


The two of you share a silent, thoughtful moment. Weapon and Emissary, connected by a shared fate. But, equally, connected by friendship.


He sobers a little as he continues, "As kind as everyone has been, I can tell the Prophecy is still on their minds. And with good reason. The Outer Nine at work, undermining our reality. They're dead set on escaping Sol, no matter the cost. And if they degrade the integrity of our spacetime enough, they could do it."


Lodi frowns at you, deep sympathy in his gaze. "I hate to put yet another crisis on your plate, but these Nine-based distortions are manifesting across Sol causing all kinds of problem. The Vanguard is calling this an all-hands-on-deck situation. Good luck out there."

entries.title: Speak to Lodi
entries.speaker: Lodi
entries.quote:
Lodi turns to you urgently as you approach. "The Nine wax and wane, like a tide. Something about my relationship to them has changed. Will. Is changing. Heh, sorry! I'm… I'm…" He gasps as the Nine overwhelm him with a vision.


"I'm ten miles outside of Allen, South Dakota. 1960. I eat iodine tablets like popcorn and walk on the deck of a ship that appeared… in the ravine." He snorts, disoriented.


"I'm weightless, like… a coin in midair; a beach after an earthquake, before the tsunami. I-Don't worry, I'm here. I'm with you." He was speaking to you, but then he laughs, suddenly, his context shifting again.


"I'm in Madison, Wisconsin. It's 1929. I think that biplane is the most beautiful thing I've ever seen. I want to be up there." He blinks, and it seems like he finally sees you for a moment.


"The Nine are going to come back, and I'll stop them. They stretched me across time and didn't think I'd learn to use it for myself. Hold infinity in the palm of your hand and eternity in an hour. See?"


"It's 1962… and I'm in Lodi, Wisconsin. I feed ducks on the pond downtown. I drove there. My hands hurt from the cold. Ben's sitting next to me…"


He breathes in shakily, shifting his weight again. "It's years from now. You've learned enough Welsh to do more than just curse. Your accent still needs work."


He looks directly at you, now. "I'm not going anywhere. I'll call you sometime, Guardian."

entries.title: Ascendant Lens
entries.speaker: Loom
entries.quote:
Queen Mara's eyebrows lift as you hand her the Ascendant Lens. "This is an exceedingly rare trinket," she says, peering at you through the lens.


"It may not look like much to a common Guardian, but in the hands of our Techeuns, it will be a valuable research tool. You were right to bring it to me."


"Allow me to repay your generosity," she says, handing you a handsome reward.


You start to thank her, but she's already walking away. You've been dismissed.

entries.title: Armed and Dangerous
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
Lord Saladin is impressed with your ability to take control of a fight. He hopes his new recruits are paying close attention, and he has another lesson for you to teach.


"Some new Guardians are shy about using their Light," he says. "Show them a better way."

entries.title: Daily: Iron Banner
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
Speak



        Fought like a Lord of Iron. You've earned this. This City needs more Guardians like you: purveyors of the old way.

entries.title: Engram Tracker
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
A recorded message from Master Rahool plays when you pick up the engram tracker: 


"Guardian! This is a new device of my own manufacture. It will allow you to monitor the number of engrams available at each of the vendors in the Tower."


"If you ever lose it, you can pick up a new one from any of those vendors. I look forward to seeing you deploy this device."

entries.title: Faction Reward

entries.quote: Complete Iron Banner matches to obtain Iron Banner tokens and earn Level 20 rewards from this faction.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote: Your reputation in the Iron Banner precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote: Complete Iron Banner matches to obtain Iron Banner tokens and earn rewards from this faction.

entries.title: For the War to Come
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
"I see with unclouded eyes now," Saladin says with a sigh. Though he seems more tired than usual, his hard edges worn down. "My trust was betrayed, and I was led astray."


"Never in my dreams would I have imagined us where we are now." Saladin continues, looking off to the Traveler. "Surrounded by the heralds of the Collapse, betrayed from within, standing shoulder-to-shoulder with the Fallen." He rankles, just a little, and then sighs deeply.


When Saladin looks away from the Traveler, there is a weight in his eyes. A weight of years. "The war to come may be our last. But we will see it through, together. For our unity is our greatest strength."

entries.title: Forgeborne
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote: Guardian. You've taken to my lessons well. Your heart is strong and your will, iron. Had you been given the chance in my time, I believe you would have stood as an equal in our ranks. Perhaps, one day, the Iron Lords will see new Light. A pack led by a once Young Wolf. Heh… Perhaps.

entries.title: Forging Iron
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote: "Watching young cubs become wolves… there are few responsibilities more thrilling." -Lord Saladin

entries.title: Forging Iron
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
Saladin's gaze could fell trees. The Iron Lord does not lift his eyes from you as you approach.


"Well met, Guardian. Every time I return to the City, I'm reminded of how far we've come. Nevertheless, we must stay vigilant. Our enemies grow stronger; so should we.


"My duty to the Cabal does not prevent me from carrying the Iron Banner forward. This test of skill is one that hones Guardians in ways that the conventional Crucible can't.


"More than that, the proceedings honor the Iron Lords who have come and gone before you. Will you make them proud?"

entries.title: Headstrong
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
Lord Saladin thanks you for your hard work. You've set a strong example for Guardians who wish to follow in the footsteps of the Iron Lords.


He asks that you carry these lessons forward, even after the Iron Banner has ended.

entries.title: Howl-adin Forge
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
"I once saw grief as an enemy," Saladin says as you approach. "Which, once it attacked, could return at any time, paralyzing its victims. Always around the corner."


He looks around at the decorations. "I see things differently now." He is silent, thinking, and then looks at you again. "Enjoy the Festival, Guardian. Honor your lost. But don't neglect your duties."

entries.title: Iron Cast
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote: "Your reverence for the old ways makes them new again. Your heart is strong and your will, iron. Continue your dominance in the Iron Banner, and you will reap rewards." -Lord Saladin

entries.title: Iron-Handed Diplomacy
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote: "These days, our enemies and allies seem to change like the weather. It's important that our capacity for hostility increases alongside our capacity for peace. Don't confuse a lull in battle for the end of the war." -Lord Saladin

entries.title: Light It Up
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
"You've shown your opponents what it means to truly wield the Light," Lord Saladin says when you return. "Now make them work harder."


Some new recruits seem too reliant on their favorite weapons. He wants you to show your fellow Guardians that it pays to be well-rounded.

entries.title: Non-Stop
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
Lord Saladin congratulates you on a job well done. You've shown your opponents the importance of being prepared for anything.


"They've seen what it takes to win," he says. "Now show them how to keep winning."

entries.title: Polish the Armor
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote: "Your reverence for the old ways makes them new again. Your heart is strong and your will, iron. Continue your dominance in the Iron Banner, and you will reap rewards." -Lord Saladin

entries.title: Power of Faith
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
"Young Wolf. You've been reckless." Lord Saladin measures your presence, up and down.


"You and Zavala both know better." He scoffs at you. "Is the City so desperate for allies that you've forgotten the Light? Forgotten what I have taught you?" He shakes his head. "Look upon the Traveler. It is the only ally you will ever need."


The Iron Lord's frustration propels his every word.


"Your scoundrel friend says nothing kills a Guardian faster than a Guardian. He's not wrong." Saladin is stern and unyielding. "Hubris toppled the Warmind where we failed. It pilfered our land as we huddled listening to static."


Saladin leans forward and growls, "Take care you don't fall prey to it, or the Darkness won't be who comes for you."

entries.title: Saladin's Gauntlet
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote: Lord Saladin pays you no mind as you approach, opting to instead look over battle plans and Cabal troop movements. "You performed well in the Banner, young Wolf. Take that training out into the field and send Caiatl running back to her burning homeworld."

entries.title: Securing Provisions
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote: "Lady Jolder often complained that being lords of 'iron' was not so impressive, as iron rusts. She came to understand that was the point. Lordship, as with all delicate things, requires maintenance." -Lord Saladin

entries.title: Slaying Dragons
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
Lord Saladin places a weapon in your hands.


"Arm yourself for the wars to come," he says.


He smiles, but there is no warmth in his eyes.

entries.title: Test of Strength
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
Lord Saladin is pleased: You've demonstrated the spirit of the Iron Banner and taught your opponents the humility of defeat.


“New Guardians can learn something from watching you,” he says. “Now I want you to show them what it means to dominate the arena.”

entries.title: The Iron Banner
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
Speak



        The Red Legion has been laid low. You've done well. Now, the time is right for the Iron Banner to return. Show me you can triumph in battles of Light versus Light, and I will reward you with relics from the Dark Age: the armor and weapons of the Iron Lords.

entries.title: What We Survive
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
Lord Saladin meets your eyes as you approach.


You half-expected to see a weariness hanging over him, as though recent events-the Lucent Hive, Caiatl, Crow-were wearing him down.


And yet, as he stands before you, there is nothing in his face but pride.


"You have done well in the Iron Banner, Young Wolf," he says, and nothing more needs to be said.

entries.title: Wolf's Clothing
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
Lord Saladin thanks you for your hard work. You've set a strong example for Guardians who wish to follow in the footsteps of the Iron Lords.


He asks that you carry these lessons forward, even after the Iron Banner has ended.

entries.title: Wolf's Clothing
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
Lord Saladin congratulates you on a job well done. You've shown your opponents the importance of being prepared for anything.


"They've seen what it takes to win," he says. "Now show them how to keep winning."

entries.title: Wolf's Clothing
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
Lord Saladin is impressed with your ability to take control of a fight. He hopes his new recruits are paying close attention, and he has another lesson for you to teach.


"Some new Guardians are shy about using their Light," he says. "Show them a better way."

entries.title: Wolf's Clothing
entries.speaker: Lord Saladin
entries.quote:
"You've shown your opponents what it means to truly wield the Light," Lord Saladin says when you return. "Now make them work harder."


Some new recruits seem too reliant on their favorite weapons. He wants you to show your fellow Guardians that it pays to be well-rounded.

entries.title: A Guardian Rises
entries.speaker: Lord Shaxx
entries.quote:
"Ah, Shaw Han's savior arrives," Lord Shaxx says. He towers over you, standing proudly in front of the waving Crucible flags that adorn his workspace.


"You may have survived the Cosmodrome, Guardian, but your steel is not yet tempered."


He clasps his hands together.


"When you're ready for a real test, join your fellow Guardians in the Crucible. Only by pitting yourself against other Lightbearers can you truly forge yourself into the weapon you're meant to be."


You can now access the Triumphs menu. Triumphs are a collection of specific objectives to achieve within Destiny 2. Completing them contributes to your Triumph score, and sometimes grants additional rewards. Claim the item below to unlock this system.

entries.title: A Lover and a Fighter
entries.speaker: Lord Shaxx
entries.quote: Shaxx is impressed by your commitment to your Bond. Your zeal, your fury, your undeniable charisma… The two of you are an awe-inspiring team. Keep spreading the love.

entries.title: Armor of Flame
entries.speaker: Lord Shaxx
entries.quote:
Armor of Flame



        Shaxx sees in you a kindred spirit. He congratulates you on your mighty and dazzling victory.

entries.title: Armor of Flame
entries.speaker: Lord Shaxx
entries.quote:
Armor of Flame



        Victory is about more than just winning a match. Shaxx knows the power of a symbol.


He challenges you to win a Crucible match wearing full Season 4 Crucible armor.
